g.desc: 发髻 bun：头顶贝壳形盘发团，竖向褶脊（内部结构线见 s00–s05）。填色 = 参考可见范围（顶缘与两侧外壁，y≈41–100）+ 被 shell_crown 遮住的中下部 + 被 hair_cap 圆顶遮住的底部隆起（至 y≈136），闭合单块 nonzero。叠放：位于 halo_ring 之上、hair_cap 之下（hair_cap 圆顶压住发髻底部；hair_cap 已延伸到发髻底座下），shell_crown 之后另画于其前。预计露出：器冠/两侧花瓣摆动时露出冠后 x≈468–542、y≈72–120 的发髻面；发髻弹动/头部倾转时 hair_cap 上缘下方露出 y≈120–130 的发髻底部，按可见部分的褶脊与明暗规律延续；y＞130 的底部余量可简化。【3.4 细节与纹理线】按参考细节密度核对：发髻为光洁贝壳面，仅有 s00–s05 放射棱与侧转面线，顶缘、壁面和冠后露出区均无额外纹理或装饰；隐藏区沿用放射棱规律（s00h–s05h），无需新增细节线，沿用已有内容。【投影关系（4.5）】bun 未登记独立投影层：参考中冠拱外缘与发髻交界无可见投影带；两侧白花瓣上缘 y≈94–98 的加深来源不确定（可能是 shell_crown 侧花瓣投到 bun 的投影，也可能是自身转面暗部），按原绘制保留在 vol_shadow_left/right 与 s04/s05 暗面内，疑点记于 s04/s05 desc。bun 投到 hair_cap 的影子沿用 head/hair_cap 管理的 hair_bun_shadow_on_hair_cap，不在本组重复登记。【4.7 复核】对照参考逐行取样修正 Rendering Stack：参考左右外壁在 y 72–88 外侧（转面线到外轮廓之间 3–6px）为亮面 #f0e9f2–#f3ecf6，暗部并非整片外侧暗面，而是沿 s04/s05 的 3–5px 柔和凹带 #c6c3dc–#d2cfe4；y≈88 起外壁根部才转暗，y 92–98 下缘整体 #c0bdd6–#c9c5de。据此：vol_mid_left/right 渐变改为上段亮、y 86 以下转暗；vol_shadow 与 ct_cool_base 起点下移至 y 86–88；local_shading 增加 ls_s04/s05_turn_band 凹带。s04/s05 desc 中“线外侧为暗侧面”的 3.3 判断以本条为准。线色：外轮廓 #8c8ba6–#9796b2，右侧暗面 #7e7c93（参考抗锯齿边 #7e7b8e–#9598b4）；放射棱 #c3c2db–#cfcde2，近冠拱转蓝紫 #b9bde2/#a2a6d5（参考 #bfc1e3、#9ba1d4）。未补额外纹理：参考发髻为平滑扇形发面，仅棱槽与亮边。

g.data-volume-source: head_hair_bun_bun_s04 s05 t01（t00 顶缘亮边留给高光节点）
g.desc: head/hair_bun/bun 大明暗与体积（4.2）：主光来自正面偏左上，贝壳发髻正面与顶部圆隆受光保持基色 #eee9f0，放射棱只作细槽、不另设面暗；两侧外壁由正面转向侧面为背光面，底鼓朝下转入头顶发为背光面。两级色面：转面中间调沿 s04/s05 外侧铺开，自上而下由 #ebe6ef/#eee9f0 渐深到 #dfdaea（明度降约 5–6%，色相向冷紫、纯度略升），内界贴 s04/s05、0.45px 模糊的半硬边；外壁暗部 #cdc8de 只在近花瓣 y 86–100 的壁根处，1.5px 软边（参考壁根 #c5c1d9–#d0cbdf）。右侧暗面比左侧起得低且窄（参考 y 72–82 右壁几乎无暗）。底鼓暗部 #e0dbea 在 t01 以下，3px 软过渡，参考中完全隐藏，供露出时连续。均按 head_hair_bun_bun 色块裁切。花瓣对壁根的可能投影、shell_crown 的接触阴影不在此处理，留给 4.5。

head/hair_bun/bun 过渡色与局部色变化（4.3）：参考左上外壁与顶缘左段 #f2eef4–#f4eff6 比正面 #eee9f0 略亮、略偏暖粉紫，铺一块宽软亮色过渡，衔接受光正面与左上光源方向；两侧壁根的暗部 #cdc8de 与转面中间调 #dfdaea 之间补一条偏冷蓝紫的过渡带 #d7d4e8（参考壁根 #c5c1d9 含蓝，过渡处 #e7e2f0/#e7deee），使暗部向花瓣下方的冷色自然过渡、不出现灰浊。右侧亮色不加（参考右上壁 #efe9f1 与正面同值）。s04/s05 内界的半硬分界保持不动；过渡层均为 2.2px 软边，按色块裁切，归属本 part，不改大明暗分区。

head/hair_bun/bun 局部暗部（4.4）：放射棱为浅凹槽，参考槽心 #b9b8d4–#d0cde4、槽宽上端 2–3px（内侧 s00/s01 较宽，s01 右缘带柔和过渡），向冠拱方向收窄到约 1px；各槽沿 s00–s03 中心线铺 #d2cfe3（透明度 0.75）的楔形软暗带，上端 8% 渐入（顶缘处不压黑），0.4px 软边，叠在 brush 槽心线之下，只加宽槽的柔和外沿，不再加深槽心，避免重复叠加。侧转面 s04/s05 已由 4.2 中间调与壁根暗部承担，不另加线状暗部；本 part 无孔洞、接缝。花瓣与 shell_crown 对本 part 的投影留给 4.5。按色块裁切，随本 part 保存。

所属 head/hair_bun/bun。4.6 高光：仅顶缘受光亮边（对应 t00_rim_highlight_inner 与 c00 之间的带），随表面变化，留在本 part 内。参考：外轮廓内侧 1.5–2.5px 亮边约 #f5f0f8–#f9f7fa，左上 (466–480, y 52–70) 最亮最宽，顶点附近次之，右段 (524–546) 变窄偏弱；左端约 y 74、右端约 y 70 以下渐隐。做法：沿 c00 描 4.6px 宽亮色描边，由引导色块裁切成约 2.3px 内侧带，横向渐变控制左强右弱，纵向蒙版下端渐隐，0.6px 柔边。发丝放射棱之间无独立高光，不加反光/透光（下缘贴冠与白花瓣，参考未见反光）。t00 辅助线继续隐藏保存。

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke（size=1, thinning=1, streamline=0, simulate_pressure=False, 压力=目标线宽/2）；源曲线见 data-source-curve；线色 4.7 已融合：外轮廓 #8c8ba6→顶缘 #9796b2→右侧暗面 #7e7c93；放射棱/转面线用邻近色面同色系淡紫 #cfcde2–#c3c2db，近冠拱段转蓝紫 #b9bde2/#a2a6d5；见各渐变
g.desc: head/hair_bun/bun 重绘笔触：按各源曲线 desc 的粗细、起收笔、渐隐和留白生成闭合填色笔触。外轮廓不裁切以保留半边落在色块外的剪影线；结构线与转面线用 head_hair_bun_bun 指引色块（与 groups.svg head_hair_bun_bun_block 同形）裁切。隐藏延伸（c01–c03、s00h–s05h、s06）与明暗范围线 t00/t01 保留为 display=none 源路径：t00 由下一阶段亮色面接管，t01 与 s04/s05 外侧暗面由色面接管/融入明暗，隐藏段仅在露出时启用。

head/left_side_hair/main_lock 直属 part 外轮廓与接界（3.1）。叠放：位于 left_side_hair 内最底，main_mass → inner_thin_strands → curled_tip 由下到上；temple_strand、outer_loose_strands、hair_cap、左头饰丝带、左耳坠、躯干、骨盆、左大腿与左臂都压在本 group 之上；脸、左耳、颈部在其下（颈部当前在文档中位于本 group 之后，见 main_mass 说明）。线型仅作定位：实线=可见外缘，点划=被前方部件压住的遮挡接界，虚线=隐藏补齐边界。

head/left_side_hair/main_lock/main_mass 主发束体：角色左侧（画面右）从 hair_cap 下垂的整束长发，上段贴脸颊、耳与颈侧（x 529–592，y 222–363，含耳坠流苏处的孔洞），经肩后、躯干后与上臂后隐藏下行（x 574–664，y 363–660），在髋外侧与前臂之间重新露出（x 598–678，y 637–830），下端沿左大腿外缘收成尖梢（尖点约 (584,982)）。外轮廓按 groups.svg 的 main_mass 色块闭合，可见外缘与参考图对齐，隐藏段沿用已补全范围。叠放注意：neck/neck_skin 在 character.svg 中排在本 group 之后，其隐藏补齐会盖住本 part 在颈侧的可见发面（约 x 529–564，y 298–363）；merge 不允许重排，需由总控/颈部 owner 决定处理（例如裁掉颈部在发下的余量或调整叠放）。
main_mass 的大明暗与体积色面（4.2），位于基色之上、线稿之下。
main_mass 的过渡色与局部色（4.3），叠在 4.2 大明暗之上、线稿之下。
main_mass 的局部暗部细化（4.4），叠在 4.3 过渡色之上、线稿之下；其他对象投影留给 4.5。
head_left_side_hair_main_lock_main_mass 4.6 高光与反光：随表面变化的亮部，裁切到本 part 轮廓

head_left_side_hair_main_lock_main_mass 的画笔重绘笔触（3.5）。原曲线保留并隐藏：data-brush-status="source" 为已重绘的来源曲线，"hidden-guide" 为填色辅助边界、遮挡/隐藏定位线与明暗定位线（由色面接管，说明保留供后续处理）。；4.7 线色：中性灰改为邻近发色同系蓝紫深色，按参考逐段取色（内部发丝 #8a8cbc 系，发叠边 #7b7cad 系，外轮廓 #5f6188 系，贴皮肤接触线偏藕紫 #8f7f9f 系，亮丝 #eeecf8）
head/left_side_hair/main_lock/inner_thin_strands 内侧细发束：从主束右下（前臂内侧 y≈718）分出的几缕细长发，向左下扫过主束，三枚尖梢伸向黑背景（x 616–682，y 718–892），中间夹一条透黑缝隙，另有一段独立细发丝 (642,856)。压在 main_mass 之上、curled_tip 之下，上端发根被左前臂压住。
inner_thin_strands 的大明暗与体积色面（4.2），位于基色之上、线稿之下。
inner_thin_strands 的过渡色与局部色（4.3），叠在 4.2 大明暗之上、线稿之下。
inner_thin_strands 的局部暗部细化（4.4），叠在 4.3 过渡色之上、线稿之下；其他对象投影留给 4.5。
head_left_side_hair_main_lock_inner_thin_strands 4.6 高光与反光：随表面变化的亮部，裁切到本 part 轮廓

head_left_side_hair_main_lock_inner_thin_strands 的画笔重绘笔触（3.5）。原曲线保留并隐藏：data-brush-status="source" 为已重绘的来源曲线，"hidden-guide" 为填色辅助边界、遮挡/隐藏定位线与明暗定位线（由色面接管，说明保留供后续处理）。；4.7 线色：中性灰改为邻近发色同系蓝紫深色，按参考逐段取色（内部发丝 #8a8cbc 系，发叠边 #7b7cad 系，外轮廓 #5f6188 系，贴皮肤接触线偏藕紫 #8f7f9f 系，亮丝 #eeecf8）
head/left_side_hair/main_lock/curled_tip 末端卷梢：细发束下方垂出、向右下弯出的一枚卷尖（x 612–650，y 885–952），压在 main_mass 尖梢与 inner_thin_strands 末端之上，尖端伸到黑背景并在参考中带一段极淡拖尾 (650–660, 950–953)。
curled_tip 的大明暗与体积色面（4.2），位于基色之上、线稿之下。
curled_tip 的过渡色与局部色（4.3），叠在 4.2 大明暗之上、线稿之下。
head_left_side_hair_main_lock_curled_tip 4.6 高光与反光：随表面变化的亮部，裁切到本 part 轮廓

head_left_side_hair_main_lock_curled_tip 的画笔重绘笔触（3.5）。原曲线保留并隐藏：data-brush-status="source" 为已重绘的来源曲线，"hidden-guide" 为填色辅助边界、遮挡/隐藏定位线与明暗定位线（由色面接管，说明保留供后续处理）。；4.7 线色：中性灰改为邻近发色同系蓝紫深色，按参考逐段取色（内部发丝 #8a8cbc 系，发叠边 #7b7cad 系，外轮廓 #5f6188 系，贴皮肤接触线偏藕紫 #8f7f9f 系，亮丝 #eeecf8）
鬓角细发束：从发际 (589,207) 沿 hair_cap 外缘下行，在 main_lock 外侧鼓出一道细弧（与 main_lock 之间透出背景空隙），下段回折斜压过 main_lock 外缘并在肩上分成两枚末梢。填色按 groups.svg 的 temple_strand 色块，含 hair_cap 下的发根隐藏段；闭合、evenodd。

head/left_side_hair/temple_strand 大明暗与体积（主光左上前方）：上段直束与两枚末梢为受光面，保持基色 #e8e4ef（参考约 (236,232,238)）；细弧从背景空隙外侧鼓出后转为背光面，参考 y 292–322 核心约 (167,168,192)，外缘一侧 1–3 px 略亮约 (190,188,215)；细弧顶端 y 284–298 外缘有一条近白受光亮边（约 245–251）；下段直束被上方回折发束压住、转面向内，约 (204,208,223)，向末梢渐亮回基色。暗区上下以 t00/t01 为界，软边过渡约 3 px；亮边与中间调分别以 s02 为内界。hair_cap 压在发根的投影（t02）属外来投影，留给 4.5。

head/left_side_hair/temple_strand 过渡色与局部色（叠在大明暗之上，不改明暗分区）：参考图中细发束从上到下由偏粉的浅紫逐渐转冷——上段直束 y 256–280 约 (236,231,243)（色相约 265°，纯度略高于基色），细弧背光面偏蓝紫（约 235°），回折后的下段直束 y 328–350 再转为冷蓝灰约 (206,212,225)（约 222°）；右侧末梢 y 352–364 明显偏蓝紫、纯度提高约 (220,216,246)–(227,221,254)，左侧末梢保持基色。各过渡为软渐变（6–10 px 淡入淡出），不形成新硬边。

head/left_side_hair/temple_strand 局部暗部（自身结构，叠在过渡色之上）：细弧回折与下段直束交叉成 X 处的左下夹角，参考 (586,322–327) 有一处约 3×5 px 的软暗凹 (150,146,176)–(125,123,151)，以软椭圆表现、边缘 0.6 px 模糊；交叉点下方下段直束左缘 y 329–337 有一道约 1 px 的浅折痕 (142,142,164)–(156,156,179)，两端渐隐。s01 回折叠压线一侧在参考图中直接为背景空隙（纯黑），无需另加叠压暗带；两枚末梢分叉凹口亦为空隙，不加暗部。hair_cap 压在发根的投影留给 4.5。

g.data-highlight-source: 参考图逐像素取样；主光左上前方
g.desc: head/left_side_hair/temple_strand 高光与反光（头发：沿外轮廓内侧的细条亮边，随发束弯曲，软边约 0.4 px）。① 细弧顶端外缘受光高光：参考 y 270–296 外缘内侧 1–2 px 处亮度 245–252、微偏青白 (f3f7f3)，比 4.2 的顶端亮边更亮、更窄，沿 c00_outer 内收 1.5 px 画 1.3 px 宽亮线，上下两端渐隐。② 细弧背光段外缘反光：参考 y 298–318 外缘内侧约 1 px 亮度回升到 200–222（核心约 175），为环境反光，以 1 px 浅冷灰紫 #d6d6e8 半透明细线表现，不盖过暗区。下段直束与两枚末梢参考亮度与已有基色/过渡色一致，不另加高光；暗区内部不加亮点。

g.data-line-color: 线色（4.7）：按参考逐点取样改为邻近色面同色系紫灰，受光段 #6e6a86–#77738f、细弧背光段 #5e5b79、与 main_lock 叠压线 #7d7b97→#8e8ea4、并行弱线 #a9a6ba、分叉/回折线 #6b6883/#77748f、转面软线 #9995b2、发丝 #8a87a2–#8f8ba8；沿笔触用 y 向渐变分段，原有粗细、留白与渐隐不变。
g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke（size=1.2, thinning=1.0, smoothing=0.5, streamline=0, simulate_pressure=False, 首尾缓动 t*t*(3-2t)）；源曲线见 data-source-curve；线色见 data-line-color
g.desc: head/left_side_hair/temple_strand 重绘笔触：沿源曲线 0.3px 间距采样，按各 desc 的粗细设压力、按留白区间分段、渐隐段用沿段线性渐变透明度、软边用 feGaussianBlur；结构线、转面线与发丝线用 r2s3_head__left_side_hair_clip_temple_strand（取本 part 填色，即 guide_svg 对应色块）裁切，轮廓线不裁切。隐藏延伸（*_hidden）、明暗范围线（t*）作为 display=none 源路径保留，供运动露出与下一阶段明暗色面接管。
外侧散发：彩带与上臂之间的短发片（含运动露出补齐的彩带/手臂后隐藏段，x≈638–669，y≈457–611）与前臂外侧的长散发（x≈679–711，y≈625–743）。填色按 groups.svg 的 outer_loose_strands 色块与 _occluded 补齐；两个子路径互不相交，闭合、evenodd。

head/left_side_hair/outer_loose_strands 大明暗与体积：整层处在手臂外侧的背光冷区，基色 #c6cde6（参考约 (196,205,228)）作为主体；长散发朝外（右）转出的一侧为受光亮带，参考约 (224,224,240)，内界为 t00（y 633–721），其下由 s00 接替至末梢；边缘中等偏软，过渡约 1.5 px。贴前臂的内侧薄束（s00 左侧）与主体同色。短发片可见段很窄、参考亮度均匀，不分明暗；隐藏延伸按 t03_hidden 延续右侧亮带（推断，上下两端淡出），供彩带摆开露出时连续。外缘高光核心（t01）留给高光节点；彩带压在长散发上端的投影（t02）与短发片左缘暗边属外来投影或来源存疑，留给 4.5。4.5.1 复核：短发片可见段左缘紧贴上臂皮肤，参考 (654–656,580–584) 的偏暗像素为臂轮廓与发片边线的抗锯齿，x 664 y 584–588 的暗线更像发片内分缕缝，均未见可登记的外来投影，暂保持原画；若后续确认为上臂投影，再登记 follow arms/left_arm。

head/left_side_hair/outer_loose_strands 过渡色与局部色：长散发主体冷蓝（约 223°，(194,205,227)），外侧亮带偏紫（约 240°，(224,224,240)），两者之间参考可见一条约 2 px 的中间色 (215,217,234)，沿 t00 补软过渡；长散发末梢 y 712–742 逐渐变亮、偏淡紫 (227,222,238)–(238,237,249)；短发片可见段 y 580–610 比长散发纯度低、略偏灰紫约 (197,197,218)。彩带下的长散发上段变暗属外来投影，留给 4.5；隐藏延伸不加局部色。

head/left_side_hair/outer_loose_strands 局部暗部（自身结构）：长散发外侧主束压住贴臂内侧薄束，参考 s00 叠压线右侧（主束一侧）y 704–728 有约 1.5 px 宽的微暗带 (188,197,222)，比主体基色略深、软边，上下渐隐，不重复加深 s00 线本身；s00 自内缘分出处 (697,696) 的分叉夹角有一小片软暗。短发片可见段很窄、参考亮度均匀，不加局部暗部。彩带压在长散发上端的投影与短发片左缘暗边留给 4.5。

g.data-highlight-source: 参考图逐像素取样；主光左上前方，长散发外（右）缘为受光侧
g.desc: head/left_side_hair/outer_loose_strands 高光（头发：沿外缘 c04_outer 内侧的细长亮线，宽约 1.3–1.5 px，软边 0.4 px）。① 高光核心（t01 范围）：参考 y 668–738、外缘内侧 1.5–2 px 处亮度 240–251，近白 #f6f6fc，比 4.2 受光亮带 (224–235) 高一档；沿 c04_outer 内收 1.7 px 绘制，上端 y 664 渐起、末梢 y 741 渐收。② 上段弱亮边：彩带切口以下 y 633–668 外缘内侧亮度约 228–235（主体约 197），以较弱的 #e6e9f6 细线衔接核心；此段位于彩带投影区，投影层在后续 multiply 叠压，不在此处削弱。贴前臂的内侧薄束与短发片参考亮度平，不加高光。

g.data-line-color: 线色（4.7）：长散发偏冷蓝，外缘 #6a6e90→#75789a；内缘上段同色，y≥712 贴前臂处转暖 #8a7a8e（参考 (201,164,158) 混肤色）；叠压线 #8f96b8、转面软线 #a3a8c6、发丝 #959bbd；短发片 #6d7192。
g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke（size=1.2, thinning=1.0, smoothing=0.5, streamline=0, simulate_pressure=False, 首尾缓动 t*t*(3-2t)）；源曲线见 data-source-curve；线色见 data-line-color
g.desc: head/left_side_hair/outer_loose_strands 重绘笔触：沿源曲线 0.3px 间距采样，按各 desc 的粗细设压力、按留白区间分段、渐隐段用沿段线性渐变透明度、软边用 feGaussianBlur；结构线、转面线与发丝线用 r2s3_head__left_side_hair_clip_outer_loose_strands（取本 part 填色，即 guide_svg 对应色块）裁切，轮廓线不裁切。隐藏延伸（*_hidden）、明暗范围线（t*）作为 display=none 源路径保留，供运动露出与下一阶段明暗色面接管。

head/right_side_hair/main_lock 直属 part 外轮廓与接界（3.1）。叠放：位于 right_side_hair 内最底，main_mass → inner_thin_strands → curled_tip 由下到上；temple_strand、cheek_lock、outer_lock、hair_cap、右头饰丝带、右耳坠、躯干、骨盆、右大腿与右臂都压在本 group 之上；脸、右耳、后发在其下，颈部在发下（颈部当前在文档中位于本 group 之后，见 main_mass 说明）。线型仅作定位：实线=可见外缘/叠压边，点划=被前方部件压住的遮挡接界，虚线=隐藏补齐边界。待父级扩展：右耳坠流苏孔洞、指缝发岛与主束的手后连接。

head/right_side_hair/main_lock/main_mass 主发束体：角色右侧（画面左）从 hair_cap 下垂的整束长发。上段在 cheek_lock 与 temple_strand 之间贴脸颊、耳前与颈侧露出（x 412–508，y 250–355，含右耳坠流苏处孔洞，并以尖角盖到下颌 (505,312) 附近），经肩、胸、右上臂、丝带与 outer_lock 后隐藏下行（x 310–465，y 355–700），在右前臂/手与髋之间重新露出（x 312–437，y 520–770），沿右大腿外缘下行，下端收成长尖梢（尖点约 (427,984)）；另含右手指缝间露出的独立发岛（x 310–315，y 803–820）。外轮廓按 groups.svg 的 main_mass 色块闭合（含 2.3 运动露出补齐的发根承接），可见外缘与参考图对齐，隐藏段沿用已补全范围。叠放注意：neck/neck_skin 在 character.svg 中排在本 group 之后，会盖住本 part 在颈侧的可见发面（约 x 463–491，y 300–355）；merge 不允许重排，需由总控/颈部 owner 处理。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/main_mass 的大明暗与体积色面（4.2），位于基色之上、线稿笔触之下；光向为画面左上主光。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/main_mass 的过渡色与局部色（4.3），叠在 4.2 大明暗之上、线稿笔触之下。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/main_mass 的局部暗部细化（4.4），叠在 4.3 过渡色之上、线稿笔触之下；其他对象投影留给 4.5。
head_right_side_hair_main_lock_main_mass 4.6 高光与反光：参考中近白淡紫的受光发片与发丝窄边，随表面变化，裁切到本 part 轮廓；置于笔触线之下
head_right_side_hair_main_lock_main_mass 的画笔重绘笔触（3.5）。原曲线保留并隐藏：data-brush-status="source" 为已重绘的来源曲线，"hidden-guide" 为填色辅助边界、遮挡/隐藏定位线与明暗定位线（由色面接管，说明保留供后续处理）。

head/right_side_hair/main_lock/inner_thin_strands 内侧细发束：从主束靠大腿一侧分出的三缕细发，彼此间有黑色空隙。l0 = 沿大腿外缘的舌状细缕（x 362–382，y 724–797，上端发根叠在 main_mass 上，右缘被髋/大腿压住）；l1 = 斜向细缕（x 333–391，y 786–856，从手下方斜穿至尖梢 (391,856)）；l2 = 下段扇形短缕（x 393–414，y 900–936）。三缕叠在 main_mass 之上，发根按 2.2 拆分边界与主束重叠承接。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/inner_thin_strands 的大明暗与体积色面（4.2），位于基色之上、线稿笔触之下；光向为画面左上主光。舌状缕 l0 复测约 210（中值 #d8d6eb，与基色接近），3.2 记录的 s00 左侧背光在参考中不明显，保持基色平涂；扇形短缕 l2 为中间调，保持基色。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/inner_thin_strands 的过渡色与局部色（4.3），叠在 4.2 大明暗之上、线稿笔触之下。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/inner_thin_strands 的局部暗部细化（4.4），叠在 4.3 过渡色之上、线稿笔触之下；其他对象投影留给 4.5。
head_right_side_hair_main_lock_inner_thin_strands 4.6 高光与反光：参考中近白淡紫的受光发片与发丝窄边，随表面变化，裁切到本 part 轮廓；置于笔触线之下
head_right_side_hair_main_lock_inner_thin_strands 的画笔重绘笔触（3.5）。原曲线保留并隐藏：data-brush-status="source" 为已重绘的来源曲线，"hidden-guide" 为填色辅助边界、遮挡/隐藏定位线与明暗定位线（由色面接管，说明保留供后续处理）。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/curled_tip 外卷发梢：在 y≈915–938 从主束外（左）侧分出，向左下卷出、收成尖端（约 (350,950)）的独立发梢，叠在 main_mass 之上。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/curled_tip 的大明暗与体积色面（4.2），位于基色之上、线稿笔触之下；光向为画面左上主光。卷梢复测：发根环内约 196、卷钩外侧约 195，与基色 #babeda 的中间调一致，未见可单独铺的自身大明暗；按“平涂部位保持简洁”保持基色。tb00 发根暗部的投影成分（main_mass 遮蔽）留给 4.5。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/curled_tip 的过渡色与局部色（4.3），叠在 4.2 大明暗之上、线稿笔触之下。卷梢复测 (182–186, 186–188, 215–228)，与基色 #babeda 色相和纯度一致，无需补过渡色或局部色，保持平涂。
head/right_side_hair/main_lock/curled_tip 的局部暗部细化（4.4），叠在 4.3 过渡色之上、线稿笔触之下；其他对象投影留给 4.5。
head_right_side_hair_main_lock_curled_tip 的画笔重绘笔触（3.5）。原曲线保留并隐藏：data-brush-status="source" 为已重绘的来源曲线，"hidden-guide" 为填色辅助边界、遮挡/隐藏定位线与明暗定位线（由色面接管，说明保留供后续处理）。
head/right_side_hair/temple_strand 鬓角细发束：外轮廓、孔洞/开口与遮挡接界（3.1 外轮廓与接界）。填色按 guide 色块（含动作露出补齐的隐藏延伸）连续闭合；可见外缘对准参考图，隐藏段沿补齐范围。
鬓边细发束自身高光：随发束表面变化，保存在本 part。

g.data-brush-source: 源曲线笔触重绘（perfect-freehand 1.2.0）
g.data-line-color: 线色融合：取邻近色面（基色+体积+过渡+暗部+高光合成后，笔触两侧 4 px 内中位色）向同色系深蓝灰 #3a4260（参考发内接界线 #82888f–#9fa6bc、回折线 #959fbb） 混合；外轮廓 68%、分叉叠压线 s00 60%、接界压线 45%、回折线 s02 42%；沿笔触最多 8 段渐变，随受光/背光与跨越色区变化，粗细、起收笔、留白与不透明度渐隐保持不变

g.desc: head/right_side_hair/cheek_lock 贴颊发束：外轮廓、孔洞/开口与遮挡接界（3.1 外轮廓与接界）。填色按 guide 色块（含动作露出补齐的隐藏延伸）连续闭合；可见外缘对准参考图，隐藏段沿补齐范围。

g.data-brush-source: 源曲线笔触重绘（perfect-freehand 1.2.0）
g.data-line-color: 线色融合：取邻近色面（基色+体积+过渡+暗部+高光合成后，笔触两侧 4 px 内中位色）向同色系深蓝灰 #3a4260（参考发内接界线 #82888f–#9fa6bc、回折线 #959fbb） 混合；外轮廓 68%、分叉叠压线 s00 60%、接界压线 45%、回折线 s02 42%；沿笔触最多 8 段渐变，随受光/背光与跨越色区变化，粗细、起收笔、留白与不透明度渐隐保持不变

g.desc: head/right_side_hair/outer_lock 外侧长发束：外轮廓、孔洞/开口与遮挡接界（3.1 外轮廓与接界）。填色按 guide 色块（含动作露出补齐的隐藏延伸）连续闭合；可见外缘对准参考图，隐藏段沿补齐范围。
外侧长发束自身高光：随发束表面变化，保存在本 part。

g.data-brush-source: 源曲线笔触重绘（perfect-freehand 1.2.0）
g.data-line-color: 线色融合：取邻近色面（基色+体积+过渡+暗部+高光合成后，笔触两侧 4 px 内中位色）向同色系深蓝灰 #3a4260（参考发内接界线 #82888f–#9fa6bc、回折线 #959fbb） 混合；外轮廓 68%、分叉叠压线 s00 60%、接界压线 45%、回折线 s02 42%；沿笔触最多 8 段渐变，随受光/背光与跨越色区变化，粗细、起收笔、留白与不透明度渐隐保持不变

g.desc: 头顶发：中分后梳覆盖头顶，连接发髻底部与两侧侧发。填色为参考图可见范围加运动露出补齐的隐藏范围，闭合、evenodd。

g.data-volume-source: head_hair_cap_t00 t01 t02 t03 t04 t05 t06
g.desc: head/hair_cap 大明暗与体积：主光正面偏上，头顶球面中段受光保持基色 #ede7f0；外侧转面、发束间凹槽与发束末端内卷为背光面。两级色面：转面中间调 #e1dae9（明度降约 5%，色相向冷紫偏、纯度略升），暗部 #cdc5de（沿 t00–t06 暗区范围，冷紫加深）。边缘按参考的柔和过渡：中间调软边约 5 px，暗部软边约 2–3 px，裁切在 hair_cap 填色内。高光 t07–t09 留给高光步骤；发髻投影 t10、t11 属外来投影，留给 4.5。被发髻、侧发遮挡的范围保持基色平铺。

head/hair_cap 过渡色与局部色：①暗部外围 3 px 加过渡色 #d8d0e4（明度、纯度介于中间调 #e1dae9 与暗部 #cdc5de 之间，见 head_hair_cap_ct_mid_to_shadow，置于暗部下方），使发束凹槽的暗面柔和接入亮面；②额前发际与 face 相接处，参考图发色偏暖（约 R−B +5～+18），沿发际铺暖色 #efe3e2（略偏粉、透出肤色），软边约 3 px，仅在发际 10 px 内，图左发际最明显。中分处与额饰交界保持冷紫，不加暖色。

head/hair_cap 局部暗部：沿每条可见结构线 s 与细发丝线 d，在参考图较暗的一侧（采样线外 3–6 px 的亮度比较得出）铺贴线窄暗带，表现发束重叠的夹缝与凹槽；结构线处宽约 5.5 px、细发丝约 3 px，中段最宽、两端收为 0 渐隐，紧贴线侧较深、向外约 1 px 软边过渡，不画成硬线。暗色 #cfc6df，透明度按两侧亮度差在 0.45–0.85 之间，避免与大明暗暗部重复叠黑。两侧亮度差小于 1.5 的 s09、d05 不加。发髻、额饰投影留给 4.5。
head/hair_cap 高光：参考中刘海分缝两侧发束隆起处各两块柔和发光泽（图左约 (462,170)(474,181)，图右约 (548,170)(537,180)），色约 #f9f7f9，比基色亮约 10–14，边缘软。随发面一起变化，保存在 part 内。头顶近发髻处小亮点属发髻/饰物交界，未计入。

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke; 源曲线见 data-source-curve；线色：沿笔触按参考同处线色分 6 段渐变（取 2px 邻域内最深的非背景像素中位值，至少比邻近色面暗 22 亮度）
g.desc: head/hair_cap 重绘笔触：按各源曲线 desc 的粗细、起收笔、渐隐和留白生成闭合填色笔触；结构线与发丝线用 head_hair_cap 指引色块裁切；隐藏延伸、明暗范围线（t*）与定位线保留为 display=none 源路径，供露出与后续明暗处理。

贝壳冠底板 shell_plate（3.1 外轮廓与接界）：拱形扇板，外缘蓝紫描边、内为白边带与浅蓝扇面（内部分区留待 3.2）。可见：拱顶 (505.5,71.6)，拱形外缘 y≈71.6–101.6（两端止于两侧花瓣上缘），以及两花瓣内段下方、花簇两侧的浅蓝扇面 x≈476–494 / 517–535、y≈108–116.4；底缘停在 hair_cap 上缘接界 y≈115–116.4。填色闭合范围 x≈472–538.6、y≈71.6–116.4，下半两侧（x≈472–483、528–539，y 101.6–116）在两侧花瓣之下，作为花瓣摆动时的背衬。叠放（自后向前）：hair_cap → hair_bun_shadow_on_hair_cap → shell_plate → right_side_petal / left_side_petal → flower_cluster；参考中冠下端与花苞压在头顶发弧线上，hair_cap 填色已延伸到冠下 y≈101，故整组插在 hair_cap 及其发髻投影层之后。 groups.svg 补全的底部圆鼓（至 y≈129，位于 hair_cap 下）记为隐藏填色与 c02，不显影，避免盖住头顶发。

defs.desc: 4.7 线色融合：可见笔触改为邻近色面的同色系深色（贝壳/侧瓣为淡紫蓝，花簇为深蓝），沿光向左上浅、右下深渐变；保留 3.5 的粗细、起收笔与渐隐透明度。

g.desc: 角色右侧（图左）白色侧花瓣（3.1 外轮廓与接界）：外伸尖叶（尖端 (453.8,100.2)）+ 贴在冠板上的内段（y≈102.5–108，伸入花簇圆叶之下），两段间在 (472.0,101.6) 附近有折线（3.2 处理）。填色 x≈453.8–490.5、y≈100–117，由可见外缘 c00、下缘接 hair_cap 段 c01、内段下缘 c02 与被花簇圆叶压住的根部隐藏段 c04 闭合（nonzero 单块，无孔洞）。叠放：在 shell_plate 之前（压住冠板外缘下段与扇面），flower_cluster 之后（根部 x≈486–490.5 被圆叶遮住）；与 groups.svg 色块次序一致。下缘停在 hair_cap 接界（y≈116.3–117），伸入头顶发下方的余量（至 y≈120.6）只记为隐藏曲线 c03，不铺色，以免盖住 hair_cap。尖端按参考对齐，超出 groups.svg 父级色块约 3–4 px（父级补全时尖端被裁）。

defs.desc: 4.7 线色融合：可见笔触改为邻近色面的同色系深色（贝壳/侧瓣为淡紫蓝，花簇为深蓝），沿光向左上浅、右下深渐变；保留 3.5 的粗细、起收笔与渐隐透明度。

g.desc: 角色左侧（图右）白色侧花瓣（3.1 外轮廓与接界）：外伸尖叶（尖端 (557.2,100.2)）+ 贴在冠板上的内段（y≈102.5–108，伸入花簇圆叶之下），两段间在 (539.0,101.6) 附近有折线（3.2 处理）。填色 x≈520.5–557.2、y≈100–117，由可见外缘 c00、下缘接 hair_cap 段 c01、内段下缘 c02 与被花簇圆叶压住的根部隐藏段 c04 闭合（nonzero 单块，无孔洞）。叠放：在 shell_plate 之前（压住冠板外缘下段与扇面），flower_cluster 之后（根部 x≈520.5–525 被圆叶遮住）；与 groups.svg 色块次序一致。下缘停在 hair_cap 接界（y≈116.3–117），伸入头顶发下方的余量（至 y≈120.6）只记为隐藏曲线 c03，不铺色，以免盖住 hair_cap。尖端按参考对齐，超出 groups.svg 父级色块约 3–4 px（父级补全时尖端被裁）。

defs.desc: 4.7 线色融合：可见笔触改为邻近色面的同色系深色（贝壳/侧瓣为淡紫蓝，花簇为深蓝），沿光向左上浅、右下深渐变；保留 3.5 的粗细、起收笔与渐隐透明度。

g.desc: 中央花簇 flower_cluster（3.1 外轮廓与接界）：外缘包住中央蓝菱瓣（尖 ≈(505,89)）、两侧上瓣（x≈491–520，y≈93–100）、两侧圆叶（x≈485–526，y≈100–112）、下部白小瓣与中央白花苞，花苞尖至 (505.5,122.0) 压在 hair_cap 上缘之上。整体剪影由一条闭合外缘表示，内部各瓣分界留待 3.2。叠放：shell_crown 最前（shell_plate 与两侧花瓣之后，压住两花瓣内段根部）。groups.svg 补全的花苞柄（至 y≈128，hair_cap 下）只记隐藏曲线 c01。

defs.desc: 4.7 线色融合：可见笔触改为邻近色面的同色系深色（贝壳/侧瓣为淡紫蓝，花簇为深蓝），沿光向左上浅、右下深渐变；保留 3.5 的粗细、起收笔与渐隐透明度。

g.desc: 丝带：自菱形坠下方起，沿侧发外侧垂落，经图左上臂后方继续下垂；顶端补至坠框内 y≈181，y≈385–545 的右缘被手臂遮挡，y≈548 以下为父级补全的隐藏尾段（至 y≈648 圆头，被侧发斜向发丝与手臂共同遮挡）。填色闭合单一区域。叠放：绘制在 diamond_pendant 之前，坠框压住丝带顶端补齐段；图左手臂与侧发（后续绘制）压住上臂后段与隐藏尾段。
大明暗与体积层（4.2）：只画随本部件一起变形的自身明暗（受光面、背光面、转面、凹陷），主光来自左上方；其他对象投在本部件上的投影（t 系列中记为外来投影/接触闭塞者）留给 4.5，白亮边与高光斑最亮部分留给 4.6。所有色面以本部件填色裁切，软边用局部高斯模糊。
过渡色与局部色层（4.3）：在 4.2 大明暗之间补色相/纯度的渐变与局部色，不改大形体与明暗分区；投影留 4.5，高光反光留 4.6。 丝带自上而下：冷蓝 → 灰紫 → 淡紫，与左侧发饰丝带同一色彩走向。
局部暗部细化层（4.4）：只细化本部件自身的折痕、凹槽、接缝与结构夹角暗部（含同件内自叠压的闭塞），深浅低于或接近 4.2 暗面、不压黑；其他部件投影留 4.5，高光留 4.6。 可见段的折棱明暗已由 4.2 表达；手臂接触暗带与坠子投影留 4.5。
4.6 高光与反光：随部件表面变化的亮部，保存在本 part 内；主光左上，与已有暗部一致。

画笔重绘层（perfect-freehand 1.2.0，simulate_pressure=False，streamline=0，thinning 0.6，smoothstep 缓动；沿原曲线每 0.25 px 采样，按位置给显式压力）。线色暂用中性灰 #4a4a4a。外轮廓/接界不裁切；内部结构与细节线用本部件色块 clipPath 裁切。透明度变化用沿中线的灰度 mask，软边用 0.28 高斯模糊；留白处断笔。原曲线及 desc 保留，已由笔触接管的隐藏并标注 data-brush-note。
珠链：从火焰发簪图左火翼钩端垂下的细链、一颗多面晶珠（y 152–170）与一颗白珠（y 170–177）；上端补入钩端之后、下端补入菱形坠顶后，摆动时保持连接。填色闭合单一区域。叠放：绘制在 flame_hairpin 之前，图左火翼钩端压住链上端补齐段；菱形坠压住链下端。
大明暗与体积层（4.2）：只画随本部件一起变形的自身明暗（受光面、背光面、转面、凹陷），主光来自左上方；其他对象投在本部件上的投影（t 系列中记为外来投影/接触闭塞者）留给 4.5，白亮边与高光斑最亮部分留给 4.6。所有色面以本部件填色裁切，软边用局部高斯模糊。 丝绳、顶环与结扣细小，平涂保持简洁。
过渡色与局部色层（4.3）：在 4.2 大明暗之间补色相/纯度的渐变与局部色，不改大形体与明暗分区；投影留 4.5，高光反光留 4.6。 白珠、绳与结扣保持原色。
局部暗部细化层（4.4）：只细化本部件自身的折痕、凹槽、接缝与结构夹角暗部（含同件内自叠压的闭塞），深浅低于或接近 4.2 暗面、不压黑；其他部件投影留 4.5，高光留 4.6。 丝绳扭纹由笔触表达，不重复加暗。
4.6 高光与反光：随部件表面变化的亮部，保存在本 part 内；主光左上，与已有暗部一致。

画笔重绘层（perfect-freehand 1.2.0，simulate_pressure=False，streamline=0，thinning 0.6，smoothstep 缓动；沿原曲线每 0.25 px 采样，按位置给显式压力）。线色暂用中性灰 #4a4a4a。外轮廓/接界不裁切；内部结构与细节线用本部件色块 clipPath 裁切。透明度变化用沿中线的灰度 mask，软边用 0.28 高斯模糊；留白处断笔。原曲线及 desc 保留，已由笔触接管的隐藏并标注 data-brush-note。
火焰发簪：硬质整块雕件，高耸上卷火舌（含圆形宝石座）、向图左伸出的横向火翼与下卷钩端；根部条带沿发髻前缘伸入头顶发之后（x 424–477，y 118–157，父级已补全）。填色为参考可见外缘（含白色外缘光）加隐藏根部，闭合单一区域，无孔洞；钩端与上卷火舌之间的黑色空隙为外轮廓开口，不属本 part。
大明暗与体积层（4.2）：只画随本部件一起变形的自身明暗（受光面、背光面、转面、凹陷），主光来自左上方；其他对象投在本部件上的投影（t 系列中记为外来投影/接触闭塞者）留给 4.5，白亮边与高光斑最亮部分留给 4.6。所有色面以本部件填色裁切，软边用局部高斯模糊。 内凹火苗面 s01 已是独立暗面色块，簪根插发接触暗边 t06 属外来闭塞，均不在此层重复。
过渡色与局部色层（4.3）：在 4.2 大明暗之间补色相/纯度的渐变与局部色，不改大形体与明暗分区；投影留 4.5，高光反光留 4.6。 内凹火苗面与灵珠保持原色。
局部暗部细化层（4.4）：只细化本部件自身的折痕、凹槽、接缝与结构夹角暗部（含同件内自叠压的闭塞），深浅低于或接近 4.2 暗面、不压黑；其他部件投影留 4.5，高光留 4.6。 尾卷 s10 下方已由 4.2 下火舌暗带表达，不重复叠加；灵珠宝石保持原色。
4.6 高光与反光：随部件表面变化的亮部，保存在本 part 内；主光左上，与已有暗部一致。

画笔重绘层（perfect-freehand 1.2.0，simulate_pressure=False，streamline=0，thinning 0.6，smoothstep 缓动；沿原曲线每 0.25 px 采样，按位置给显式压力）。线色暂用中性灰 #4a4a4a。外轮廓/接界不裁切；内部结构与细节线用本部件色块 clipPath 裁切。透明度变化用沿中线的灰度 mask，软边用 0.28 高斯模糊；留白处断笔。原曲线及 desc 保留，已由笔触接管的隐藏并标注 data-brush-note。
菱形坠：白框菱形宝石（中心 x≈381，y 178.5–205，侧角 x 369–393）及其下方心形小坠标记（y 205–215），压在丝带顶端之上；两块分离填色，各自闭合。叠放：最后绘制，压在丝带顶端与链下端之上；顶角与珠链下端相接。
大明暗与体积层（4.2）：只画随本部件一起变形的自身明暗（受光面、背光面、转面、凹陷），主光来自左上方；其他对象投在本部件上的投影（t 系列中记为外来投影/接触闭塞者）留给 4.5，白亮边与高光斑最亮部分留给 4.6。所有色面以本部件填色裁切，软边用局部高斯模糊。 心形小挂饰平涂。
局部暗部细化层（4.4）：只细化本部件自身的折痕、凹槽、接缝与结构夹角暗部（含同件内自叠压的闭塞），深浅低于或接近 4.2 暗面、不压黑；其他部件投影留 4.5，高光留 4.6。 白框与宝石其余区域保持原状。
过渡色与局部色层（4.3）：在 4.2 大明暗之间补色相/纯度的渐变与局部色，不改大形体与明暗分区；投影留 4.5，高光反光留 4.6。 白框与心形挂饰保持原色。
4.6 高光与反光：随部件表面变化的亮部，保存在本 part 内；主光左上，与已有暗部一致。

画笔重绘层（perfect-freehand 1.2.0，simulate_pressure=False，streamline=0，thinning 0.6，smoothstep 缓动；沿原曲线每 0.25 px 采样，按位置给显式压力）。线色暂用中性灰 #4a4a4a。外轮廓/接界不裁切；内部结构与细节线用本部件色块 clipPath 裁切。透明度变化用沿中线的灰度 mask，软边用 0.28 高斯模糊；留白处断笔。原曲线及 desc 保留，已由笔触接管的隐藏并标注 data-brush-note。
丝带：自菱形坠下方起，经肩后、手臂后垂落，至尾端分叉；顶端补至坠框内 y179，肩后被手臂遮挡段为父级已补全的连续全宽。填色闭合单一区域。叠放：绘制在 diamond_pendant 之前，坠框压住丝带顶端补齐段；手臂（后续绘制）压住肩后段。
大明暗与体积层（4.2）：只画随本部件一起变形的自身明暗（受光面、背光面、转面、凹陷），主光来自左上方；其他对象投在本部件上的投影留给 4.5，高光与反光留给 4.6。所有色面以本部件填色裁切，软边用局部高斯模糊。
过渡色与局部色层（4.3）：在 4.2 大明暗之间补色相/纯度的渐变与局部色，不改大形体与明暗分区；投影留 4.5，高光反光留 4.6。 丝带自上而下：冷蓝 → 灰蓝 → 淡紫。
局部暗部细化层（4.4）：只细化本部件自身的折痕、凹槽、接缝与结构夹角暗部（含同件内自叠压的闭塞），深浅低于或接近 4.2 暗面、不压黑；其他部件投影留 4.5，高光留 4.6。 上段 s02 折棱暗带已由 4.2 中带表达，不重复叠加。
高光与反光层（4.6）：大光向左上；亮部随表面变化，保存在本部件内，按部件裁切；位于局部暗部之上、笔触之下。

画笔重绘层（perfect-freehand 1.2.0，simulate_pressure=False，streamline=0，thinning 0.6，smoothstep 缓动；沿原曲线每 0.25 px 采样，按位置给显式压力）。线色暂用中性灰 #4a4a4a。外轮廓/接界不裁切；内部结构与细节线用本部件色块 clipPath 裁切。透明度变化（淡入淡出）用沿中线的灰度 mask，软边用 0.28 高斯模糊；留白处断笔。原曲线及 desc 保留并隐藏，标注 data-brush-note。
珠链：从火焰钩端垂下的细链与两颗小晶珠；上端补入钩内、下端补入菱形坠顶后，摆动时保持连接。填色闭合单一区域。叠放：绘制在 flame_hairpin 之前，钩端压住链上端补齐段；菱形坠压住链下端。
大明暗与体积层（4.2）：只画随本部件一起变形的自身明暗（受光面、背光面、转面、凹陷），主光来自左上方；其他对象投在本部件上的投影留给 4.5，高光与反光留给 4.6。所有色面以本部件填色裁切，软边用局部高斯模糊。 绞绳与细颈平涂保持简洁。
过渡色与局部色层（4.3）：在 4.2 大明暗之间补色相/纯度的渐变与局部色，不改大形体与明暗分区；投影留 4.5，高光反光留 4.6。 白晶珠与绞绳保持原色。
局部暗部细化层（4.4）：只细化本部件自身的折痕、凹槽、接缝与结构夹角暗部（含同件内自叠压的闭塞），深浅低于或接近 4.2 暗面、不压黑；其他部件投影留 4.5，高光留 4.6。 链节扭纹由笔触表达，不重复加暗。
高光与反光层（4.6）：大光向左上；亮部随表面变化，保存在本部件内，按部件裁切；位于局部暗部之上、笔触之下。

画笔重绘层（perfect-freehand 1.2.0，simulate_pressure=False，streamline=0，thinning 0.6，smoothstep 缓动；沿原曲线每 0.25 px 采样，按位置给显式压力）。线色暂用中性灰 #4a4a4a。外轮廓/接界不裁切；内部结构与细节线用本部件色块 clipPath 裁切。透明度变化（淡入淡出）用沿中线的灰度 mask，软边用 0.28 高斯模糊；留白处断笔。原曲线及 desc 保留并隐藏，标注 data-brush-note。
火焰发簪：硬质整块雕件，上卷火舌、横向火翼、下卷尾与钩端；根部圆端插入头顶发后。填色为参考可见外缘（含白色外缘光）加父级已补全的隐藏根部，闭合单一区域。
大明暗与体积层（4.2）：只画随本部件一起变形的自身明暗（受光面、背光面、转面、凹陷），主光来自左上方；其他对象投在本部件上的投影留给 4.5，高光与反光留给 4.6。所有色面以本部件填色裁切，软边用局部高斯模糊。 内凹小火苗面 s01 与中火舌根暗缝 t05 不在此层重复。
过渡色与局部色层（4.3）：在 4.2 大明暗之间补色相/纯度的渐变与局部色，不改大形体与明暗分区；投影留 4.5，高光反光留 4.6。 内凹小火苗面与宝石保持原色。
局部暗部细化层（4.4）：只细化本部件自身的折痕、凹槽、接缝与结构夹角暗部（含同件内自叠压的闭塞），深浅低于或接近 4.2 暗面、不压黑；其他部件投影留 4.5，高光留 4.6。 灵珠宝石保持原色。
高光与反光层（4.6）：大光向左上；亮部随表面变化，保存在本部件内，按部件裁切；位于局部暗部之上、笔触之下。 灵珠宝石保持原色。

画笔重绘层（perfect-freehand 1.2.0，simulate_pressure=False，streamline=0，thinning 0.6，smoothstep 缓动；沿原曲线每 0.25 px 采样，按位置给显式压力）。线色暂用中性灰 #4a4a4a。外轮廓/接界不裁切；内部结构与细节线用本部件色块 clipPath 裁切。透明度变化（淡入淡出）用沿中线的灰度 mask，软边用 0.28 高斯模糊；留白处断笔。原曲线及 desc 保留并隐藏，标注 data-brush-note。
菱形坠：白框菱形宝石及其下方小水滴标记，压在丝带顶端之上；两块分离填色，各自闭合。叠放：最后绘制，压在丝带顶端与链下端之上；顶角与珠链下端相接。
大明暗与体积层（4.2）：只画随本部件一起变形的自身明暗（受光面、背光面、转面、凹陷），主光来自左上方；其他对象投在本部件上的投影留给 4.5，高光与反光留给 4.6。所有色面以本部件填色裁切，软边用局部高斯模糊。 心形小挂饰平涂。
过渡色与局部色层（4.3）：在 4.2 大明暗之间补色相/纯度的渐变与局部色，不改大形体与明暗分区；投影留 4.5，高光反光留 4.6。 白框与心形挂饰保持原色。
局部暗部细化层（4.4）：只细化本部件自身的折痕、凹槽、接缝与结构夹角暗部（含同件内自叠压的闭塞），深浅低于或接近 4.2 暗面、不压黑；其他部件投影留 4.5，高光留 4.6。 白框与宝石其余区域保持原状。
高光与反光层（4.6）：大光向左上；亮部随表面变化，保存在本部件内，按部件裁切；位于局部暗部之上、笔触之下。

body/chest 大明暗与体积：本 part 自身受光、背光、转面与凹陷色面（皮肤固有色 #f9e6dc 系，暗面略暖略饱和），随本 part 变形，按本 part 填色裁切；不含他物投影与高光。（4.5 疑问：颈部根部是否受下巴/颈部投影未能从参考确认——参考中下巴投影止于颈部，胸口颈根仅有轻微暗色，暂按本 part 明暗保留原画，未登记独立投影）
body/chest 过渡色与局部色：外缘暖粉边、明暗交界暖带、关节/折痕局部红晕，均为本 part 自身皮肤色变化，按本 part 填色裁切；不改变大明暗分区。
body/chest 局部暗部细化：折痕、凹窝、结构夹角等本 part 自身的小范围暗部，按本 part 填色裁切；他物投影留给 4.5。
body/chest 高光：左右肩头球面镜面光斑，沿 tone_shoulder_hl 闭合形填近白径向渐变，中心较实、1px 柔边，外加 3px 模糊的弱光晕；随 chest 变形（若肩头显示最终归 arms，光斑随所在表面迁移——待手臂拼合时复核）。锁骨上缘与胸骨受光已在体积层，不重复。皮肤无反光/透光

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh fill, closed (nonzero union of three pieces cut from the completed right_leg outline: visible thigh, hip joint cap and inner-thigh contact lens). Top: semicircular hip-joint cap (x 382-502, top y~698) hidden under pelvis/hips, which paints over it down to the hips bottom lobes (outer ~389,836 to crotch ~503,893); exposed only when the thigh rotates at the hip. Outer edge visible from under the hips lobe (~y 836) down to the knee, aligned to the reference silhouette. Inner edge visible from the crotch (503,880) to y~984 along the dark thigh gap; y 984-1058 is the contact zone with the left thigh, where the lens extends ~3 px past the midline (to x~509.4) under the left leg, exposed when the legs part. Bottom: shallow rounded joint end y~1078 (sides) to ~1096 (centre) across the knee, overlapping the shin top (y~1010-1034) by ~50-80 px for the knee bend; it is an internal skin seam with the shin, never stroked, soft blend. Base colour (part_base_colors): bare skin #f9e7de, one material and one inherent-colour zone over the whole fill incl. hidden overlap/contact/joint areas; sampled as the mid-tone median of the reference thigh (thigh ~#f9e7df, shin ~#f9e6dd), shared by thigh and shin so the knee overlap seam stays invisible, a hair under pelvis #f9e8df. Material: warm, soft, matte skin with low gloss; the knee blush (warm pink), rim warmth, highlight and shade bands are later shading/colour layers, not base-colour zones.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_thigh big light/dark (4.2): self-shading of the thigh form only, light from upper image-right/front. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; all layers soft-edged (Gaussian blur) and clipped to the thigh fill, painted over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: shade bands, then the lit front plane. No cast shadows (left for 4.5), no crease stripes (4.4) and no specular dot (4.6).

path.desc: Outer (image-left) turning shade: region between thigh_tone_outer_shade (continued by thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead) and the outer outline, extended past the outline and clipped. Narrow ~4px at the hip, widening to ~10-14px at the outer knee; colour #f8e1d8 at the top deepening to #f4d8cc at the knee (reference f9e2d9 at y 880, f4ded1 at y 1000). Blur 2.5 for the ~3px soft inner edge. Continues up under the pelvis so motion exposes the same band.

Inner (image-right) turning shade: region from thigh_tone_inner_shade to the inner outline, ~6-9px wide; #f7e0d7 at the crotch to #f4d7cd in the knee contact zone y 984-1061 (reference f7e3d6 to f5d8d0; deeper next to legs/left_leg as soft occlusion, kept part of the self shade). Blur 2.0.

Lit front plane: the closed thigh_tone_highlight_band loop filled #fbede5 (reference f9eae1-fbefe8 along x 455-467), blur 3.0 for the ~4-6px soft transition on both sides; its left edge follows thigh_struct_front_ridge. The tip fades out over y 960-976 through the gradient. Upper part runs on under the pelvis for motion.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_thigh transition and local colour (4.3), over the volume layer and under the brush strokes, clipped to the thigh fill. From the reference: the turning shade warms toward peach (b lower, f8e4d6) before the edge; a 1-3px pinkish light lies just inside the outer silhouette (fbe4e0) ahead of the warm rim line; the inner thigh is pinker near the crotch (f0d2cb); the knee carries a soft pink blush (f6ddd5 average). Big light/shade zones are unchanged.

path.desc: Warm peach transition (#f8e5d5, opacity 0.55, ~5px wide, blur 3) straddling the inner edge of the outer shade band (thigh_tone_outer_shade): shifts the soft turn from pink-grey toward the warmer yellow-peach of the reference (f8e4d5-f8e5d7 at y 900) without moving the band.

Pinkish edge light just inside the outer silhouette: the hidden outline stroked 5px (about 2.5px falls inside after clipping), #fbe2dc at 0.8, blur 1.0; matches the reference fbe4e0 between the warm rim line and the shade. Fades in under the pelvis.

Warm pink along the inner silhouette: the hidden inner outline stroked 7px, blur 2.0; strongest near the crotch (#f2cbc5), lighter mid-thigh, pinker again in the knee contact zone. Reference f0d2cb near y 880, f5d8d0 at the edge lower.

ellipse.desc: Local pink warmth at the top of the inner thigh under the crotch (centre ~497,878), radial fade, blur 3; continues under the pelvis for motion.

Upper part of the knee blush: the same radial field as shin_lc_knee_blush (centre ~474,1058, 38x50, shared gradient r2s8_legs_right_leg_lc_knee_blush), so colour matches exactly across the thigh/shin overlap. On the thigh only its faint upper fringe shows (opacity under ~0.15 around the specular at y~1015), keeping the knee top light. Blur 3.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_thigh local darks (4.4): only the upper start of the outer kneecap crease. Warm pink (reference eecbc5), soft, painted over volume and local colour and under the brush strokes, clipped to the thigh fill. No cast shadows (4.5).

path.desc: Upper start of the outer kneecap crease along thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead (446,1004)-(452,1028): warm pink #eec8c1 band ~5px, fading in from 0 at the top to 0.7 at (452,1028); then continues along the first part of shin_struct_knee_outer down to (461,1058) under the shin top with the same width, colour and opacity as shin_ls_knee_outer_crease, so the two match exactly at the shin fill edge (y~1034) and the knee bend reveals the same crease. Blur 1.5 (soft both sides).

Added in 4.7 review: upper start of the inner kneecap crease on the thigh, x 500.5-498.5, y 1016-1036. The reference crease begins here (#f1d2c8 at y 1022, #ecc7be at y 1028, #e9c1b7 at y 1034, all at x 498-499), above where the shin starts; the 4.4 stack only had it on the shin. Warm pink #ebc3bc band ~5px, opacity 0 at y 1012 rising to 0.7 at y 1035, blur 1.5. It runs on under the shin to y 1048 for movement room, and joins shin_ls_knee_inner_crease (whose top stop was raised to 0.45 for continuity).

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_thigh highlights (4.6): only the kneecap specular. Skin is matte, so there is a single small soft spot on the top of the patella, consistent with the light from upper front and with the front light band already in the volume layer (thigh_volume_front_light, unchanged). Reference: core #fcf3ed at ~(474-478, 1012-1022), around it #fbe9e1, then base skin #fae6dd. It moves and deforms with the thigh, so it stays in this part.

path.desc: Soft halo around the knee specular, ~14x25px, fading over ~5px into the base tone (reference #fbe9e1 ring).

Specular core following legs_right_leg_right_thigh_tone_knee_specular, shifted +1.5/+1px to the reference centre ~(475.5,1016). Near white #fdf4ef; 0.6px blur keeps the slightly firmer edge the reference shows on the upper half.

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh, outer (image-left) contour. Starts hidden under the pelvis/hips outer lobe at ~(384,812) (the hips paint over the first ~25 px, so no gap at the joint), runs down the outer thigh past the hair (hair lies behind the leg) to the knee at ~(437,1048) and ends at y~1078 where the shin outer contour takes over (overlap y~1036-1078; whichever part is on top shows its own line). Use: main silhouette line, final visible. Weight: medium ~1.2 px, slightly heavier on the outer thigh bulge (y 900-1000), tapering to thin at both ends; start hidden, end fades over the last ~15 px into the shin line. Hard edge on the black/hair side. Matches the outer edge of the thigh fill.

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh, inner (image-right) contour. Starts at the crotch under the hips bottom (~503,880), runs down the inner thigh along the dark thigh gap to ~(506,970) and continues straight along the contact with the left thigh to the knee (~506,1061). Use: inner silhouette line, final visible. Weight ~1.0 px, clear along the gap (y 880-984), lighter/shared in the contact zone y 984-1061 where it coincides with the left leg contour (one line only should read in the final; this one may fade or be covered by the left leg). Start hidden under hips, end fades into the shin inner line. The hidden contact lens edge (x~509) is not stroked.

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh. Front-plane turn of the thigh: starts ~(458,905) below the pelvis overlap, runs down the soft highlight ridge to ~(472,1000) just above the kneecap, where it hands over to the knee structure on right_shin. Use: separates the lit front plane (image-right side) from the slightly turned outer plane; drives the thigh highlight band. Final: not shown as a line, only as the soft edge of the highlight/shade. Weight 0.5, both ends fade, no solid stretch; very soft edge. Tone (3.3): runs along the left edge of legs_right_leg_right_thigh_tone_highlight_band; highlight on its image-right side, base skin on its left.

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh. Upper lead-in of the outer kneecap side: starts ~(446,1004) where the thigh tapers into the knee, ends ~(452,1028) at the right_shin top edge, connecting with legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_knee_outer. Use: outer edge of the patella above the shin cover. Final: soft pink-shade edge, faded start, continues seamlessly under the shin. Weight 0.6, thin start; soft edge. Tone (3.3): left of it is the outer knee shade (closed by thigh_tone_outer_shade and the outer outline); right of it is the lighter knee top.

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh. Closed loop around the long front highlight band of the thigh: left edge (433,842)->(441,902)->(463,962), right edge (450,840)->(472,900)->(471,960), meeting in a soft tip ~(468,976) above the knee. Upper part (y above 860) is under the pelvis; it continues the same band up to ~(433,789) so it stays correct if the pelvis or skirt moves. Source: the thigh's own front plane facing the light (self-shading, deforms with the thigh). Inside = highlight (brightest tone); outside = base skin. Edges soft, ~4-6px transition outward on both sides; the tip fades out over y 960-976. Its left edge near y 900-960 runs close to legs_right_leg_right_thigh_struct_front_ridge. Final: absorbed into shading (colour fill takes over); helper line not kept.

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh. Inner edge of the narrow shade band along the outer (image-left) silhouette: from (386,812) to (433,992), widening to the outer knee shade at ~(441,1004), where it meets legs_right_leg_right_thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead. The region between this line and legs_right_leg_right_thigh_line_outer is shade; it closes with that outline at both ends. Band ~3-5px at the top, ~8-12px at the knee (x 431-447 at y 1000). Source: the thigh turning away from the light (self-shading). Soft edge, gradient ~3px toward image-right. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh. Edge of the shade band along the inner (image-right) side: from (496,860) through (491,900) and (497,980) to (500,1032), joining legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_knee_inner below. The region from here to legs_right_leg_right_thigh_line_inner is shade (~6-9px wide), closed by that outline. Source: mainly the inner thigh turning from the light, deepened by contact/occlusion with legs/left_leg in y 984-1061 (an occlusion darkening from the neighbouring leg, not a hard cast shadow; uncertain). Cast-shadow step: the left-leg contact part (x 494-506, y 984-1061) is registered as independent layer right_leg_left_leg_contact_shadow (follow legs/left_leg); still drawn here for now. Doubt: how much of this band is self turn and how much is contact occlusion. Soft edge, ~3px gradient toward image-left. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh. Small closed spot for the specular highlight on top of the kneecap, centre ~(474,1015), ~4x13px. Source: the patella catching the light (self). Inside = highlight / specular (near white); outside = slightly lighter knee-top area that fades into the base tone over ~8px. Hard-ish edge on the upper half, softer below. Final: rendered as a highlight shape; helper line not kept.

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh. Warm skin rim: a thin pink-red line about 1px inside legs_right_leg_right_thigh_line_outer, from ~y 860 (below the pelvis overlap; continues up the same way if exposed) to ~y 1070 where right_shin covers the thigh. Purpose: the subsurface-like warm edge the reference shows along every skin silhouette. Final: kept as a colour line (#e07a7a-ish, lower opacity), not a dark line. Weight 0.6, fades in at the top and out at the bottom; soft inner edge, blends into the outer shade band (thigh_tone_outer_shade).

Part legs/right_leg/right_thigh. Warm skin rim along the inner side, ~1px inside legs_right_leg_right_thigh_line_inner, y 880-1034; it hands over to legs_right_leg_right_shin_detail_rim_inner. Purpose and final as thigh_detail_rim_outer: kept as a soft warm colour line. Slightly stronger in the contact zone with legs/left_leg (y 984-1034). Weight 0.6, thin ends; soft.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_thigh brush strokes: closed filled outlines generated from the source curves by their desc (weight, taper, fades, soft edges). Silhouette lines unclipped; structure and rim strokes clipped to the thigh fill. Source curves kept as display=none. Hidden helper or tone curves without a brush: thigh_struct_front_ridge (absorbed into shading, edge of the highlight band); all thigh_tone_* boundaries (colour fill takes over). Colours set in 4.7: silhouette lines #5c3533 (lighter #b07a77 in the contact zone with legs/left_leg), soft structure creases #d9a39c, rims #e2a29c.

path.desc: Brush for thigh_line_outer: perfect_freehand, explicit pressure, size 1.35, ~1.0-1.2px; heavier (pressure 1.0) on the outer thigh bulge y 900-1000, 0.75 elsewhere; taper start 20px (start hidden under hips), taper end 12px; opacity fades over the last ~15px (y 1063-1078) into the shin outline. Hard edge, no blur, not clipped (silhouette line straddles the fill edge). Colour (4.7): warm deep red-brown #5c3533 (reference silhouette: dark warm line with a pink fringe).

Brush for thigh_line_inner: size 1.15, ~1.0px clear along the thigh gap y 880-984 (pressure 0.85); in the shared contact zone y 984-1061 thinner (0.6) and opacity dropping to ~0.4, so the left leg line can read on top without doubling. Taper start 12px (hidden under hips), end 8px. Hard edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): warm deep red-brown #5c3533 from the skin family, matching the reference silhouette (dark warm line with a pink fringe against the background). In the shared contact zone with legs/left_leg the stops switch to the lighter #b07a77, as the reference contact line reads ~#b67e7b-#ca9592 there.

Brush for thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead: soft shade-edge stroke, size 1.0, pressure 0.3 to 0.8 downward; fades in from 0 over the first 40%; ends at full ~0.5 opacity at the shin top, where shin_struct_knee_outer_brush continues. Gaussian blur 0.5 (soft edge), clipped to the thigh fill. Colour (4.7): skin-family soft pink, segmented along the stroke (#e6b3ab start, #e0aaa2 at the heaviest middle, #e9bdb5-#f0d0c8 toward the lower end where the reference crease fades into the skin); at the existing opacity it lands ~#e8c2ba, like the reference soft creases (#ecc5bd-#efc7bd).

Brush for thigh_detail_rim_outer: warm rim colour line, size 0.75 (~0.6px), even pressure, taper 15px both ends, opacity fades in/out over 10% at each end, max 0.6; blur 0.3 soft edge; clipped to the thigh fill so it stays inside the outline. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e2a29c at the existing opacity, matching the reference pink skin edge (~#f0c6c6/#d5a8a6).

Brush for thigh_detail_rim_inner: as thigh_detail_rim_outer, slightly stronger (0.65) toward the contact zone y 984-1034; fades at both ends; blur 0.3; clipped to the thigh fill. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e2a29c at the existing opacity, matching the reference pink skin edge (~#f0c6c6/#d5a8a6).

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothstep easing); source curves kept hidden in this part (display=none), see data-source-curve; line colour set in 4.7 to same-hue darks of the adjacent colour fields (pearl lavender-blue for the chain and bead, glass blue for the crystal, pale cyan-white for the crystal ridge, sparkle and light streak); tone_* and turn/highlight/facet guide lines stay hidden for colour fields

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_shin fill, closed. Top: rounded joint end over the kneecap, y~1034 (sides) to ~1010 (centre), overlapping the thigh bottom for the knee bend (internal seam, never stroked). Outer and inner edges visible from the knee through calf and shin to the ankle, aligned with the reference silhouette; includes the lower end of the inner contact lens (y 1034-1058). Bottom: rounded joint end y~1394 (sides) to ~1404 (centre), hidden under the right_foot top (foot starts y~1354-1370), ~35 px overlap for ankle rotation; internal seam, not stroked. Base colour (part_base_colors): bare skin #f9e7de, one material and one inherent-colour zone over the whole fill incl. hidden overlap/contact/joint areas; sampled as the mid-tone median of the reference shin (thigh ~#f9e7df, shin ~#f9e6dd), shared by thigh and shin so the knee overlap seam stays invisible, a hair under pelvis #f9e8df. Material: warm, soft, matte skin with low gloss; the knee blush (warm pink), rim warmth, highlight and shade bands are later shading/colour layers, not base-colour zones.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_shin big light/dark (4.2): self-shading of knee, calf and shin, light from upper image-right/front. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; soft-edged, clipped to the shin fill, over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: side shade bands, concave mid shade under the kneecap, shallow ankle hollows, then the lit shin front. The warm crease stripes along the kneecap sides are left to 4.4, the knee specular to 4.6, cast shadows (anklet etc.) to 4.5.

path.desc: Outer calf turning shade: from the outer knee down shin_tone_outer_shade (with shin_struct_calf_turn as its softer inner fade, covered by the blur) to the ankle, extended past the outer outline and clipped. ~6px at the knee, 8-10px at the calf, ~4px above the ankle; #f4d8cc at the knee top y 1004-1036 (continuing the thigh outer knee shade over the overlap seam, bounded by the kneecap side line at x~452), narrowing and lightening to #f8e0d6 by y~1068, #f8e1d8 on the calf, #f6ddd3 near the ankle (reference f9e3d7 / f8e2d9). Blur 2.5.

Inner shin turning shade: from the knee contact line along shin_tone_inner_shade to the inner outline; ~8-10px below the knee, ~3px from y 1200 down; #f4d6cc at the knee contact, #f5dbd1-#f6ddd4 lower (reference f4dacf at y 1100, f9e4d8-eeccc1 at the edge lower). Blur 2.0.

Concave mid shade under the patella: the closed shin_tone_knee_lower_shade region filled #f5d8cf (reference f4d7ce-f6dbd2 at y 1070), one step below base. Top edge softened by the gradient (opacity 0 at y 1046, full by ~1060) plus blur 2.0; the bottom tip fades toward ~1094.

Shallow hollows beside both ankle bones: outer pocket (x 446-455, y 1351-1369, marked by shin_struct_ankle_bones) and the closed shin_tone_ankle_pockets inner pocket (x 478-484, y 1350-1369); shade #f6ddd3 (reference f6dbd2 / f4dcd2), blur 1.5. Lower parts continue under right_anklet.

Lit shin front: the closed shin_tone_highlight_streak loop filled #fbefe8 (reference fbefe7 at x 458-464, y 1100-1200); its right edge follows shin_struct_tibia_ridge. Blur 2.0 (~3px soft edge); fades in at the top under the kneecap and out over y 1215-1246.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_shin transition and local colour (4.3), over the volume layer and under the brush strokes, clipped to the shin fill. From the reference: pink knee blush around and below the kneecap, peach warmth in the calf turn, pinkish edge light inside the outer silhouette, warm pink along the inner edge, slight warmth at the ankle. Big light/shade zones unchanged; crease stripes stay for 4.4.

ellipse.desc: Knee blush (centre ~474,1058, shared gradient with thigh_lc_knee_blush): pink #f3d1ca, opacity ~0.4 at the centre over the lower kneecap shade, fading out by ~1105 and toward the sides; identical field on the thigh so the overlap has no seam. Reference knee average f6ddd5 against base f9e7de. Blur 3.

path.desc: Warm peach transition (#f8e5d5, 0.5, ~5px, blur 3) along the inner edge of the outer calf shade: keeps the calf turn warm and soft.

Pinkish edge light just inside the outer silhouette from the knee to the ankle (hidden outline stroked 5px, #fbe2dc 0.8, blur 1.0), turning pinker (#f8d8d2) at the ankle (reference f1c4c9-fbe4de at y 1360).
Warm pink along the inner shin edge: hidden inner outline stroked 7px, blur 2.0; pinker at the knee contact, lighter mid-shin, slightly pinker at the ankle.

ellipse.desc: Slight local warmth around the ankle (centre ~467,1366), #f5d6cf at 0.35, radial fade, blur 3; continues under the right anklet and foot.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_shin local darks (4.4): the warm pink crease stripes along both kneecap sides and the outer ankle-bone crease. Colours from the reference (crease eecbc5/eec7bd outer, ebc2bc inner), soft edges, fade-outs as described by the struct curves; over volume and local colour, under the brush strokes (the grey/neutral side strokes sit on top as the crease core), clipped to the shin fill. Inner ankle hollow stays as the volume pocket (no double darkening); the anklet shadow is left for 4.5.

path.desc: Outer kneecap crease stripe straddling shin_struct_knee_outer: #eec8c1, ~6px wide (x 452-463 over y 1030-1065), strongest 1035-1065 (0.8), fading out toward the patella bottom point by ~1092; joins thigh_ls_knee_outer_crease at 0.7 at the top. Blur 2.0, no hard edge.

Inner kneecap crease stripe straddling shin_struct_knee_inner: #ebc3bc (slightly deeper than the outer side, as in the reference), ~6px wide (x 486-499 over y 1035-1065), darkest 1040-1070, fading in from its start ~2px clear of the inner outline and out toward the patella bottom. Blur 2.0.

Small soft crease under the outer ankle bone along shin_struct_ankle_bones (444,1352)-(452,1364): #efcdc6, ~3px, max 0.6 mid, thin faded ends, blur 1.0; sits inside the outer ankle pocket shade without stacking to a dark spot.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin, outer (image-left) contour. Starts at the knee ~(437,1018), where the shin top joint end meets the outer edge, overlapping the end of the thigh outer line, follows the calf bulge (~423,1140) and shin down to the outer ankle bone (~443,1380), ending at y~1400 under the right_foot top where the foot contour continues. Use: main silhouette line, final visible. Weight ~1.2 px, fullest along the calf, thin at the knee start (fades in over ~15 px) and at the ankle; hard edge. Matches the outer edge of the shin fill.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin, inner (image-right) contour. Starts at ~(503,1032) on the shared knee-contact line (where the shin fill covers the thigh line), continues past the split at ~(505,1061) where the thighs part, runs down the inner calf and shin to the inner ankle (~490,1380), ending at y~1400 under the right_foot top. Use: inner silhouette line, final visible. Weight ~1.0 px, clear along the leg gap, thin start and end; hard edge. Matches the inner edge of the shin fill.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Outer (image-left) side of the kneecap: from ~(452,1028), joined to thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead, down along the grey/pink shading to the patella bottom point ~(475,1094), where it meets shin_struct_knee_inner. Use: patella/outer tendon plane turn; the shading on its left is the main knee shadow. Final: kept as a soft shade edge; slightly darker 1040-1065, tapers out toward the bottom point. Weight 0.8 mid, thin ends; soft edge. Closes with shin_struct_knee_inner as the bottom of the kneecap shade region. Tone (3.3): this is also a shade boundary. A darker crease stripe ~5-6px wide straddles the line over y 1030-1065 (x 452-463). To its right below y 1050 is the mid shade region legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_knee_lower_shade. Detail (3.4): the crease stripe here is a warm pink blush in the reference (same family as the rim lines), not grey. Keep the stripe colour warm.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Inner (image-right) side of the kneecap: starts ~(503,1033) near the inner contour (legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_inner) without touching it, curves down-left along the inner knee shade to the patella bottom ~(475,1094). Use: inner tendon / patella plane turn. Final: soft shade edge, darkest 1045-1070, fades at both ends; gap of ~2px kept from the inner silhouette. Weight 0.8 mid, thin ends; soft edge. Tone (3.3): this is also a shade boundary. A dark crease stripe straddles it over y 1035-1065 (x 486-499). To its left below y 1050 is legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_knee_lower_shade. Detail (3.4): the crease stripe here is a warm pink blush in the reference (same family as the rim lines), not grey. Keep the stripe colour warm.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Upper rim of the kneecap: faint arc from ~(452,1041) on shin_struct_knee_outer to ~(500,1038) on shin_struct_knee_inner, sagging to y~1047 at the middle. Use: top edge of the lower patella face; with the two side lines and the bottom point it encloses the lighter kneecap face (closed region 1041-1094). The specular dot near (474,1015) sits above it on the thigh/knee boundary. Final: barely visible, fade-only, no hard stroke. Weight 0.5; very soft. Tone (3.3) correction: in the reference the area enclosed below this arc is a mid shade (legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_knee_lower_shade), not a lighter face. The lighter area is above the arc around the specular dot. This arc is the soft top edge of that shade.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Shin bone (tibia) front ridge: starts under the patella bottom ~(472,1100), runs down the faint highlight stripe at x~467-462 to ~(452,1350) above the ankle bones. Use: divides the lit front of the shin from the inner calf plane; drives the vertical shin highlight. Final: not a drawn line, only the edge of the highlight; strongest 1120-1220, fades out from 1260 down. Weight 0.5; very soft edge. Tone (3.3): forms the right edge of legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_highlight_streak over y 1100-1240.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Outer calf plane turn: from ~(437,1060) just inside the outer contour below the knee, down to ~(448,1210) where the calf narrows. Use: separates the calf bulge (outer shade) from the front of the shin. Final: shade edge only, faded at both ends, no solid stretch. Weight 0.5; soft. Tone (3.3): soft inner fade of the outer calf shade bounded by legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_outer_shade.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Outer ankle bone (malleolus) underside: short curve from the outer contour bump ~(444,1352) inward to ~(452,1364), above the anklet chain. Mirrored inner bump on the contour at ~(487,1352) needs no separate line. Use: ankle bone volume; continues under right_anklet. Final: short soft crease, thin start and end. Weight 0.6; soft edge. Tone (3.3): marks the outer ankle shade pocket (x 450-454, y 1352-1368); its inner counterpart is legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_ankle_pockets.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Closed loop around the vertical shin highlight: from x 458-467 at y 1095 under the kneecap, down to a tip ~(464,1246). Its right edge follows legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_tibia_ridge (the shin bone front ridge). Source: the lit front of the shin (self, deforms with the shin). Inside = highlight; outside = base skin. Soft edges ~3px; the lower 1215-1246 fades out. A weaker continuation of the light down to ~(462,1340) is base tone; no extra line. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Inner edge of the shade band along the outer calf: (436,1080)->(441,1170)->(455,1335). The region from here to legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_outer is shade (~8-10px wide at the calf, ~4px above the ankle), closed by that outline at both ends. From y 1060 to 1210 it sits next to legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_calf_turn, which is the softer inner fade of the same shade. Source: the calf turning away from the light (self). Soft, ~3px gradient. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Edge of the shade band along the inner (image-right) shin: (494,1062)->(489,1100)->(492,1200)->(481,1340). The region from here to legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_inner is shade, ~8-10px below the knee, narrowing to ~3px from y 1200 down; closed by that outline. Source: the inner shin turning from the light, slightly deepened by the gap to legs/left_leg (occlusion, uncertain). Cast-shadow step: below y 1061 there is no confirmed cast shadow from the left leg; the anklet (legs/right_leg/right_anklet) and the swimsuit edge (pelvis/hips) show no visible cast shadow on the shin or thigh in the reference. Soft, ~2-3px gradient. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Closed region for the mid shadow below the patella (the lower kneecap face / patellar tendon dip): top edge along legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_knee_top (y~1047-1050), sides just inside legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_knee_outer and legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_knee_inner, bottom tip ~(475,1092). Source: concave form under the kneecap (self). Inside = mid shade (one step below base); the darker crease stripes run along the two side lines. Top edge soft (~4px vertical fade); sides firmer; bottom fades over ~5px. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Small closed shade pocket under the inner ankle bone, ~(478-484, 1350-1369), mirroring the outer pocket marked by legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_ankle_bones (outer shade x 450-454, y 1352-1368). Source: hollow beside the ankle bone (self). Inside = shade; soft edges ~2px. The lower part continues under right_anklet. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Warm skin rim ~1px inside legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_outer, from ~y 1022 at the outer knee to ~y 1395 at the ankle, ending under right_anklet / right_foot. Purpose: warm silhouette edge from the reference. Final: kept as a soft colour line, not a dark line. Weight 0.6; brightest along the calf (1080-1250), slightly broken/faded at the ankle-bone bump (1350-1365); soft inner edge into shin_tone_outer_shade.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Warm skin rim ~1px inside legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_inner, y 1034-1395, continuing from thigh_detail_rim_inner across the knee split (~y 1061). Final: kept as a soft warm colour line. Weight 0.6; thin ends, fades over the last 10px at the ankle; soft edge into shin_tone_inner_shade.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes outer contours and junctions (3.1) for the five direct parts. Stack: the whole group lies under legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body (toe roots tuck ~9 px under its toe_root_seam, as the foot_body desc states); inside the group the paint order is little_toe (bottom), fourth_toe, middle_toe, second_toe, big_toe (top), so each visible toe-gap line is the image-left side edge of the toe toward the big toe, and the toe toward the little toe continues as a hidden root lap under it. Gap lines re-measured on base-subject.png (dark minima of the gaps, about 0.5-1.5 px right of the straight approximations used for the guide blocks); the toe tips and the small notches where neighbouring tips meet are traced from base-subject.png (skin-to-background edge, set 0.7 px outward so the ink centre matches the foot_body contour handovers at (425.8,1463) and (494.6,1465)); there they sit up to ~2 px inside the guide block, which had smoothed over the notches (little toe tip ~2 px higher than the block). Between second_toe and big_toe the reference opens a hair-thin dark slit (y~1474-1490, under 1 px of skin gap); it is carried by the shared gap-4 line and its junction notch at ~(470.4,1490), not as a separate opening. The root seams and hidden laps keep the guide block top. The full-image line-reference.png is horizontally offset/stretched in this foot area (its toe-gap strokes sit ~3-10 px further image-right than the colour reference), so it is used for stroke character (where gap strokes start, line weight), and positions follow base-subject.png. Lines are thin position guides only (red = visible contour to be inked, blue dashed = internal seam / hidden edge, never inked); final ink, colour and widths come in later stages. Order: side-plane shades, ankle hollows (continuing the shin ankle pockets over the hidden ankle seam), then the lit instep. The foot in the reference is almost flat-lit, so all steps are small. legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body highlights (4.6), over local colour and local shading, under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill. Skin: one warm rim light on the outer side toward the toes (tone_outer_rim_light). The top-plane highlight is already carried by volume_instep_highlight (4.2, toned down by lc_forefoot_warm in 4.3) and gets no extra sheen: the reference skin is matte with no specular spot. tone_anklet_glow is not made an independent glow layer: the reference halo beside the pendant bead and crystal is only +3-4 levels (fbece1 vs fae6dd) and narrower than 2 px, i.e. the anti-aliased bright fringe of the beads/crystal themselves (right_anklet's own rendering), and the instep highlight already lightens that area; nothing follows the crystal on the skin.

legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body internal structure lines (3.2), thin position guides (#3a2a2a, 0.5-0.6 px). The line-reference has no inked interior lines on the foot body (only the toe-gap strokes, which belong to the toes group), so every line here is a structure/shade boundary for later shading and none is inked in the final; anklet and crystal drop lie over the upper instep.

legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body main light/dark ranges (3.3), simple hidden dashed guide loops in the shin convention. Light from upper image-right/front. Self shading: outer and inner ankle hollows, outer and inner side planes; lit instep top plane; outer rim light near the toes. External: a light halo from the right_anklet gem (rendering stack). The reference foot is very evenly lit (G 227-233), so all ranges are weak, soft-edged steps.

legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body details (3.4), shin convention (hidden detail colour lines). The line-reference has no interior lines on the foot body and the reference skin is smooth: only the two silhouette rims are needed. The faint mottling on the instep in a contrast-stretched crop is compression/soft shading, not tendons or texture, so no tendon or texture lines are drawn. Toe gaps belong to the toes group; anklet chain and crystal belong to right_anklet.

Soft: both malleolus shade edges and the two rims, clipped to the foot_body fill. Not stroked (hidden guides, kept with descs): fill boundary, ankle and toe-root seams, ankle crease, instep ridge, side turns, metatarsal arc, all tone loops. Final colours (4.7): outline #5c3533 continuous with the shin; malleolus edges warm pink #e0aaa2; outer rim pink at the ankle turning pale #fde9df toward the toes; inner rim warm #e2a69c.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_thigh big light/dark (4.2): self-shading of the thigh form only, light from the front/upper image-right, as on the right leg. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; all layers soft-edged (Gaussian blur) and clipped to the thigh fill, painted over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: shade bands, then the lit front plane. No cast shadows (left for 4.5), no warm crease stripes (4.4) and no specular dot (4.6). 4.5 check: the reference shows no foreign cast shadow on the thigh (skin under the bodysuit leg opening at y 800-900 stays flat, about #f9e6dc to #fbefe8), so no separate layer is registered. Open question: the darkening on the inner side towards the gap between the legs is still kept as self-shade in inner_shade; it is not certain whether it is really contact occlusion from the right leg.

legs/left_leg/left_thigh transition and local colour (4.3), over the volume layer and under the brush strokes, clipped to the thigh fill; same scheme as the right leg so both legs read as one skin. From the left-leg reference: the outer (image-right) turning shade warms toward peach (f8e5d7-f7e3d6 at y 980) before the edge; a 1-2px pinkish light lies just inside the outer silhouette (fbe6dc-fae0db) ahead of the warm rim line; the inner thigh is pinker near the crotch (crotch area average e4cac2, edge f5d5c7-f4d8cc at y 920); the knee carries a soft pink blush (f6dcd4 average). Big light/shade zones are unchanged.

legs/left_leg/left_thigh local darks (4.4): only the upper starts of the two kneecap creases (both sides have a thigh lead-in on this leg). Warm pink from the reference, soft, over volume and local colour and under the brush strokes, clipped to the thigh fill. No cast shadows (4.5).

legs/left_leg/left_thigh highlights (4.6): only the upper tail of the kneecap light. The reference lighter patch #fae8e1-#fbebe6 at x 535-539, y 1004-1011 sits just above the shin top edge (shin clip starts at y~1010), so this part carries it and it continues under the shin into legs_left_leg_left_shin_hl_knee_halo. Skin is matte: no specular core here; the thigh front band stays the volume front light (unchanged). Moves with the thigh, stays in this part, under the brush strokes.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_shin big light/dark (4.2): self-shading of knee, calf and shin, light from the front/upper image-right. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; soft-edged, clipped to the shin fill, over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: side shade bands, concave mid shade under the kneecap, shallow ankle hollows, then the lit shin front. The warm crease stripes along the kneecap sides are left to 4.4, the knee specular to 4.6, cast shadows (anklet etc.) to 4.5. 4.5 check: in the reference the shin directly above the anklet (y 1364-1382) stays flat at about #fae8dd, with no shadow cast by the anklet, so no separate layer is registered. If an anklet contact shadow is added later, use owner legs/left_leg/left_shin, follow legs/left_leg/left_anklet, clip_to legs/left_leg/left_shin (the anklet group has no drawn part yet).

legs/left_leg/left_shin transition and local colour (4.3), over the volume layer and under the brush strokes, clipped to the shin fill. From the reference: pink knee blush around and below the kneecap, peach warmth in the calf turn, pinkish edge light inside the outer silhouette, warm pink along the inner edge, slight warmth at the ankle. Big light/shade zones unchanged; crease stripes stay for 4.4.

legs/left_leg/left_shin local darks (4.4): the warm pink crease stripes along both kneecap sides and the outer ankle-bone crease. Colours from the reference (outer crease f1cfc7-edc9c1/eec8c0 at x 551-557 y 1030-1050; inner deeper e9beba-ebbfbb-eac1bc-ecc4bf along x 512-521 y 1030-1060), soft edges and fade-outs as described by the struct curves; over volume and local colour, under the brush strokes (the side strokes sit on top as the crease core), clipped to the shin fill. The mid shade between the creases is the 4.2 volume (not darkened again). The inner ankle hollow stays as the volume pocket (no double darkening); the anklet shadow is left for 4.5.

legs/left_leg/left_shin highlights (4.6): only the kneecap specular, on the rounded top cap of the shin (the shin covers the thigh here). Skin is matte, so there is a single small soft spot on the top of the patella, consistent with the light from upper front / image-right and with the front light band already in the volume layer (shin_volume_front_light, unchanged; the long thigh band and shin streak in the reference are no brighter than that layer, so no extra highlight there). Reference: core #fcf2ed at ~(534-538, 1013-1022), a lighter #faeae4-#fbebe5 area above it up to y~1004, then base skin #fae6dd. It moves and deforms with the shin, so it stays in this part, painted above volume/local colour/local shading and under the brush strokes.

Colours set in 4.7: silhouette lines #5c3533 (mauve #866478 against the light backdrop on the upper outer thigh, lighter #b07a77 on the contact seam with legs/right_leg), soft structure creases #e0aaa2-#f0d0c8, rims #e2a29c.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes outer contours and junctions (3.1) for the five direct parts, mirroring legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes. Stack: the whole group lies under legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body (toe roots tuck ~9 px under its toe_root_seam, as the foot_body desc states); inside the group the paint order is little_toe (bottom), fourth_toe, middle_toe, second_toe, big_toe (top), so each visible toe-gap line is the image-right side edge of the toe toward the big toe, and the toe toward the little toe continues as a hidden root lap under it. Gap lines follow the dark minima of the gaps on base-subject.png (the same centrelines used for the guide blocks); the toe tips and the notches where neighbouring tips meet are traced from base-subject.png (skin-to-background edge, set 0.6 px outward so the ink centre matches the foot_body contour handovers at (505.4,1461.6) and (573.8,1459.1)); the guide block had smoothed over the notches, so the traced tips sit up to ~2 px inside it there. Between big_toe and second_toe the reference opens a hair-thin dark slit (y~1474-1490, about 1 px of background); it is carried by the shared gap-1 line and its junction notch at ~(529.4,1489.7), not as a separate opening. The root seams and hidden laps keep the guide block top. line-reference.png agrees with the colour reference here within ~1 px and is used for stroke character (gap strokes start ~y 1462-1468 under the foot_body seam, line weight). Lines are thin position guides only (red = visible contour to be inked, blue dashed = internal seam / hidden edge, never inked); final ink, colour and widths come in later stages. No holes or openings in any toe; nails and toe pads are interior detail for later stages.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe: little (5th) toe, image-right edge toe. One closed fill plus its boundary curves (tip contour, side edges, root seam), which together trace the fill outline exactly. Guide: block-layers/groups.svg legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe (block0 visible strip, block1 root motion margin).

legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe large light/shade (4.2), checked against base-subject.png: light from the upper right/front. The toe top plane stays the lit base skin #f9e7de with no fill over it. The left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps (both sides of each gap read light, recorded in 3.3 as edge lights), so the only self shade carried by the toe form is the narrow tip rim where the top plane rolls under toward the sole, between legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_tip_turn and the tip contour. Not here: the gap-1 cleft (slit and its root above y 1474, contact occlusion from big_toe, rendering 4.5), the hidden-lap occlusion (4.5), edge lights / nail centre / pale tip (4.6), nail plate shading (later nail steps). Drawn over the skin fill and under the nail plate and brush lines. Local darks (4.4, checked against base-subject.png): no extra dark painted on this toe. At the junctions: at J4 (564.5,1480.1) the reference notch (x 564, y 1476-1479: G 176-75) is already matched or exceeded by the swelling gap and tip brushes (current 148-53), so a crevice dark would double the junction and make it too black. The reference shows no dark at the knuckle hinge, the nail fold or the toe root on this toe (rows above the nail stay G 228-232, current 231); the tip rim shade above stays the only turning dark, and the nail ring brush and nail local colour carry the nail edge. (Current values measured before the 4.7 gap-line recolour; after it the gap lines read pinkish brown and the junction notches stay at or below the reference, still no extra crevice dark needed.)

legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe highlights (4.6), checked against base-subject.png: matte skin and nail, light from the upper right/front, so only soft pale planes (#fdf1ed for skin, #fbe5e1 for nail), no glossy specular dots. Placed above the nail colours and below the brush lines. No reflected light under the tip (the tip rim stays pink-dark, 4.2). Nail centre stays its 4.3 local colour (reference G 195-215 at (568,1475), current 210), no tip pale crescent in the reference. All highlights move with the toe, so no separate rendering layer.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe internal structure lines (3.2), thin position guides. The nail is the only interior line inked in line-reference.png (a light grey-pink thin ring, much lighter than the skin contour); the knuckle hinge, side-plane turns and tip turn are structure / shade boundaries for later shading and are not inked. Positions measured on base-subject.png (pink nail ring / nail plate, pinker side bands along the gaps and sides, pinker rim along the tip). Mirrors the right-foot toes structure.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe light/shade ranges (3.3), thin dashed position loops only (display none, like the right-foot toes); colour and value are the next stage. Read from base-subject.png in the current rest pose: light from the upper right/front, the toe top plane is one even light value (#f9e6db-#fae7db, G 228-231), with no cast shadow from foot_body over the toe roots (y 1456-1462 is as light as the toe tops, so no root shadow loop) and no tone on the knuckle hinge. Unlike the mirrored right-foot draft, the left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps or the tip rim: the drawing puts a thin lighter edge on both sides of each gap ink line, so those bands are recorded as edge lights. Ranges here: left gap edge light (weak), hidden-lap cast shadow from fourth_toe, nail centre light (weak); no pale crescent (nail at the tip) and no outer rim light or side shade: the outer edge x 571-573 reads G 229-232 like the top plane, so foot_body_tone_outer_side_shade / outer_rim_light end at the toe-root seam.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe details (3.4): foot_body convention (silhouette rim as a thin warm colour line). The reference skin of the toes is smooth at this density (no wrinkles, knuckle creases, nail ridges or cuticle lines in base-subject.png); line-reference.png has only the outer contour, the gap lines and faint nail outlines (offset ~+2/+3 px like the rest of this area), all already drawn in 3.1/3.2. legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body outer contour and junctions (3.1). Mirror of right_foot/foot_body. Stack: above legs/left_leg/left_shin (the shin's lower end y~1400-1405 lies under this part), below left_anklet and above the toes group (toe roots tuck under this part ~9 px). Guide: block-layers/groups.svg same id. Lines here are thin position guides only (red = visible contour to be inked, blue dashed = internal seam / hidden edge, never inked); final ink, colour and widths come in later stages.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body big light/dark (4.2): self shading of the foot, frontal light treated as the mirror of the right foot (outer image-right side and both ankle hollows in shade), consistent with the left shin. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; soft-edged, clipped to the foot_body fill, over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: side-plane shades, ankle hollows (continuing the shin ankle pockets over the hidden ankle seam), then the lit instep. The foot in the reference is almost flat-lit, so all steps are small. The outer rim light and inner warm rim are left to 4.3/4.4 (detail rims), the left_anklet glow and any anklet occlusion to 4.5 / rendering stack.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body transition and local colour (4.3), over the volume layer and under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill and sharing the dome feather mask. From the reference: slight warm peach on the forefoot top plane, pinkish edge light at the outer ankle continuing the shin, warm pink-peach along the inner edge, a warm peach transition at the outer side-plane turn. Big light/shade zones unchanged; the rims stay as detail lines (4.4), the left_anklet glow for 4.5/rendering stack.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body local darks (4.4): the narrow warm creases where both ankle bones turn into the foot sides and a very faint ankle-front fold. Over volume and local colour, under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill and sharing the dome feather mask. Ankle hollows stay as the volume pockets (no double darkening); the metatarsal arc gets no shade because the reference shows no tone step there (G 229-231); the anklet / crystal drop shadows and the toe overlaps are left for 4.5.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body highlights (4.6), over local colour and local shading, under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill. Skin, matte: two faint warm rim lights just inside the contours (measured on the left-foot reference, not mirrored blindly). The top-plane highlight is already carried by volume_instep_highlight (4.2) and gets no extra sheen: no specular spot in the reference. tone_anklet_glow is not made an independent glow layer: next to the bead/crystal the skin brightening is only 1-2 px of anti-aliased fringe belonging to left_anklet's own rendering, and under the crystal the skin equals the base (f9e6dc); nothing follows the crystal on the skin.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body internal structure lines (3.2), thin position guides (#3a2a2a, 0.5-0.6 px), mirrored from right_foot/foot_body (contours of the two feet mirror within ~0.5 px about x=500, and the reference shading is mirrored too) and checked on base-subject.png. The line-reference has no inked interior lines on the foot body (only toe-gap strokes, which belong to the toes group), so every line here is a structure/shade boundary for later shading and none is inked in the final; anklet and crystal drop lie over the upper instep.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body main light/dark ranges (3.3), simple hidden dashed guide loops in the shin convention. Light from upper image-left/front (mirrored from the right foot). Self shading: outer and inner ankle hollows, outer and inner side planes; lit instep top plane; outer rim light near the toes. External: a light halo from the left_anklet gem (rendering stack). The reference foot is very evenly lit (G 225-233), so all ranges are weak, soft-edged steps.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body details (3.4), shin convention (hidden detail colour lines). The line-reference has no interior lines on the foot body and the reference skin is smooth: only the two silhouette rims are needed (mirroring the right foot; the outer rim here is a faint warm edge rather than a pale rim). Faint instep mottling in a contrast-stretched crop is compression/soft shading, not tendons or texture, so no tendon or texture lines are drawn; the hidden ankle area under the shin continues the same smooth skin. Toe gaps belong to the toes group; anklet chain and crystal belong to left_anklet.
