g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_shin big light/dark (4.2): self-shading of knee, calf and shin, light from upper image-right/front. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; soft-edged, clipped to the shin fill, over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: side shade bands, concave mid shade under the kneecap, shallow ankle hollows, then the lit shin front. The warm crease stripes along the kneecap sides are left to 4.4, the knee specular to 4.6, cast shadows (anklet etc.) to 4.5.

path.desc: Outer calf turning shade: from the outer knee down shin_tone_outer_shade (with shin_struct_calf_turn as its softer inner fade, covered by the blur) to the ankle, extended past the outer outline and clipped. ~6px at the knee, 8-10px at the calf, ~4px above the ankle; #f4d8cc at the knee top y 1004-1036 (continuing the thigh outer knee shade over the overlap seam, bounded by the kneecap side line at x~452), narrowing and lightening to #f8e0d6 by y~1068, #f8e1d8 on the calf, #f6ddd3 near the ankle (reference f9e3d7 / f8e2d9). Blur 2.5.

Inner shin turning shade: from the knee contact line along shin_tone_inner_shade to the inner outline; ~8-10px below the knee, ~3px from y 1200 down; #f4d6cc at the knee contact, #f5dbd1-#f6ddd4 lower (reference f4dacf at y 1100, f9e4d8-eeccc1 at the edge lower). Blur 2.0.

Concave mid shade under the patella: the closed shin_tone_knee_lower_shade region filled #f5d8cf (reference f4d7ce-f6dbd2 at y 1070), one step below base. Top edge softened by the gradient (opacity 0 at y 1046, full by ~1060) plus blur 2.0; the bottom tip fades toward ~1094.

Shallow hollows beside both ankle bones: outer pocket (x 446-455, y 1351-1369, marked by shin_struct_ankle_bones) and the closed shin_tone_ankle_pockets inner pocket (x 478-484, y 1350-1369); shade #f6ddd3 (reference f6dbd2 / f4dcd2), blur 1.5. Lower parts continue under right_anklet.

Lit shin front: the closed shin_tone_highlight_streak loop filled #fbefe8 (reference fbefe7 at x 458-464, y 1100-1200); its right edge follows shin_struct_tibia_ridge. Blur 2.0 (~3px soft edge); fades in at the top under the kneecap and out over y 1215-1246.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_shin transition and local colour (4.3), over the volume layer and under the brush strokes, clipped to the shin fill. From the reference: pink knee blush around and below the kneecap, peach warmth in the calf turn, pinkish edge light inside the outer silhouette, warm pink along the inner edge, slight warmth at the ankle. Big light/shade zones unchanged; crease stripes stay for 4.4.

ellipse.desc: Knee blush (centre ~474,1058, shared gradient with thigh_lc_knee_blush): pink #f3d1ca, opacity ~0.4 at the centre over the lower kneecap shade, fading out by ~1105 and toward the sides; identical field on the thigh so the overlap has no seam. Reference knee average f6ddd5 against base f9e7de. Blur 3.

path.desc: Warm peach transition (#f8e5d5, 0.5, ~5px, blur 3) along the inner edge of the outer calf shade: keeps the calf turn warm and soft.

Pinkish edge light just inside the outer silhouette from the knee to the ankle (hidden outline stroked 5px, #fbe2dc 0.8, blur 1.0), turning pinker (#f8d8d2) at the ankle (reference f1c4c9-fbe4de at y 1360).
Warm pink along the inner shin edge: hidden inner outline stroked 7px, blur 2.0; pinker at the knee contact, lighter mid-shin, slightly pinker at the ankle.

ellipse.desc: Slight local warmth around the ankle (centre ~467,1366), #f5d6cf at 0.35, radial fade, blur 3; continues under the right anklet and foot.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_shin local darks (4.4): the warm pink crease stripes along both kneecap sides and the outer ankle-bone crease. Colours from the reference (crease eecbc5/eec7bd outer, ebc2bc inner), soft edges, fade-outs as described by the struct curves; over volume and local colour, under the brush strokes (the grey/neutral side strokes sit on top as the crease core), clipped to the shin fill. Inner ankle hollow stays as the volume pocket (no double darkening); the anklet shadow is left for 4.5.

path.desc: Outer kneecap crease stripe straddling shin_struct_knee_outer: #eec8c1, ~6px wide (x 452-463 over y 1030-1065), strongest 1035-1065 (0.8), fading out toward the patella bottom point by ~1092; joins thigh_ls_knee_outer_crease at 0.7 at the top. Blur 2.0, no hard edge.

Inner kneecap crease stripe straddling shin_struct_knee_inner: #ebc3bc (slightly deeper than the outer side, as in the reference), ~6px wide (x 486-499 over y 1035-1065), darkest 1040-1070, fading in from its start ~2px clear of the inner outline and out toward the patella bottom. Blur 2.0.

Small soft crease under the outer ankle bone along shin_struct_ankle_bones (444,1352)-(452,1364): #efcdc6, ~3px, max 0.6 mid, thin faded ends, blur 1.0; sits inside the outer ankle pocket shade without stacking to a dark spot.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin, outer (image-left) contour. Starts at the knee ~(437,1018), where the shin top joint end meets the outer edge, overlapping the end of the thigh outer line, follows the calf bulge (~423,1140) and shin down to the outer ankle bone (~443,1380), ending at y~1400 under the right_foot top where the foot contour continues. Use: main silhouette line, final visible. Weight ~1.2 px, fullest along the calf, thin at the knee start (fades in over ~15 px) and at the ankle; hard edge. Matches the outer edge of the shin fill.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin, inner (image-right) contour. Starts at ~(503,1032) on the shared knee-contact line (where the shin fill covers the thigh line), continues past the split at ~(505,1061) where the thighs part, runs down the inner calf and shin to the inner ankle (~490,1380), ending at y~1400 under the right_foot top. Use: inner silhouette line, final visible. Weight ~1.0 px, clear along the leg gap, thin start and end; hard edge. Matches the inner edge of the shin fill.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Outer (image-left) side of the kneecap: from ~(452,1028), joined to thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead, down along the grey/pink shading to the patella bottom point ~(475,1094), where it meets shin_struct_knee_inner. Use: patella/outer tendon plane turn; the shading on its left is the main knee shadow. Final: kept as a soft shade edge; slightly darker 1040-1065, tapers out toward the bottom point. Weight 0.8 mid, thin ends; soft edge. Closes with shin_struct_knee_inner as the bottom of the kneecap shade region. Tone (3.3): this is also a shade boundary. A darker crease stripe ~5-6px wide straddles the line over y 1030-1065 (x 452-463). To its right below y 1050 is the mid shade region legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_knee_lower_shade. Detail (3.4): the crease stripe here is a warm pink blush in the reference (same family as the rim lines), not grey. Keep the stripe colour warm.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Inner (image-right) side of the kneecap: starts ~(503,1033) near the inner contour (legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_inner) without touching it, curves down-left along the inner knee shade to the patella bottom ~(475,1094). Use: inner tendon / patella plane turn. Final: soft shade edge, darkest 1045-1070, fades at both ends; gap of ~2px kept from the inner silhouette. Weight 0.8 mid, thin ends; soft edge. Tone (3.3): this is also a shade boundary. A dark crease stripe straddles it over y 1035-1065 (x 486-499). To its left below y 1050 is legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_knee_lower_shade. Detail (3.4): the crease stripe here is a warm pink blush in the reference (same family as the rim lines), not grey. Keep the stripe colour warm.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Upper rim of the kneecap: faint arc from ~(452,1041) on shin_struct_knee_outer to ~(500,1038) on shin_struct_knee_inner, sagging to y~1047 at the middle. Use: top edge of the lower patella face; with the two side lines and the bottom point it encloses the lighter kneecap face (closed region 1041-1094). The specular dot near (474,1015) sits above it on the thigh/knee boundary. Final: barely visible, fade-only, no hard stroke. Weight 0.5; very soft. Tone (3.3) correction: in the reference the area enclosed below this arc is a mid shade (legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_knee_lower_shade), not a lighter face. The lighter area is above the arc around the specular dot. This arc is the soft top edge of that shade.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Shin bone (tibia) front ridge: starts under the patella bottom ~(472,1100), runs down the faint highlight stripe at x~467-462 to ~(452,1350) above the ankle bones. Use: divides the lit front of the shin from the inner calf plane; drives the vertical shin highlight. Final: not a drawn line, only the edge of the highlight; strongest 1120-1220, fades out from 1260 down. Weight 0.5; very soft edge. Tone (3.3): forms the right edge of legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_highlight_streak over y 1100-1240.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Outer calf plane turn: from ~(437,1060) just inside the outer contour below the knee, down to ~(448,1210) where the calf narrows. Use: separates the calf bulge (outer shade) from the front of the shin. Final: shade edge only, faded at both ends, no solid stretch. Weight 0.5; soft. Tone (3.3): soft inner fade of the outer calf shade bounded by legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_outer_shade.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Outer ankle bone (malleolus) underside: short curve from the outer contour bump ~(444,1352) inward to ~(452,1364), above the anklet chain. Mirrored inner bump on the contour at ~(487,1352) needs no separate line. Use: ankle bone volume; continues under right_anklet. Final: short soft crease, thin start and end. Weight 0.6; soft edge. Tone (3.3): marks the outer ankle shade pocket (x 450-454, y 1352-1368); its inner counterpart is legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_ankle_pockets.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Closed loop around the vertical shin highlight: from x 458-467 at y 1095 under the kneecap, down to a tip ~(464,1246). Its right edge follows legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_tibia_ridge (the shin bone front ridge). Source: the lit front of the shin (self, deforms with the shin). Inside = highlight; outside = base skin. Soft edges ~3px; the lower 1215-1246 fades out. A weaker continuation of the light down to ~(462,1340) is base tone; no extra line. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Inner edge of the shade band along the outer calf: (436,1080)->(441,1170)->(455,1335). The region from here to legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_outer is shade (~8-10px wide at the calf, ~4px above the ankle), closed by that outline at both ends. From y 1060 to 1210 it sits next to legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_calf_turn, which is the softer inner fade of the same shade. Source: the calf turning away from the light (self). Soft, ~3px gradient. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Edge of the shade band along the inner (image-right) shin: (494,1062)->(489,1100)->(492,1200)->(481,1340). The region from here to legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_inner is shade, ~8-10px below the knee, narrowing to ~3px from y 1200 down; closed by that outline. Source: the inner shin turning from the light, slightly deepened by the gap to legs/left_leg (occlusion, uncertain). Cast-shadow step: below y 1061 there is no confirmed cast shadow from the left leg; the anklet (legs/right_leg/right_anklet) and the swimsuit edge (pelvis/hips) show no visible cast shadow on the shin or thigh in the reference. Soft, ~2-3px gradient. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Closed region for the mid shadow below the patella (the lower kneecap face / patellar tendon dip): top edge along legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_knee_top (y~1047-1050), sides just inside legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_knee_outer and legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_knee_inner, bottom tip ~(475,1092). Source: concave form under the kneecap (self). Inside = mid shade (one step below base); the darker crease stripes run along the two side lines. Top edge soft (~4px vertical fade); sides firmer; bottom fades over ~5px. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Small closed shade pocket under the inner ankle bone, ~(478-484, 1350-1369), mirroring the outer pocket marked by legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_ankle_bones (outer shade x 450-454, y 1352-1368). Source: hollow beside the ankle bone (self). Inside = shade; soft edges ~2px. The lower part continues under right_anklet. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Warm skin rim ~1px inside legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_outer, from ~y 1022 at the outer knee to ~y 1395 at the ankle, ending under right_anklet / right_foot. Purpose: warm silhouette edge from the reference. Final: kept as a soft colour line, not a dark line. Weight 0.6; brightest along the calf (1080-1250), slightly broken/faded at the ankle-bone bump (1350-1365); soft inner edge into shin_tone_outer_shade.

Part legs/right_leg/right_shin. Warm skin rim ~1px inside legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_inner, y 1034-1395, continuing from thigh_detail_rim_inner across the knee split (~y 1061). Final: kept as a soft warm colour line. Weight 0.6; thin ends, fades over the last 10px at the ankle; soft edge into shin_tone_inner_shade.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothstep easing); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_shin brush strokes: closed filled outlines generated from the source curves by their desc (weight, taper, fades, soft edges). Silhouette lines unclipped; structure and rim strokes clipped to the shin fill. Source curves kept as display=none. Hidden helper or tone curves without a brush: shin_struct_knee_top, shin_struct_tibia_ridge, shin_struct_calf_turn (absorbed into shading); all shin_tone_* boundaries (colour fill takes over). Colours set in 4.7: silhouette lines #5c3533 (lighter #b07a77 in the contact zone with legs/left_leg), soft structure creases #d9a39c, rims #e2a29c.

path.desc: Brush for shin_line_outer: size 1.35; fullest (pressure 1.0, ~1.3px) along the calf y 1080-1260, 0.7 at the knee and ankle; fades in over the first ~15px at the knee (opacity 0 to 1, over the thigh line), taper start 15px, end 10px under right_foot. Hard edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): warm deep red-brown #5c3533 from the skin family, matching the reference silhouette (dark warm line with a pink fringe against the background).

Brush for shin_line_inner: size 1.15 (~1.0px). Starts thinner and at ~0.4 opacity in the shared contact y 1032-1061, then full along the leg gap to the ankle; taper 10px both ends (end under right_foot). Hard edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): warm deep red-brown #5c3533 from the skin family, matching the reference silhouette (dark warm line with a pink fringe against the background). In the shared contact zone with legs/left_leg the stops switch to the lighter #b07a77, as the reference contact line reads ~#b67e7b-#ca9592 there.

Brush for shin_struct_knee_outer, outer kneecap side: mid stroke size 1.1, pressure sin profile (thin ends, heaviest y 1040-1065), opacity 0.55 with ends fading to 0.2. Gaussian blur 0.6 (soft shade edge, kept in the final as the edge of the crease). Not clipped: the stroke lies inside the leg, and the top edge of the shin fill (y~1033-1040) would cut its start; it continues thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead over that edge. Colour (4.7): skin-family soft pink, segmented along the stroke (#e6b3ab start, #e0aaa2 at the heaviest middle, #e9bdb5-#f0d0c8 toward the lower end where the reference crease fades into the skin); at the existing opacity it lands ~#e8c2ba, like the reference soft creases (#ecc5bd-#efc7bd).

Brush for shin_struct_knee_inner, inner kneecap side: same treatment, heaviest y 1045-1070; the start stays ~2px clear of the inner outline. Gaussian blur 0.6 (soft shade edge, kept in the final as the edge of the crease). Not clipped: the stroke lies inside the leg, and the top edge of the shin fill (y~1033-1040) would cut its start; it continues thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead over that edge. Colour (4.7): skin-family soft pink, segmented along the stroke (#e6b3ab start, #e0aaa2 at the heaviest middle, #e9bdb5-#f0d0c8 toward the lower end where the reference crease fades into the skin); at the existing opacity it lands ~#e8c2ba, like the reference soft creases (#ecc5bd-#efc7bd).

Brush for shin_struct_ankle_bones: short soft crease, size 0.8, thin start and end (sin pressure), opacity max 0.45 mid; blur 0.4; clipped to the shin fill. Colour (4.7): skin-family soft pink, segmented along the stroke (#e6b3ab start, #e0aaa2 at the heaviest middle, #e9bdb5-#f0d0c8 toward the lower end where the reference crease fades into the skin); at the existing opacity it lands ~#e8c2ba, like the reference soft creases (#ecc5bd-#efc7bd).

Brush for shin_detail_rim_outer: warm rim, size 0.75, thinner over the ankle-bone bump y 1350-1365 (pressure 0.45), fades at both ends; blur 0.3; clipped to the shin fill. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e2a29c at the existing opacity, matching the reference pink skin edge (~#f0c6c6/#d5a8a6).

Brush for shin_detail_rim_inner: warm rim, size 0.75, fades in at the knee contact and out over the last ~10px at the ankle; blur 0.3; clipped to the shin fill. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e2a29c at the existing opacity, matching the reference pink skin edge (~#f0c6c6/#d5a8a6).

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes outer contours and junctions (3.1) for the five direct parts. Stack: the whole group lies under legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body (toe roots tuck ~9 px under its toe_root_seam, as the foot_body desc states); inside the group the paint order is little_toe (bottom), fourth_toe, middle_toe, second_toe, big_toe (top), so each visible toe-gap line is the image-left side edge of the toe toward the big toe, and the toe toward the little toe continues as a hidden root lap under it. Gap lines re-measured on base-subject.png (dark minima of the gaps, about 0.5-1.5 px right of the straight approximations used for the guide blocks); the toe tips and the small notches where neighbouring tips meet are traced from base-subject.png (skin-to-background edge, set 0.7 px outward so the ink centre matches the foot_body contour handovers at (425.8,1463) and (494.6,1465)); there they sit up to ~2 px inside the guide block, which had smoothed over the notches (little toe tip ~2 px higher than the block). Between second_toe and big_toe the reference opens a hair-thin dark slit (y~1474-1490, under 1 px of skin gap); it is carried by the shared gap-4 line and its junction notch at ~(470.4,1490), not as a separate opening. The root seams and hidden laps keep the guide block top. The full-image line-reference.png is horizontally offset/stretched in this foot area (its toe-gap strokes sit ~3-10 px further image-right than the colour reference), so it is used for stroke character (where gap strokes start, line weight), and positions follow base-subject.png. Lines are thin position guides only (red = visible contour to be inked, blue dashed = internal seam / hidden edge, never inked); final ink, colour and widths come in later stages. No holes or openings in any toe; nails and toe pads are interior detail for later stages.

legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe: little (5th) toe, image-left edge toe. One closed fill plus its boundary curves (tip contour, side edges, root seam), which together trace the fill outline exactly. Guide: block-layers/groups.svg legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe (block0 visible strip, block1 root motion margin).

path.desc: Fill region of little_toe, base skin #f9e7de (same as foot_body), one continuous closed area without holes: root seam under foot_body from (442.8,1451.3) along the toes-group top to (425.8,1463.0), outer (image-left) side and rounded tip down to the gap-1 junction (435.9,1482.7), then up the hidden right side (gap 1 + root lap, up to ~3.5 px image-right of the visible gap at y~1450, 1 px at y 1468, 0 by y 1472) back to the start. Expected reveal: the root lap (under foot_body and under the neighbouring toe) shows only when the toes spread, curl or the foot flexes; it is the same toe skin and later shading should simply continue the visible root tone into it. Base colour (4.1, checked against base-subject.png): toe skin #f9e7de confirmed (reference toe skin averages #f9e6dc-#fae6de); the nail plate is a separate pink nail material drawn as legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_nail_base above this fill.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe large light/shade (4.2), checked against base-subject.png: light from the upper right/front; the toe top plane stays the lit base skin #f9e7de (no fill over it), the form is carried by its own turning planes: tip rim shade. Not here: the occlusion/cast band from the overlapping neighbour toe along the right gap (right_gap_occlusion_shade, rendering 4.5), pale tip / nail centre / rim lights (4.6), nail plate shading (4.3/4.4). Shades sit over the skin fill and under the nail plate and brush lines.

path.desc: 4.2 tip rim self shade of little_toe, filled along legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_tip_rim_shade: the tip surface rolling under toward the sole: reference #f2cfc9-#eec4c1 along the lower curve (#ecc0ba at 0.8, reads ~#efc8c2), warmer/pinker than the side shade so the round tip reads as a volume. Edge: hard against the tip contour (fill clip), blur 0.6 softens the ~1 px inner edge. Clipped (via the group) to legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_fill, so it never leaves the toe; continues up the hidden root lap where the loop does.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe transition / local colour on the skin (4.3), checked against base-subject.png: the toe skin warms slightly toward the tip pad (the tips read a touch pinker, #f6d6cf-#f3d2cd, than the cool-pale root band #fae8e0 under foot_body) and the pink tip-rim shade (4.2) meets the lit top plane through this warm band instead of a step. The root, gap shading and nail stay as they are; no hard edge is added.

circle.desc: Warm tip blush of little_toe: radial gradient #f6d6cf, opacity 0.55 at (434.0,1479.2) easing to 0 at r 6 px; centred above the lowest tip point (435.9,1482.7), so it overlaps the inner soft edge of the tip-rim shade and fades out before mid-toe. Clipped to legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_fill; drawn over the volume shades, under the nail plate. Local skin colour, moves with the toe.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe local dark refinement (4.4), checked against base-subject.png: the only small structural darks on the toe itself are the crevice corners where it meets the neighbouring toe tip at the gap junction(s). The knuckle hinge, nail fold and toe top carry no dark in this pose (reference rows above the nails stay #fae8e0). Cast/occlusion from the overlapping neighbour toe (right_gap_occlusion_shade, the black second/big slit) is left to 4.5. Kept light and soft so it does not double the 4.2 shades.

circle.desc: Crevice dark of little_toe at the gap-1 junction (435.9,1482.7) with fourth_toe: where the gap side and the rolled-under tip meet, the skin folds into the deepest corner of the toe. Reference: in the last ~3 px above each junction the skin beside the gap line drops to #e9c0bf-#c39798 and the gap widens into a dark notch. Radial gradient #d4a09d 0.75 at the junction (focus 0.4 px above it) easing to 0 at r 3.2 px, clipped to legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_fill so only this toe's side of the corner is darkened; soft, no line; it deepens the ends of the 4.2 gap-side / tip-rim shades without a second band.

path.desc: Nail plate base colour of little_toe: #f1cbc6, pink nail material distinct from the toe skin #f9e7de (reference small nails read as a pink ring ~#f0c9c4 around a lighter centre). Closed area = little_toe_struct_nail, clipped to the little_toe fill; the lighter centre stays for the nail centre light tone (3.3 boundary little_toe_tone_nail_center_light), not base colour. Nail outline is the existing brush stroke above.

Local colour of the little_toe nail plate (4.3): the reference small nail is a pink rim (#f0c9c4) around a paler centre (#f8dbd5-#fae1db), so the centre oval (from legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_nail_center_light) is filled #f8ddd7 at 0.85 over the nail_base with a 0.6 blur, leaving a soft pink ring. Colour variation of the nail material; no specular highlight (that stays for 4.6).

little_toe visible contour (red). Visible outer contour of the little toe: starts at (425.8,1463.0), the handover point where foot_body_outer_contour ends, so the foot outer edge and this line read as one stroke; runs down the slightly convex outer side (x~425.7-426.2, y 1463-1472), turns round the toe tip (lowest ~y 1481.5) and curls up into the small notch and ends at (435.9,1482.7) where it meets the bottom of the gap-1 line (fourth_toe left edge). Weight: ~2 px skin line at full strength from the start, fullest round the tip (2-2.2 px), easing to ~1.5 px into the gap junction; hard edge throughout, no fade-out (the reference outline is continuous here). Bounds the lower edge of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_fill.

little_toe image-right side, hidden (blue dashed): from (442.8,1451.3) at the toes-group top down to (435.9,1482.7) at the gap-1 junction. Lies under fourth_toe (gap 1 line plus a root lap ~3.5 px wide at y~1450, 1 px at y 1468, closing to 0 by y~1472), so it is never inked and stays a soft, colour-matched fill edge; the visible gap line here is fourth_toe_left_gap_contour. Bounds the right edge of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_fill. Expected reveal: a 1-3 px strip of this toe's side shows beside the gap line only when the toes spread apart.

little_toe root edge, hidden (blue dashed): top of the toe from (442.8,1451.3) to (425.8,1463.0) and down the parent edge under the foot outer contour to (425.8,1463), about 6-10 px above foot_body_toe_root_seam, all under foot_body. Internal joint lap for toe flexion, never inked, soft colour-matched edge. Closes legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_fill along the top. Expected reveal: none in the rest pose; toe curl or spread keeps it under the foot.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe internal structure lines (3.2), thin position guides. The nail is the only interior line inked in line-reference.png (a light grey-pink thin ring, much lighter than the skin contour); the knuckle hinge, side-plane turns and tip turn are structure / shade boundaries for later shading and are not inked. Positions measured on base-subject.png (pink nail ring / nail plate, pinker side bands along the gaps, pinker rim along the tip).

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. little toe nail: small closed oval centred (432.0,1476.0), ~5.4 x 6.4 px, long axis tilted 10 deg to follow the toe axis (toes lean toward image-left at the tip). Reference: pink ring with paler centre (base-subject.png), light grey ring in line-reference.png. Island inside the toe top plane, its lower edge ~1.5-2 px above the tip contour; connects to nothing. Use: nail border; final shows as a thin light ring (~0.5-0.7 px, warm grey-pink, clearly lighter than the gap lines), slightly firmer on the upper arc and the two sides, thinning and nearly breaking for ~1.5 px at the lower arc where the paler tip crescent begins. Hard but light edge. Fill: closes the nail region for later local colour (pinkish ring, paler centre). Expected reveal: none. Tone (3.3): the lower arc closes legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_tip_pale_highlight below it; the nail region itself is a local-colour zone (pink), not a shade.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Proximal interphalangeal joint hinge: very shallow upward-bowed arc across the toe at y~1468.0 from (427.8,1468.3) near the left side to (436.6,1468.3) near the right side, ending ~0.8-1.2 px short of both side edges, about halfway between the foot_body toe-root seam and the nail top. Use: bend axis for toe curl / flex (the segment below it rotates); the reference shows no crease or knuckle mark here in the rest pose, so final: no ink, no visible tone, at most a hair of shading if the toe curls. Soft, both ends fade. Not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: when the toes curl a soft crease forms along this line and the knuckle top above it catches light.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Right side-plane turn: runs 1.8 px inside (image-left of) the gap-1 line from (435.9,1465.5) down to (434.8,1474.5) beside the nail, fading into the tip turn. The band between it and the gap line is this toe's side rolling under fourth_toe (reference: pinker shade band along the gap). Continues as the same side plane over the hidden root lap (under fourth_toe) if the toes spread. Use: top-plane / side-plane boundary for shading; final: no ink, soft tone break only (~1.5 px gradient toward the side), fades in at its upper end over ~2 px and fades out into the tip turn. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): soft limit of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_right_gap_occlusion_shade (occlusion shade between it and the gap line, top-plane light beyond).

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Outer side-plane turn of the little toe: ~1.9 px inside the outer contour from (427.9,1464.0), just under the foot_body outer contour handover, to (428.8,1474.5) where it curves into the tip turn. Continues the foot_body outer side plane (foot_body_struct_outer_side_turn ends at (435.8,1458.5) above the 4th/5th toe roots; on the little toe the side band narrows to ~2 px). Band to the left of it is the outer side shade (reference pinker band x 427-429, y 1464-1476). Use: top-plane / side-plane boundary for shading; final: no ink, soft tone break only (~1.5 px gradient toward the side), fades in at its upper end over ~2 px and fades out into the tip turn. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): inner limit of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_outer_rim_light (rim light between it and the outer contour).

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Tip turn: where the top plane rolls over the rounded toe tip toward the underside, ~2 px inside the tip contour, from (428.6,1473.8) to (435.4,1478.9), passing just under the nail. Joins the lower ends of the side-plane turns (outer side here). The strip between this line and the tip contour is the pinker rim of the tip in the reference (1-2 px, #f2cfc9-#eec4c1), and above it, under the nail, the pale tip crescent (paler skin just below the nail). Use: shade boundary for the tip rim / pale crescent; final: no ink, soft tone break; fades out at both ends into the gap-junction notches. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: none beyond the visible tip. Tone (3.3): shared inner edge of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_tip_rim_shade (rim shade below/outside it); above it the pale tip highlight sits under the nail.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe light/shade ranges (3.3), thin dashed position loops only; colour and value are the next stage. Read from base-subject.png in the current rest pose: light from the upper right/front, the toe top plane is one even light value (~#fae8e0), so the only shade ranges are the narrow occlusion bands along the toe gaps, the rolled-under rim of the tip, the side plane at the outer/inner edge of the foot, and the light ranges are the pale tip crescent under the nail, the paler nail centre and the outer rim light. No cast shadow from foot_body over the toe roots (the toe-root band y 1456-1462 is as light as the toe tops), so there is no root shadow loop. The knuckle hinge carries no tone in this pose.

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Shade range on the right side of the toe along gap 1: closed loop between the gap 1 line (= this toe's visible right edge / hidden right edge, (438.0,1463.5) down to the tip junction (435.9,1482.3)) and a line 1.8 px to its left (alongside legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_right_side_turn), tapering to 0 at both ends. Source: cast shadow / contact occlusion from fourth toe (the toe above in the stack overlapping this toe's right side) onto little toe, together with this toe's own side turning under it. Reference: dark pinkish band 1.5-1.8 px wide left of the gap line, darkest in its middle third. Edge: hard against the gap line, soft ~1 px toward the top plane. Hidden part: continues up the hidden root lap under fourth toe at the same width (fully in shadow when the toes spread a little), so the shade does not stop at the visible top. Final: absorbed into tone (darker skin band, casts handled as a separate shadow layer by the rendering stack); no line. Region: inside the toe fill, closed against the gap / hidden right edge.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Rolled-under rim of the toe tip: closed band from (426.2,1472.5) along the tip contour to (435.9,1482.7), inner edge ~1.7 px inside the contour (follows legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_tip_turn, which it shares in the middle; tapers to the contour at both ends where it meets the gap bands and the outer rim light). Source: self shade, the tip surface turning down away from the light toward the sole. Reference: pinker/darker 1-2 px rim (#f2cfc9-#eec4c1) along the lower curve. Edge: hard against the contour, soft ~1 px inward. Final: absorbed into tone; the outer contour stays the ink line. Region: inside the toe fill, closed against the tip contour.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Pale crescent under the nail: closed lens from (429.3,1476.6) along the lower arc of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_nail (shared edge) to (434.3,1477.5), bowing down to ~1.5-1.7 px below the nail and stopping short of the tip-rim shade. Source: light on the forward-facing toe pad / pale nail free edge. Reference: paler skin crescent just under the nail ring (#fbeee9 vs #fae8e0). Edge: firm along the nail, soft ~1 px downward. Final: absorbed into tone (highlight); no line. Region: closed against the nail outline.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Paler centre of the nail plate: small closed oval centred (432.0,1475.7), ~55% of the nail size, entirely inside legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_nail. Source: the domed nail plate facing the light; the reference nail reads as a pink ring with a paler centre. Edge: soft ~0.8 px all round (no hard edge). Final: absorbed into tone (nail colour step); no line. Region: inside the nail region.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Outer rim light of the little toe: closed sliver along the outer contour from (425.8,1463.0) to (426.1,1471.4), ~1.5 px wide, tapering at both ends; continues foot_body_tone_outer_rim_light, which ends at the foot outer contour at y~1461. Source: back/side light catching the outer edge of the foot. Reference: the outer edge x 426-427, y 1464-1471 is slightly lighter than the top plane (#fbece5 vs #fae8e0), then the nail and tip take over below. Edge: hard against the contour, soft ~1 px inward; lies between the contour and legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_outer_side_turn. Final: absorbed into tone (rim highlight); no line. Region: inside the toe fill, closed against the outer contour.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe details (3.4), foot_body convention (silhouette rim as a thin colour line). The reference skin of the toes is smooth (no wrinkles, knuckle creases or nail ridges at this density); line-reference.png has only the outer contour, the gap lines and the light nail outline, all already drawn in 3.1/3.2. Only detail: the pale outer rim continuing the foot_body outer rim.

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe. Pale skin rim ~0.9 px inside the little toe outer contour, from (426.7,1462.8) just below the foot_body / toes handover (continues legs__right_leg__right_foot__foot_body_detail_rim_outer, which ends at (426.8,1461)) down to (427.1,1472.4), where the outer side turns into the nail/tip and the rim dissolves. Purpose: the 1 px pale line the reference shows right inside the dark outer contour (lum ~66-68 against ~63 top plane), lies inside legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_outer_rim_light. Final: shown as a thin pale colour line (no dark ink), 0.5-0.6 px, uniform; starts at full strength at the handover so the foot rim reads continuous, fades out over the last ~2 px. Soft edge. Not a fill boundary.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe highlights (4.6), checked against base-subject.png: matte skin, light from the upper right/front; only soft pale planes, no glossy specular dots. Nail: the paler nail centre is already its local colour (4.3) and the reference shows no specular on the nail plate, so none is added. No reflected light along the sole edge (the tip rim stays pink-dark). All highlights move with the toe, so no separate rendering layer.

path.desc: Pale crescent under the little_toe nail (4.6): reference skin just under the nail ring reads #fbeee9-#fcf0eb against #fae8e0. Filled from legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_tip_pale_highlight at 0.9 with a 0.6 blur, firm along the nail (nail ring drawn above), soft ~1 px downward; stops short of the tip-rim shade. Moves with the toe.

Outer rim light of little_toe (4.6), continuing foot_body_tone_outer_rim_light: reference x 426-427, y 1464-1471 is slightly lighter (#fbece5) than the top plane. Filled from legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_outer_rim_light at 0.85, blur 0.6: hard against the outer contour (fill clip), soft ~1 px inward, tapering at both ends; the soft pale rim line from 3.5 rides on it.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothing 0.5, linear radius easing; widths set by explicit per-point pressure with smoothstep ramps t*t*(3-2t); built-in taper options off, tapers realised as pressure ramps); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe brush strokes (3.5), recoloured in 4.7: silhouette ink warm dark brown (#4e2b2c-#6e4446, #5c3533 at the foot_body handovers), gap lines pinkish brown (#c9958f-#c08a86, darker into the junctions), nail outline pink (#dcaaa5 / #e0aea9), soft lines skin-family pinks. Inked: tip contour. Light: nail outline; soft: outer rim. Not stroked (source curves set display=none, descs kept): fill boundary/seams (blue guides: root seam, right hidden edge), the hidden part of the gap line above the foot_body seam, knuckle hinge, side turns, tip turn and all tone loops (kept hidden with their descs for the shading stages). Source curves of the strokes are also hidden; the toe fill stays visible.

path.desc: Line junction refinement (4.7) at the outer silhouette handover to foot_body_outer_contour_brush (425.8,1463.0): a small solid fill under the foot_body stroke, #5c3533 like both strokes, ~1.4-2.0 px wide over the taper, so the silhouette keeps one width across the seam. Reason: the foot_body outer stroke tapers to a point over y 1460-1462.9 while the toe tip stroke starts 1.2 px wide, which left a pinched white notch in the silhouette (reference: one continuous dark edge 673c42 here, no break). Lies beneath legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body (its fill hides the inner side); no change to the existing stroke geometry.

Brush for little_toe_tip_contour (outer silhouette ink): size 1.3, thinning 0.7; from the foot_body handover (425.8,1463.0) the width ramps 1.2 to 2.0 px over the first 3 px (the foot_body outer stroke tapers into this point from above, so the two read as one line without a blob), holds 2.0 px down the outer side, 2.2 px round the lowest part of the tip (y~1478-1481.5), eases to ~1.5 px over the last 5 px into the gap-1 junction (435.9,1482.7) where it meets the fourth_toe gap and tip strokes. Opacity solid, no breaks; hard edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): horizontal gradient, warm dark brown from the skin family: #5c3533 at the foot_body handover (same as foot_body outer contour, so the silhouette runs on), easing to #6a4041 round the lit lowest part of the tip and deepening to #53302f into the gap-1 junction; reference silhouette reads 673c42-9c6b69 at the skin/background edge (darker 3d1d22-603137 at the junction notches). Width, caps and opacity unchanged.

Brush for little_toe_struct_nail (nail ring, the only interior line inked in line-reference.png): closed stroke, size 0.5, thinning 0.6; ~0.7 px along the upper arc and sides, thinning to ~0.4 px along the lower arc. Opacity: vertical gradient 0.85 over the upper 60 %, easing to 0.45 and ~0.2 at the bottom (y 1472.8 to 1479.2), so the lower edge nearly breaks where the paler tip begins. Hard but light edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): pink nail-rim #dcaaa5 with the same opacity gradient, so the ring reads ~e8bcb7 over the nail (reference ring dcaca6-f0cbc4, centre eec8c4-f8dbd5); no grey ink.

Brush for little_toe_detail_rim_outer (pale rim inside the outer silhouette, continuing foot_body_detail_rim_outer_brush): size 0.4, thinning 0.6, even ~0.55 px; opacity 0.7 from the handover (y 1462.8) to y~1470.0, then fades out to 0 over the last ~2 px (y 1472.4). Blur 0.3 (soft edge), clipped to the little_toe fill. Colour (4.7): pale skin #fbe6dc (continuing foot_body rim end #fde9df), a light strip just inside the outline (reference f7ceca-fadbd7 inside the edge); not ink.

g.desc: 独立投影层（4.5.1 登记，4.5.2 绘制）：fourth_toe 叠压在 little_toe 右侧并挡光，投在 little_toe 沿 gap 1 的右侧带（位置见 legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_right_gap_occlusion_shade）。follow legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe，clip_to legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/little_toe。放在 little_toe 之后、fourth_toe 之前，故被 fourth_toe 自身遮住的部分不可见、张趾时随 fourth_toe 移动露出。

path.desc: Full cast shadow of fourth_toe on little_toe along gap 1: band following legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_left_gap_contour (the casting toe edge) from the toes-group top (y 1450.7, hidden lap under foot_body and fourth_toe) down to the gap-1 junction (435.9,1482.7); 1.8 px wide on the little_toe side, tapering to 0 over the last 3.5 px into the junction, plus a 1 px margin under fourth_toe for spreading/curling. Colour from the reference: dark pink band 1.5-1.8 px left of the gap line (#e1b9b1-#d3aba2, darkest #c78e8b in the middle third) on the #f9e7de skin, so multiply ~#e6c4c2, deepening to #dcb0ae in the middle third. Vertical gradient: geometry runs up the hidden lap for motion margin, but opacity is 0 above y 1462.0 and fades in to 0.75 by y 1466.0 (the reference gap shade starts softly just below the foot_body root seam, together with the gap ink fade-in), 1.0 over the middle third of the visible gap (y 1463.5-1482.7), 0.55 at the junction. Blur 0.6 keeps the edge against fourth_toe firm and softens the ~1 px edge toward the little_toe top plane. Shown only where the later receiver mask (little_toe) allows; the parts over fourth_toe and foot_body are covered by them.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe: fourth toe. One closed fill plus its boundary curves (tip contour, side edges, root seam), which together trace the fill outline exactly. Guide: block-layers/groups.svg legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe (block0 visible strip, block1 root motion margin).

path.desc: Fill region of fourth_toe, base skin #f9e7de (same as foot_body), one continuous closed area without holes: visible left side along gap 1 from (439.5,1450.7) to its junction (435.9,1482.7), rounded tip to (446.6,1488.2), hidden right side up gap 2 plus the root lap under the next toe (up to ~3.5 px at y~1450, 1 px at y 1468, 0 by y 1472) to (454.9,1454.6), root seam under foot_body back to the start. Expected reveal: the root lap (under foot_body and under the neighbouring toe) shows only when the toes spread, curl or the foot flexes; it is the same toe skin and later shading should simply continue the visible root tone into it. Base colour (4.1, checked against base-subject.png): toe skin #f9e7de confirmed (reference toe skin averages #f9e6dc-#fae6de); the nail plate is a separate pink nail material drawn as legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_nail_base above this fill.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe large light/shade (4.2), checked against base-subject.png: light from the upper right/front; the toe top plane stays the lit base skin #f9e7de (no fill over it), the form is carried by its own turning planes: left gap side shade, tip rim shade. Not here: the occlusion/cast band from the overlapping neighbour toe along the right gap (right_gap_occlusion_shade, rendering 4.5), pale tip / nail centre / rim lights (4.6), nail plate shading (4.3/4.4). Shades sit over the skin fill and under the nail plate and brush lines.

path.desc: 4.2 gap-side self shade of fourth_toe, filled along legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_tone_left_gap_side_shade: the toe side turning away from the light into the gap: reference #f3d3cc-#efc8c4 against the #f9e7de top plane, so a slightly redder, darker skin (#ebbbb5 at 0.9 over the base, blurred to read ~#f0cac4 at its core). Edge: hard on the gap side (clipped by this toe's fill, whose edge is the gap contour), blur 0.6 softens the ~1.5 px edge toward the top plane. Clipped (via the group) to legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_fill, so it never leaves the toe; continues up the hidden root lap where the loop does.

4.2 tip rim self shade of fourth_toe, filled along legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_tone_tip_rim_shade: the tip surface rolling under toward the sole: reference #f2cfc9-#eec4c1 along the lower curve (#ecc0ba at 0.8, reads ~#efc8c2), warmer/pinker than the side shade so the round tip reads as a volume. Edge: hard against the tip contour (fill clip), blur 0.6 softens the ~1 px inner edge. Clipped (via the group) to legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_fill, so it never leaves the toe; continues up the hidden root lap where the loop does.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe transition / local colour on the skin (4.3), checked against base-subject.png: the toe skin warms slightly toward the tip pad (the tips read a touch pinker, #f6d6cf-#f3d2cd, than the cool-pale root band #fae8e0 under foot_body) and the pink tip-rim shade (4.2) meets the lit top plane through this warm band instead of a step. The root, gap shading and nail stay as they are; no hard edge is added.

circle.desc: Warm tip blush of fourth_toe: radial gradient #f6d6cf, opacity 0.55 at (444.5,1484.7) easing to 0 at r 6 px; centred above the lowest tip point (446.6,1488.2), so it overlaps the inner soft edge of the tip-rim shade and fades out before mid-toe. Clipped to legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_fill; drawn over the volume shades, under the nail plate. Local skin colour, moves with the toe.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe local dark refinement (4.4), checked against base-subject.png: the only small structural darks on the toe itself are the crevice corners where it meets the neighbouring toe tip at the gap junction(s). The knuckle hinge, nail fold and toe top carry no dark in this pose (reference rows above the nails stay #fae8e0). Cast/occlusion from the overlapping neighbour toe (right_gap_occlusion_shade, the black second/big slit) is left to 4.5. Kept light and soft so it does not double the 4.2 shades.

circle.desc: Crevice dark of fourth_toe at the gap-1 junction (435.9,1482.7) with little_toe: where the gap side and the rolled-under tip meet, the skin folds into the deepest corner of the toe. Reference: in the last ~3 px above each junction the skin beside the gap line drops to #e9c0bf-#c39798 and the gap widens into a dark notch. Radial gradient #d4a09d 0.75 at the junction (focus 0.4 px above it) easing to 0 at r 3.2 px, clipped to legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_fill so only this toe's side of the corner is darkened; soft, no line; it deepens the ends of the 4.2 gap-side / tip-rim shades without a second band.

Crevice dark of fourth_toe at the gap-2 junction (446.6,1488.2) with middle_toe: where the gap side and the rolled-under tip meet, the skin folds into the deepest corner of the toe. Reference: in the last ~3 px above each junction the skin beside the gap line drops to #e9c0bf-#c39798 and the gap widens into a dark notch. Radial gradient #d4a09d 0.75 at the junction (focus 0.4 px above it) easing to 0 at r 3.2 px, clipped to legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_fill so only this toe's side of the corner is darkened; soft, no line; it deepens the ends of the 4.2 gap-side / tip-rim shades without a second band.

path.desc: Nail plate base colour of fourth_toe: #f1cbc6, pink nail material distinct from the toe skin #f9e7de (reference small nails read as a pink ring ~#f0c9c4 around a lighter centre). Closed area = fourth_toe_struct_nail, clipped to the fourth_toe fill; the lighter centre stays for the nail centre light tone (3.3 boundary fourth_toe_tone_nail_center_light), not base colour. Nail outline is the existing brush stroke above.

Local colour of the fourth_toe nail plate (4.3): the reference small nail is a pink rim (#f0c9c4) around a paler centre (#f8dbd5-#fae1db), so the centre oval (from legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_tone_nail_center_light) is filled #f8ddd7 at 0.85 over the nail_base with a 0.6 blur, leaving a soft pink ring. Colour variation of the nail material; no specular highlight (that stays for 4.6).

fourth_toe visible contour (red). Visible tip contour of the fourth toe: from the gap-1 junction (435.9,1482.7) (bottom of this toe's left gap line, also end of the neighbouring tip contour) round the rounded tip to the gap-2 junction (446.6,1488.2). Weight ~1.5 px at both junctions, ~2 px over the lowest part of the tip; hard edge, continuous; the two neighbouring tip contours and the gap line meet at each junction without a gap. Bounds the lower edge of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_fill.

fourth_toe image-left side = toe gap 1 (between little_toe and fourth_toe), the visible gap line (red). Runs from (439.5,1450.7) at the toes-group top (hidden under foot_body) down to the junction (435.9,1482.7) with the tip contours. Hidden and never inked above y~1463 (under foot_body toe_root_seam); the inked stroke starts at y~1463 with a soft fade-in over ~3 px (hair-thin, then ~1-1.2 px), holds ~1.2 px, and thickens slightly to ~1.5 px into the junction where it merges with the tip contours. Edge firm on the fourth_toe side; the dark gap shading beside it toward little_toe belongs to later shading. Bounds the left edge of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_fill; this toe sits above little_toe, so this line is the actual silhouette edge over the neighbour. Expected reveal when toes spread: the line stays this toe's edge; the neighbour's root lap appears beside it.

fourth_toe image-right side, hidden (blue dashed): from (454.9,1454.6) at the toes-group top down to (446.6,1488.2) at the gap-2 junction. Lies under middle_toe (gap 2 line plus a root lap ~3.5 px wide at y~1450, 1 px at y 1468, closing to 0 by y~1472), so it is never inked and stays a soft, colour-matched fill edge; the visible gap line here is middle_toe_left_gap_contour. Bounds the right edge of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_fill. Expected reveal: a 1-3 px strip of this toe's side shows beside the gap line only when the toes spread apart.

fourth_toe root edge, hidden (blue dashed): top of the toe from (454.9,1454.6) to (439.5,1450.7), about 6-10 px above foot_body_toe_root_seam, all under foot_body. Internal joint lap for toe flexion, never inked, soft colour-matched edge. Closes legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_fill along the top. Expected reveal: none in the rest pose; toe curl or spread keeps it under the foot.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe internal structure lines (3.2), thin position guides. The nail is the only interior line inked in line-reference.png (a light grey-pink thin ring, much lighter than the skin contour); the knuckle hinge, side-plane turns and tip turn are structure / shade boundaries for later shading and are not inked. Positions measured on base-subject.png (pink nail ring / nail plate, pinker side bands along the gaps, pinker rim along the tip).

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe. fourth toe nail: small closed oval centred (442.3,1481.4), ~6.0 x 6.2 px, long axis tilted 8 deg to follow the toe axis (toes lean toward image-left at the tip). Reference: pink ring with paler centre (base-subject.png), light grey ring in line-reference.png. Island inside the toe top plane, its lower edge ~1.5-2 px above the tip contour; connects to nothing. Use: nail border; final shows as a thin light ring (~0.5-0.7 px, warm grey-pink, clearly lighter than the gap lines), slightly firmer on the upper arc and the two sides, thinning and nearly breaking for ~1.5 px at the lower arc where the paler tip crescent begins. Hard but light edge. Fill: closes the nail region for later local colour (pinkish ring, paler centre). Expected reveal: none. Tone (3.3): the lower arc closes legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__fourth_toe_tone_tip_pale_highlight below it; the nail region itself is a local-colour zone (pink), not a shade.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe. Proximal interphalangeal joint hinge: very shallow upward-bowed arc across the toe at y~1470.5 from (437.9,1470.8) near the left side to (447.9,1470.8) near the right side, ending ~0.8-1.2 px short of both side edges, about halfway between the foot_body toe-root seam and the nail top. Use: bend axis for toe curl / flex (the segment below it rotates); the reference shows no crease or knuckle mark here in the rest pose, so final: no ink, no visible tone, at most a hair of shading if the toe curls. Soft, both ends fade. Not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: when the toes curl a soft crease forms along this line and the knuckle top above it catches light.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe. g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe light/shade ranges (3.3), thin dashed position loops only; colour and value are the next stage. path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe. Reference: dark pinkish band 1.5-1.8 px wide left of the gap line, darkest in its middle third. Edge: hard against the gap line, soft ~1 px toward the top plane. g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothing 0.5, linear radius easing; widths set by explicit per-point pressure with smoothstep ramps t*t*(3-2t); built-in taper options off, tapers realised as pressure ramps); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/fourth_toe brush strokes (3.5), recoloured in 4.7: silhouette ink warm dark brown (#4e2b2c-#6e4446, #5c3533 at the foot_body handovers), gap lines pinkish brown (#c9958f-#c08a86, darker into the junctions), nail outline pink (#dcaaa5 / #e0aea9), soft lines skin-family pinks. Not stroked (source curves set display=none, descs kept): fill boundary/seams (blue guides: root seam, right hidden edge), the hidden part of the gap line above the foot_body seam, knuckle hinge, side turns, tip turn and all tone loops (kept hidden with their descs for the shading stages). Colour (4.7): horizontal gradient, warm dark brown from the skin family: #53302f at both gap junctions, #684042 round the lit lowest part of the tip; reference silhouette reads 673c42-9c6b69 at the skin/background edge (darker 3d1d22-603137 at the junction notches). Brush for fourth_toe_left_gap_contour (toe gap 1 ink, this toe's silhouette over little toe): only the visible part from y~1463.0 (just below foot_body_toe_root_seam) to the junction (435.9,1482.7); the hidden part above stays unstroked. Opacity: vertical gradient 0.85 over the upper 60 %, easing to 0.45 and ~0.2 at the bottom (y 1478.3 to 1484.5), so the lower edge nearly breaks where the paler tip begins. Hard but light edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): pink nail-rim #dcaaa5 with the same opacity gradient, so the ring reads ~e8bcb7 over the nail (reference ring dcaca6-f0cbc4, centre eec8c4-f8dbd5); no grey ink.

The strip between this line and the tip contour is the pinker rim of the tip in the reference (1-2 px, #f2cfc9-#eec4c1), and above it, under the nail, the pale tip crescent (paler skin just below the nail). path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/middle_toe. Edge: firm (hard) on the gap side, soft ~1.5 px gradient toward the top plane, fades in under the foot_body seam over ~2 px and fades out into the tip-rim shade at the bottom. Final: absorbed into tone (side-shade colour), no line; the gap contour keeps the ink. Region: inside the toe fill, closed against the gap contour.

Reference: dark pinkish band 1.5-1.8 px wide left of the gap line, darkest in its middle third. Edge: hard against the gap line, soft ~1 px toward the top plane. Final: absorbed into tone (darker skin band, casts handled as a separate shadow layer by the rendering stack); no line. Region: inside the toe fill, closed against the gap / hidden right edge.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothing 0.5, linear radius easing; widths set by explicit per-point pressure with smoothstep ramps t*t*(3-2t); built-in taper options off, tapers realised as pressure ramps); source curve in data-source-curve

Not stroked (source curves set display=none, descs kept): fill boundary/seams (blue guides: root seam, right hidden edge), the hidden part of the gap line above the foot_body seam, knuckle hinge, side turns, tip turn and all tone loops (kept hidden with their descs for the shading stages). Colour (4.7): horizontal gradient, warm dark brown from the skin family: #53302f at the gap-3 junction, #684042 round the tip, #4e2b2c into the deeper gap-4 junction; reference silhouette reads 673c42-9c6b69 at the skin/background edge (darker 3d1d22-603137 at the junction notches). Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/big_toe. Soft, both ends fade. Not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: when the toes curl a soft crease forms along this line and the knuckle top above it catches light.
