Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/big_toe. Rolled-under rim of the toe tip: closed band from (470.4,1490.3) along the tip contour to (492.1,1483.8), inner edge ~1.7 px inside the contour (follows legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_tip_turn, which it shares in the middle; tapers to the contour at both ends where it meets the gap bands and the inner side shade). Source: self shade, the tip surface turning down away from the light toward the sole. Reference: pinker/darker 1-2 px rim (#f2cfc9-#eec4c1) along the lower curve. Edge: hard against the contour, soft ~1 px inward. Final: absorbed into tone; the outer contour stays the ink line. Region: inside the toe fill, closed against the tip contour.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/big_toe. Pale free-edge / tip highlight under the big toe nail: closed loop from (475.6,1487.0) along the nail bottom (shared with big_toe_struct_nail lower edge) to (485.6,1486.9), round under it to the lowest point (480.0,1490.6), ~3.5 px tall; stays ~1.5-2 px above the tip contour and inside the tip-rim shade. Source: light on the forward-facing tip pad / white nail free edge. Reference: the brightest skin in the group, near white #fdf3ef, y 1487-1491, x 474-486. Edge: hard along the nail bottom (colour change pink plate to white), soft ~1.5 px downward into the base skin and the rim shade. Final: absorbed into tone (highlight colour); no line. Region: closed against the nail outline on top, free soft lower edge.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/big_toe. Inner side plane of the big toe: closed band from (494.6,1465.0) (foot_body inner contour handover) down the inner contour to (491.9,1484.3), inner edge ~2.8 px inside the contour, following legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_inner_side_turn, tapering at the bottom into the tip-rim shade. Source: self shade, the inner side turning away from the light; continues foot_body_tone_inner_side_shade (ends at (489.6,1460)/(494.6,1463)). Reference: x 488-493 a soft step darker (#f8e3d8-#f7e1d6) than the top plane. Edge: hard against the contour, soft ~2 px gradient toward image-left. Final: absorbed into tone (warm side shade); no line. Region: inside the toe fill, closed against the inner contour.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/big_toe details (3.4). The reference skin of the toes is smooth (no wrinkles, knuckle creases or nail ridges at this density); line-reference.png has only the outer contour, the gap lines and the light nail outline, all already drawn in 3.1/3.2. Details: the warm inner rim continuing the foot_body inner rim, and the thin free-edge line of the nail (line-reference shows the nail bottom as a double line, ~1 px apart).

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/big_toe. Warm pink rim ~0.9 px inside the big toe inner contour, from (493.7,1465.0) at the foot_body / toes handover (continues legs__right_leg__right_foot__foot_body_detail_rim_inner, which ends at (493.2,1462)) down to (490.9,1484.6) where the inner side rounds into the tip. Purpose: the pinkish edge band the reference shows on the inner silhouette (x 491-492 lum ~201-212 against ~232 top plane); lies over legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__big_toe_tone_inner_side_shade next to the contour. Final: thin warm colour line (no dark ink), 0.6-0.7 px at the top, thinning to ~0.3 px and fading out over its last ~3 px into the tip-rim shade. Soft edge. Not a fill boundary.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/big_toe. Nail free-edge line: short, almost straight arc ~1.3 px below the bottom edge of legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_nail, from (476.4,1488.3) to (485.0,1488.2), lowest (480.8,1488.7) at the middle; connects to nothing (both ends stop ~1 px inside the nail bottom corners). Purpose: the thin white free edge of the nail; line-reference.png draws the nail bottom as two light lines ~1 px apart (offset there by +3/+2 px like the rest of this area). Lies inside legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__big_toe_tone_tip_pale_highlight, near its top. Final: very light grey-pink hairline, 0.3-0.4 px, lighter than the nail outline; clear in the middle ~5 px, fades out over ~1.5 px at both ends. Hard but faint edge. Not a fill boundary (the white free edge is carried by the pale highlight tone).

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/big_toe highlights (4.6), checked against base-subject.png: matte skin, light from the upper right/front; only soft pale planes, no glossy specular dots. Nail: the paler nail centre is already its local colour (4.3) and the reference shows no specular on the nail plate, so none is added. No reflected light along the sole edge (the tip rim stays pink-dark). All highlights move with the toe, so no separate rendering layer.

path.desc: Pale free-edge / tip-pad highlight of big_toe (4.6): the brightest skin of the group in the reference, near white #fdf3ef over x 474-486, y 1487-1491, directly under the nail. Filled from legs__right_leg__right_foot__toes__big_toe_tone_tip_pale_highlight at 0.95 with a 0.6 blur: its top edge sits on the nail bottom (the nail plate and its free-edge hairline are drawn above, so the pink-to-white change stays firm), and the lower edge fades ~1.5 px into the base skin and the tip-rim shade. Light from the front, consistent with the lit top plane; moves with the toe.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothing 0.5, linear radius easing; widths set by explicit per-point pressure with smoothstep ramps t*t*(3-2t); built-in taper options off, tapers realised as pressure ramps); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes/big_toe brush strokes (3.5), recoloured in 4.7: silhouette ink warm dark brown (#4e2b2c-#6e4446, #5c3533 at the foot_body handovers), gap lines pinkish brown (#c9958f-#c08a86, darker into the junctions), nail outline pink (#dcaaa5 / #e0aea9), soft lines skin-family pinks. Inked: tip contour and the visible left gap line. Light: nail outline; soft: inner rim and nail free edge. Not stroked (source curves set display=none, descs kept): fill boundary/seams (blue guides: root seam), the hidden part of the gap line above the foot_body seam, knuckle hinge, side turns, tip turn and all tone loops (kept hidden with their descs for the shading stages). Source curves of the strokes are also hidden; the toe fill stays visible.

path.desc: Line junction refinement (4.7) at the inner silhouette handover to foot_body_inner_contour_brush (494.6,1465.0): a small solid fill under the foot_body stroke, #5c3533 like both strokes, ~1.4-2.0 px wide over the taper, so the silhouette keeps one width across the seam. Reason: the foot_body inner stroke tapers to a point over y 1461.5-1465.0 while the toe tip stroke starts 1.4 px wide, which left a pinched notch (reference: continuous inner edge d8a9a2 / 5c-6b brown core, no break). Lies beneath legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body (its fill hides the inner side); no change to the existing stroke geometry.

Brush for big_toe_tip_contour (outer silhouette ink): size 1.3, thinning 0.7; ~1.5 px at the gap-4 junction (470.3,1490.3), growing to 2.2 px over the first 6 px and held round the broad tip and up the inner side; over the last 4 px it eases to ~1.4 px at the handover (494.6,1465.0), where foot_body_inner_contour_brush tapers in from above, so the inner silhouette runs on as one line. Opacity solid, no breaks; hard edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): horizontal gradient, warm dark brown from the skin family: #4e2b2c at the gap-4 junction, #5e3739 to #6e4446 round the broad lit tip, #64393a up the inner side and #5c3533 at the handover (same as foot_body inner contour); reference silhouette reads 673c42-9c6b69 at the skin/background edge (darker 3d1d22-603137 at the junction notches). Width, caps and opacity unchanged.

Brush for big_toe_left_gap_contour (toe gap 4 ink, this toe's silhouette over second toe): only the visible part from y~1464.5 (just below foot_body_toe_root_seam) to the junction (470.4,1490.3); the hidden part above stays unstroked. Size 1.0, thinning 0.7: hair-thin ~0.25 px at the top, rising to ~1.2 px over the first 3 px, held, thickening to ~1.5 px over the last 4 px into the junction where it merges with the tip strokes. Opacity: vertical gradient fade-in 0 to 1 over y 1464.2-1467.7, then solid. Hard edge, unclipped (the dark gap shading beside it is a later tone). Colour (4.7): vertical gradient over the visible length, same opacity fade-in: #c69590 at the top (reference dbb0aa), deep #6a3434 to #5a2a2b over y ~1474-1479 where the slit between second and big toe opens (reference 441716-602d2e), easing to #9a6a64 along the lower part (reference 8a5451-ae7c71) and #4a2426 into the junction (reference 2f130f).

Brush for big_toe_struct_nail (nail outline (rounded rectangle), the only interior line inked in line-reference.png): closed stroke, size 0.5, thinning 0.6; ~0.7 px along the upper edge and upper corners, thinning to ~0.4 px along the lower free-edge line. Opacity: vertical gradient 0.85 over the upper 60 %, easing to 0.45 and ~0.2 at the bottom (y 1478.0 to 1487.1), so the lower edge nearly breaks where the paler tip begins. Hard but light edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): pink #e0aea9 with the same opacity gradient, so the plate edge reads just deeper than the plate #f3cdc9 (reference edge eecbc7-f0cec9) and nearly vanishes at the free edge.

Brush for big_toe_detail_rim_inner (warm rim inside the inner silhouette, continuing foot_body_detail_rim_inner_brush): size 0.5, thinning 0.6; ~0.7 px at the handover (y 1465.0) thinning smoothly to ~0.3 px at its end (y 1484.6); opacity 0.6, fading out to 0 over the last ~3 px into the tip-rim shade. Blur 0.3, clipped to the big_toe fill. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e6aa9c, the foot_body inner rim family (#e2a69c); reference inner edge d8a9a2 / eac2b6; not ink.

Brush for big_toe_detail_nail_free_edge (nail free-edge hairline): size 0.25, thinning 0.6, even ~0.35 px; horizontal gradient opacity 0 at x 476.4, 0.5 by +1.5 px, held over the middle, 0 at x 485.0 (fades over ~1.5 px at both ends). Hard but faint edge, unclipped (lies well inside the toe). Colour (4.7): light grey-pink #d9aeab hairline at 0.5, reading ~eacbc6 between the plate and the white tip strip (reference efc9c6 to fbe7e2).

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body outer contour and junctions (3.1). Stack: above legs/right_leg/right_shin (the shin's rounded bottom y~1394-1404 lies under this part, per the shin fill desc), below right_anklet and above the toes group (toe roots tuck under this part ~9 px). Guide: block-layers/groups.svg same id. Lines here are thin position guides only (red = visible contour to be inked, blue dashed = internal seam / hidden edge, never inked); final ink, colour and widths come in later stages.

path.desc: Fill region of foot_body, one continuous closed area without holes: ankle dome top (467,1358.5) - outer side (445.6,1370) - outer sole edge down to (425.8,1463) - toe-root seam to (494.6,1465) - inner (big-toe side) edge up to (488.4,1370.5) - back over the dome. Taken unchanged from the guide block (visible edges already calibrated to base-subject.png and line-reference.png; dome is the hidden ankle cap). Base colour (part_base_colors): bare skin #f9e7de over the whole closed fill, one material and one inherent-colour zone, including the hidden ankle dome under the shin end and the strip under the toe roots, so ankle rotation and toe flexion reveal the same skin. Checked against the reference: the mid-tone median of the visible foot is ~#f9e6dc (ankle front and instep, anklet excluded), the same as the shin (~#fae6dd); so the foot uses the shin/thigh base #f9e7de and the ankle seam with legs/right_leg/right_shin stays invisible. Material: warm, soft, matte skin with low gloss, the same as the legs. The side shades, ankle hollows, instep highlight, rims and the anklet glow are later shading/colour layers, not base-colour zones; the anklet chain and crystal belong to right_anklet. Volume step (4.2): the top of the hidden ankle dome is feathered with mask r3s7_legs__right_leg__right_foot_dome_feather (the fill blurred by 3 px, solid from y 1376 down), so the internal seam over the shin ankle shading stays invisible as foot_body_ankle_joint_seam requires; the visible outer/inner edges below y 1376 stay hard. The earlier blue position stroke is removed; the visible edge is drawn by the contour brushes. Whole region is one skin surface: bare skin like the shin, matte.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body big light/dark (4.2): self shading of the foot, light from upper image-right/front, consistent with the shin. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; soft-edged, clipped to the foot_body fill, over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: side-plane shades, ankle hollows (continuing the shin ankle pockets over the hidden ankle seam), then the lit instep. The foot in the reference is almost flat-lit, so all steps are small. The outer rim light and inner warm rim are left to 4.3/4.4 (detail rims), the right_anklet glow and any anklet occlusion to 4.5 / rendering stack.

path.desc: Outer (little-toe) side plane turning from the upper-right light: the closed foot_body_tone_outer_side_shade loop (inner edge = struct_outer_side_turn, outer edge past the outer contour, clipped by the fill), filled #f8e1d6, one soft step below base #f9e7de (reference #f9e4d9 on the side band against #f9e5dc-#fae6dd on the top plane; deepened a hair so the side reads). Opacity fades in under the anklet beads (y 1388-1397), held to ~1452, eases to 0.5 at the toe-root seam where the toes take over. Blur 2.0: ~3-4 px soft gradient toward the top plane, matching the reference.

Inner (big-toe/arch) side plane shade: the closed foot_body_tone_inner_side_shade loop, #f6e2d1, a warmer yellowish step below base (reference #f7e5d2 on the 3-5 px inner band, edge #edcebb at y 1400). Fades in under the anklet, eases out toward the toe-root seam. Blur 1.5 (~2 px soft edge toward image-left).

Outer ankle hollow beside the lateral malleolus: closed foot_body_tone_outer_ankle_pocket (right edge = struct_outer_malleolus), #f6dad2 (reference #f6d9d3; shin pocket #f6ddd3, so the foot carries the same hollow down from the shin over the hidden ankle seam). Top fades in over the hidden dome overlap (y 1356-1363) so it meets the shin pocket under the cap; firm y 1363-1383; fades into the outer side shade below the anklet beads. Grown by a 5 px stroke in the same gradient (about 2.5 px past the malleolus line, outward part clipped) and blurred 2.0, because the reference hollow reaches ~3 px in front of the bone line (x~454 outer, x~481 inner) and meets the shin side shade there.

Inner ankle hollow beside the medial malleolus: closed foot_body_tone_inner_ankle_pocket (left edge = struct_inner_malleolus), #f2d7cc (reference #f3dacd, #f1d6cb-#f2cbbf at x 482-486 y 1368), continuing the shin inner pocket; top fades in over the hidden overlap, fades out under the anklet inner beads. Grown by a 5 px stroke in the same gradient (about 2.5 px past the malleolus line, outward part clipped) and blurred 2.0, because the reference hollow reaches ~3 px in front of the bone line (x~454 outer, x~481 inner) and meets the shin side shade there.

Lit instep top plane: closed foot_body_tone_instep_highlight around struct_instep_ridge, #fbebe3 at max 0.6 opacity, only a whisper above base (the reference top plane is nearly flat, #f8e7db-#f9e7dd; the lift mainly separates the top plane from the side shades). Fades in under the anklet pendant, held over y 1418-1450, fades out before the toe-root seam. Blur 3.0 (~4-5 px soft on all sides).

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body transition and local colour (4.3), over the volume layer and under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill and sharing the dome feather mask. From the reference: slight warm peach on the forefoot top plane, pinkish edge light at the outer ankle continuing the shin, warm pink-peach along the inner edge, a warm peach transition at the outer side-plane turn. Big light/shade zones unchanged; the rims stay as detail lines (4.4), the anklet glow for 4.5/rendering stack.

ellipse.desc: Slight warm peach on the lower top plane / forefoot (centre 468,1440, rx 20, ry 13, #f8e3d6 0.45 at the centre, radial fade, blur 3): the reference forefoot reads #f9e6dd-#f8e6da, a touch warmer and less pale than the instep highlight above it (#faeae2 after 4.2); this tempers the cool pale run-out of the instep highlight into the toe roots without moving the highlight itself. The ankle warmth of the shin (shin_lc_ankle_warm) was tested here and left out: on the foot top plane it darkened the visible ankle front (reference #f9e7dc-#fae8dc), so that warmth stays under right_anklet.

path.desc: Pinkish edge light inside the outer silhouette at the ankle, continuing legs_right_leg_right_shin_lc_outer_edge_light (which ends #f8d8d2 at the ankle): hidden outer contour stroked 5 px (outer half clipped), #f8d8d2 0.7 at y~1370, lightening to #fbe2dc 0.6 by ~1392 and fading out by ~1420, where the pale detail rim (foot_body_detail_rim_outer) takes over toward the toes (reference outer edge #fce6dc there). Blur 1.0.

Warm pink-peach along the inner (big-toe side) edge, continuing legs_right_leg_right_shin_lc_inner_edge_warm (#f3d1cb at the ankle): hidden inner contour stroked 7 px (outer half clipped), #f3d1cb 0.6 at the ankle, warmer peach #f2d2c4 0.45-0.55 over y 1395-1428 (reference inner band #f7e5d2, edge #edcebb at y 1400 and #f8e5d3 at 1420), easing to 0.2 by ~1450 and 0 at the toe-root seam. Over the inner side shade, under the warm detail rim. Blur 2.0.

Warm peach transition (#f8e5d5, 0.5, ~5 px, blur 3) along struct_outer_side_turn, the inner edge of the outer side shade: keeps the side-plane turn warm and soft like the shin calf turn (reference side band #f9e4d9, slightly warmer than the top plane #f9e5dc). Fades in below the anklet (y~1398) and out before the toe-root seam.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body local darks (4.4): the narrow warm creases where both ankle bones turn into the foot sides and a very faint ankle-front fold. Over volume and local colour, under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill and sharing the dome feather mask. Ankle hollows stay as the volume pockets (no double darkening); the metatarsal arc gets no shade because the reference shows no tone step there (G 229-231); the anklet / crystal drop shadows and the toe overlaps are left for 4.5.

path.desc: Warm crease just inside the inner contour where the inner ankle bone turns into the arch side (y ~1362-1404): the reference keeps a narrow deeper band there (#deb0a6 at x 486 y 1370, #ecc8ba-#f0d5c3 at x 485 y 1388-1398) while the foot body was still #f5dad0/#f8e4d6. Hidden inner contour stroked 5 px (outer half clipped, so ~2.5 px inside), #ebc3b8 0.55-0.6 over y 1366-1393, fading in at the top and out by ~1406. Narrow and soft (blur 1.0); lies over the inner ankle pocket and inner edge warm without forming a dark spot.

Small soft crease along the outer contour behind the outer ankle bone (y ~1362-1384), continuing legs_right_leg_right_shin_ls_ankle_bone_crease (#efcdc6) onto the foot so the bone hollow reads across the ankle seam: reference #e5c2c4-#f0ccc9 at x 446-448 y 1366-1374. Hidden outer contour stroked 4 px (outer half clipped), #efc9c4 0.45-0.5, fading out at both ends by ~1388. Blur 1.0. Re-checked in 4.7: raised to 0.6-0.65 because the outer ankle hollow beside the line still read ~5 levels lighter than the reference (229 vs 224 at x 452, y 1362-1370).

Very faint flexion fold across the front of the ankle along struct_ankle_front_crease, as its desc asks: #f4dcd3, max 0.25 over the centre third, fading out toward both malleoli, ~3 px, blur 1.5, no ink. Mostly under the anklet chain; the reference shows almost nothing between the beads, so it is kept just perceptible as a hinge for dorsiflexion.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body highlights (4.6), over local colour and local shading, under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill. Skin: one warm rim light on the outer side toward the toes (tone_outer_rim_light). The top-plane highlight is already carried by volume_instep_highlight (4.2, toned down by lc_forefoot_warm in 4.3) and gets no extra sheen: the reference skin is matte with no specular spot. tone_anklet_glow is not made an independent glow layer: the reference halo beside the pendant bead and crystal is only +3-4 levels (fbece1 vs fae6dd) and narrower than 2 px, i.e. the anti-aliased bright fringe of the beads/crystal themselves (right_anklet's own rendering), and the instep highlight already lightens that area; nothing follows the crystal on the skin.

path.desc: Warm rim light just inside the outer contour from ~y 1428 to the toe-root seam (~1461), following tone_outer_rim_light: reference shows a bright strip fce9de-fce6db 1-2 px inside the outline (x 436-440, y 1436-1456) against the side plane f9e4d8. Hidden outer contour stroked 7 px (outer half clipped, ~3.5 px inside so it shows just past the current contour brush, which reaches ~2.5 px inside the fill edge), #fdeade 0.75, fading in over ~10 px at the top and out at the seam (continues on the toes if they show it). Slightly soft (blur 0.6); the contour brush sits on top, leaving the strip just inside the line. Same family as the shin's warm outer rim.

foot_body visible outer (image-left, little-toe side) silhouette. Starts at (445.6,1370.4) where it continues the right_shin outer outline (shin ink runs above; this line picks it up at the ankle so the ankle-to-foot edge reads as one stroke), passes the slight outer ankle-bone bulge (x~444, y 1372-1380, under the anklet left bead at ~446,1376), then runs as a long gently convex line down-left along the side of the foot to (425.8,1463) at the root of the little toe, where it hands over to the toes group outline (the little toe outer edge continues it). Final ink: line-reference shows a firm dark line ~2.0 px, slightly thinner (~1.4 px) at the start where it overlaps the shin stroke end; taper out over the last ~4 px at the toe root so it overlaps the toe outline without a blob. Clear from y 1381 to 1458; y 1371-1381 is crossed by the anklet beads (hidden under them, ink may stop at bead edges). Hard edge, matches the fill boundary exactly (closed by the fill path).

foot_body visible inner (image-right, big-toe side) silhouette. Starts at (488.4,1370.5) continuing the right_shin inner outline, passes the inner ankle bulge (x~489-490, y 1372-1382, under the anklet right bead) and runs nearly straight, very slightly outward, down to (494.6,1465) at the big-toe root, where the big toe outline (toes group) continues it down to ~y 1490. Final ink: firm line ~1.8-2.0 px as in line-reference, thinner start overlapping the shin stroke, short taper at the bottom handover. Clear from y 1383 to 1460; anklet covers y 1371-1383. Hard edge, same as the fill boundary.

Hidden ankle cap: the near-semicircular top (peak 467,1358.5; ends at the outer and inner contour starts y~1370.5) lying over the shin's lower end. Joint overlap for ankle rotation, same skin as the shin, so this seam is never inked and stays invisible (soft, colour-matched). Sides at y 1358-1370 sit just inside the shin silhouette, so the shin outline stays the visible edge there.

Junction with the toes group: lower edge of foot_body along the ball of the foot / toe roots, from (425.8,1463) through the tops of the toe gaps (~437,1460; 449,1462; 460,1465; 474,1463) to (494.6,1465). The toes group continues ~9 px up beneath this edge, so the seam is internal skin and never inked; the short dark toe-gap strokes that start here (line-reference y~1465-1472) belong to the toes group. Expected reveal: when toes curl or spread the edge stays over continuous toe-root skin; nothing behind it opens.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body internal structure lines (3.2), thin position guides (#3a2a2a, 0.5-0.6 px). The line-reference has no inked interior lines on the foot body (only the toe-gap strokes, which belong to the toes group), so every line here is a structure/shade boundary for later shading and none is inked in the final; anklet and crystal drop lie over the upper instep.

path.desc: Outer ankle bone (lateral malleolus) on the image-left side: shallow convex arc from (447.2,1360.5) under the shin overlap, bulging inward to x~451.6 at y~1374.5 and closing back toward the outer contour at (448.6,1385.4). Continues legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_ankle_bones (outer pocket x 446-455, y 1351-1369) across the ankle seam so the bone reads as one form when the foot rotates. Use: separates the bone bump from the hollow in front of it; final display only as a soft shade edge (no ink), fading in at the top and out at the bottom; middle y 1366-1380 slightly firmer. Upper part y 1360-1370 lies under the shin cap and is expected to show only during ankle rotation; lower part partly under the anklet left beads (x 446-452, y 1374-1386). Soft edge. Not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): also a shade boundary. Between this line and foot_body_outer_contour (x 444-451, y 1359-1386) is the outer ankle hollow shade, closed as foot_body_tone_outer_ankle_pocket; to its right is the lit ankle front (base/light skin). Self shading from the bone turning away from the light.

Inner ankle bone (medial malleolus) on the image-right side: mirror of outer_malleolus but slightly higher and narrower, from (486.4,1359.8) bulging inward to x~482.4 at y~1374 and back toward the inner contour at (486.0,1384.2). Continues the shin inner ankle pocket (x 478-484, y 1350-1369). Soft shade edge only, no ink; fades at both ends, firmest y 1366-1378. Top part hidden under the shin cap (reveals on rotation), lower end under the anklet right beads. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): also a shade boundary. Between this line and foot_body_inner_contour (x 482-489, y 1359-1384) is the inner ankle hollow shade, closed as foot_body_tone_inner_ankle_pocket; to its left is the lit ankle front.

Ankle flexion fold across the front of the ankle where the shin front turns into the instep, from just inside the outer malleolus (454.5,1389.5) sagging to y~1394 at the centre and rising to (482.0,1389.6) by the inner malleolus. Connects the lower ends of both malleolus lines. Mostly lies under the anklet chain (beads y 1384-1405), visible between beads. Use: top boundary of the instep plane and the hinge of ankle dorsiflexion. Final: very faint soft tone break only, no ink; centre third slightly stronger, both ends fade out. Soft edge. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

Crest of the instep (dorsum), the highest line of the foot top: from the ankle centre under the anklet pendant bead (468,1397) running down and slightly toward the big-toe side to (478.6,1456.5) just above the second/big-toe root. Separates the lit top plane (inner half, reference lighter x 465-490) from the plane rolling toward the outer side. Passes under the crystal drop (x 461-470, y 1405-1428). Final: no ink; it is the axis of the top-plane highlight in later shading, soft and fading at both ends, strongest y 1420-1445. Tone (3.3): runs inside foot_body_tone_instep_highlight, toward its image-right half; the highlight is brightest just left of this ridge (x 462-475, y 1425-1452) and fades toward both side turns. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

Turn from the top plane to the outer (little-toe) side plane: from below the outer malleolus (452.6,1395) running down-left roughly parallel to the outer contour, 9-12 px inside it, to (435.8,1458.5) above the 4th/5th toe roots. The band between this line and the outer contour is the darker side plane in the reference (x 430-445, y 1420-1460). Final: soft shade boundary only, no ink; fades in at the top under the anklet and fades out 3-4 px before the toe-root seam. Soft edge. Tone (3.3): also the inner edge of foot_body_tone_outer_side_shade; left of it (to the outer contour) is the outer side shade, right of it base/lit top plane. Soft, ~3 px gradient toward image-right. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

Turn from the top plane to the inner (arch) side plane on the big-toe side: from below the inner malleolus (484.6,1394.5) down, 4-6 px inside the inner contour, to (489.6,1460) above the big-toe root. Narrow darker inner side band (reference x 487-493). Final: soft shade boundary, no ink, fades at both ends. Soft edge. Tone (3.3): also the inner edge of foot_body_tone_inner_side_shade; right of it (to the inner contour) is the narrow inner side shade, left of it the lit top plane. Soft, ~2 px gradient toward image-left. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

Ball-of-foot line (metatarsal heads): gentle arc across the foot 5-9 px above the toe-root seam, from the outer side (429,1455.5) to the inner side (492.6,1458.4). Marks where the top plane rolls forward into the toe roots; the toes group bends from here. Final: very faint soft tone step (slightly shaded below), no ink; ends fade into the side planes. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): the reference shows almost no tone step here (G 229-231 on both sides); kept as an auxiliary line only, no fill relation; at most a very faint shade under it handed to shading. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body main light/dark ranges (3.3), simple hidden dashed guide loops in the shin convention. Light from upper image-right/front. Self shading: outer and inner ankle hollows, outer and inner side planes; lit instep top plane; outer rim light near the toes. External: a light halo from the right_anklet gem (rendering stack). The reference foot is very evenly lit (G 227-233), so all ranges are weak, soft-edged steps.

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body. Outer ankle hollow shade, closed region: right edge = foot_body_struct_outer_malleolus (446.8,1359.2)-(448.6,1385.4); left edge runs just outside foot_body_outer_contour (x 443-446), closed by it (the overflow is clipped by the fill). Top starts under the ankle dome/shin overlap (hidden, revealed on ankle rotation); bottom ends under the right_anklet outer beads. Source: self shading, the lateral malleolus and ankle side turning from the upper-right light; reference stretch shows it as the darker band beside the lit ankle front (G ~211-219 vs 231). Continues legs_right_leg_right_shin_tone_ankle_pockets on the shin so the hollow reads continuous across the hidden seam. Soft edge, ~2 px gradient toward image-right; firmest y 1364-1380, fades into the outer side shade below the anklet. Final: absorbed into shading (colour fill), no line.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body. Inner ankle hollow shade, closed region: left edge = foot_body_struct_inner_malleolus (486.6,1359)-(486.0,1384.2); right edge just outside foot_body_inner_contour (x 488.6-490), closed by it. Top hidden under the dome/shin overlap, bottom under the right_anklet inner beads. Source: self shading of the medial malleolus side (reference G ~184-219 near the inner edge at y 1378-1390). Continues the shin inner ankle pocket. Soft edge, ~2 px gradient toward image-left; fades at top and bottom. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body. Outer (little-toe) side plane shade, closed region: inner edge = foot_body_struct_outer_side_turn (452.6,1395)-(435.8,1458.5); outer edge runs along/just outside foot_body_outer_contour from ~(443,1388) to (426.4,1462.4), closed by the contour; top joins the outer ankle pocket under the anklet beads; bottom closes at the toe-root seam (foot_body_toe_root_seam), where the toes group takes over. Source: self shading, the side plane turned away from the upper-right light (reference mottled G ~227-228 vs 230-232 on the top plane, a weak step). 8-12 px wide, widest y 1420-1450. Very soft edge, ~3-4 px gradient toward image-right; inside it the outer rim light strip (foot_body_tone_outer_rim_light) sits along the contour near the toes. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body. Lighter rim strip along the outer contour near the toes, closed thin region ~1.5-2 px wide, 0.5 px inside foot_body_outer_contour, from (434.3,1428) to the toe-root seam at (427.2,1461). Source: rim/edge light on the outer side (reference stretch shows a bright strip there, G ~231 against the 227-228 side shade); same family as the warm rim on the shin. Fades in at the top over ~6 px, ends at the toe-root seam (continued on the toes group if they show it). Soft edge. Final: colour accent (light warm skin) inside the side shade, no line.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body. Inner (big-toe/arch) side shade, narrow closed region: inner edge = foot_body_struct_inner_side_turn (484.6,1394.5)-(489.6,1460); outer edge along/just outside foot_body_inner_contour, closed by it; top joins the inner ankle pocket under the anklet beads, bottom closes at the toe-root seam. Source: self shading, inner side turning from the light; reference G ~228-229 near the edge with a slightly darker 1-2 px edge at y 1380-1440. 3-5 px wide. Soft edge, ~2 px gradient toward image-left. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body. Lit instep (top plane) highlight, closed soft region x 459-482, y 1400-1457, centred around foot_body_struct_instep_ridge (ridge on its image-right half). Upper part y 1400-1430 is overlapped by the right_anklet pendant and crystal drop. Source: self lighting of the top plane facing the upper-right light (reference G ~231-233 vs 229-230). Very soft edge, ~4 px gradient on all sides; brightest x 462-475, y 1425-1452; fades out toward the toe-root seam and the side turns. Final: absorbed into shading (slightly lighter skin), no line.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body (receiver). Bright halo on the skin around the anklet pendant bead and crystal drop, closed region x 455-480, y 1392-1433. Source: light from another part, the gem/crystal of right_anklet (caster) lighting or reflecting onto foot_body (receiver); reference G up to ~240-248 next to the bead vs 230 base. Doubt: this may be part of the anklet's own glow rendering rather than skin tone; to be decided in rendering stack. No clear cast shadow under the chain or crystal is visible in the reference (doubt kept: any anklet occlusion is left to rendering stack). Very soft edge, ~3-5 px radial fade. Final: handed to the rendering stack as an independent light layer; on foot_body only a slight lightening. Highlights (4.6): decided not to register an independent glow layer; the halo is the anklet beads/crystal anti-aliased fringe (+3-4 levels, <2 px) and the area is already lightened by volume_instep_highlight.

g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body details (3.4), shin convention (hidden detail colour lines). The line-reference has no interior lines on the foot body and the reference skin is smooth: only the two silhouette rims are needed. The faint mottling on the instep in a contrast-stretched crop is compression/soft shading, not tendons or texture, so no tendon or texture lines are drawn. Toe gaps belong to the toes group; anklet chain and crystal belong to right_anklet.

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body. Light skin rim ~1 px inside foot_body_outer_contour, from (444.6,1372) under the right_anklet outer beads (and the hidden ankle continuation up to the dome) down to (426.8,1461) at the toe-root seam, where the toes group continues it. Purpose: the 1 px pale rim the reference shows along the outer silhouette (RGB ~252,230,220 right inside the dark contour, vs 248,225,215 base); continues legs_right_leg_right_shin_detail_rim_outer across the ankle seam in tone, though lighter (the shin rim is warm pink, the foot outer rim is pale). Final: kept as a soft light colour line, not a dark line. Weight 0.6, solid y 1395-1458, faded start under the anklet beads (y 1372-1392, blank where beads cover), fades over the last ~2 px at the seam. Soft inner edge into foot_body_tone_outer_side_shade, overlapping foot_body_tone_outer_rim_light near the toes. Not a fill boundary.

Part legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body. Warm pink skin rim ~1-1.5 px inside foot_body_inner_contour, from (488.6,1372) under the right_anklet inner beads down to (493.2,1462) at the toe-root seam. Purpose: warm (subsurface-like) edge on the inner side of the foot from the reference (RGB ~240,192,175 at y 1400, 219,178,163 at y 1420), same family as legs_right_leg_right_shin_detail_rim_inner, which it continues across the ankle. Final: kept as a soft warm colour line, not dark. Weight 0.7 at y 1395-1425 (strongest), thinning to 0.4 below y 1435 and fading out by y 1450, blank to the seam except a faint trace; faded start under the anklet beads (blank where beads cover). Soft inner edge into foot_body_tone_inner_side_shade. Not a fill boundary.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothstep easing; start/end tapers realised as smoothstep pressure ramps over the stated lengths, built-in taper options off); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/right_leg/right_foot/foot_body brush strokes (3.5), neutral check colours at 3.5 (#3a3a3a ink, #8a8a8a soft lines), recoloured in 4.7. Inked: outer and inner silhouette. Soft: both malleolus shade edges and the two rims, clipped to the foot_body fill. Not stroked (hidden guides, kept with descs): fill boundary, ankle and toe-root seams, ankle crease, instep ridge, side turns, metatarsal arc, all tone loops. Final colours (4.7): outline #5c3533 continuous with the shin; malleolus edges warm pink #e0aaa2; outer rim pink at the ankle turning pale #fde9df toward the toes; inner rim warm #e2a69c.

path.desc: Brush for foot_body_outer_contour (outer silhouette ink): perfect_freehand size 1.18, thinning 0.7; pressure 0.7 (~1.5 px) at the start over the shin stroke end, rising to 1.0 (~2.0 px) by y~1386 and held to the toe root; taper start 3 px, taper end 4 px into the toe outline. Fades in over the first ~2 px (opacity 0 to 1) so it joins the shin outline without a blob; solid through the anklet crossing (the anklet beads paint over it). Hard edge, unclipped. Neutral check colour; final colour later. Line colour (4.7): #5c3533, the same dark warm brown as legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_outer_brush so the silhouette runs on unbroken across the ankle; reference outline here reads dark red-brown (291110-825e59 core with a warm e7c1b9 fringe at y 1436-1452). Width, tapers and opacity ramps unchanged.

Brush for foot_body_inner_contour (inner silhouette ink): size 1.12, thinning 0.7; pressure 0.7 (~1.4 px) at the start over the shin stroke end, 1.0 (~1.9 px) from y~1388 to the big-toe root; taper start 3 px, end 4 px into the big-toe outline. Fades in over the first ~2 px; solid under the anklet beads. Hard edge, unclipped. Neutral check colour. Line colour (4.7): #5c3533, matching legs_right_leg_right_shin_line_inner_brush; geometry and ramps unchanged.

Brush for foot_body_struct_outer_malleolus: soft shade-edge stroke (no ink), size 1.0, thinning 0.6, pressure 0.3 at the ends rising to 0.8 over y 1366-1380; opacity fades in from 0 and out to 0 along the curve (max ~0.35 in the middle); taper 4 px both ends. Upper part lies in the hidden overlap under the shin cap, lower end under the anklet beads. Gaussian blur 0.5 (soft edge), clipped to the foot_body fill. Final: merged into the ankle hollow shading (foot_body_tone_*_ankle_pocket); neutral check colour. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e0aaa2 (ends #e6b3ab), max 0.32, the same family as legs_right_leg_right_shin_struct_ankle_bones_brush; over the pocket it gives ~f1d1c9 against the reference bone edge f5d8d1-f6dad3, staying soft.

Brush for foot_body_struct_inner_malleolus: soft shade-edge stroke (no ink), size 1.0, thinning 0.6, pressure 0.3 at the ends rising to 0.8 over y 1366-1378; opacity fades in from 0 and out to 0 along the curve (max ~0.35 in the middle); taper 4 px both ends. Upper part lies in the hidden overlap under the shin cap, lower end under the anklet beads. Gaussian blur 0.5 (soft edge), clipped to the foot_body fill. Final: merged into the ankle hollow shading (foot_body_tone_*_ankle_pocket); neutral check colour. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e0aaa2 (ends #e6b3ab), max 0.32, as the outer malleolus; reference inner bone edge f1d6cb-f1d6c9.

Brush for foot_body_detail_rim_outer (pale rim inside the outer silhouette): size 0.55, thinning 0.6, pressure 0.4 under the anklet beads rising to 1.0 (~0.6 px) by y~1396, easing off over the last 2 px at the toe-root seam. Opacity blank y 1372-1388 (under beads), fades in to 0.55 by y~1395, solid to y~1458, fades out at the seam. Blur 0.3, clipped to the foot_body fill. Final: light colour accent line; neutral check colour for now (final pale skin #f6e2da-ish). Colour (4.7), split along the stroke: warm pink #eab7af 0.5 near the ankle (y ~1395-1415, continuing the shin rim #e2a29c softly, reference outer edge pinkish there), blending through #f2ccc4 to pale skin #fde9df 0.6 from y ~1428 to the seam, where it joins foot_body_hl_outer_rim as the bright strip inside the line (reference fce9de-fce6db).

Brush for foot_body_detail_rim_inner (warm rim inside the inner silhouette): size 0.65, thinning 0.6, pressure 1.0 (~0.7 px) over y 1395-1425, thinning to ~0.55 (~0.4 px) below y 1440. Opacity blank under the anklet beads (y 1372-1386), fades in to 0.6 by y~1395, solid to ~1425, fades out to 0 by ~1450, blank to the seam. Blur 0.3, clipped to the foot_body fill. Final: warm colour line (#e9a898-ish); neutral check colour for now. Colour (4.7): warm #e2a69c 0.6 over y 1395-1425 easing to #e4ab9f and fading by ~1450, the shin inner rim family (#e2a29c); reference inner edge ecc8ba/e7c2b1 at x 485 y 1388-1398.

g.desc: 独立投影层（登记见 structure/rendering.json：owner legs/right_leg/right_thigh，follow legs/left_leg，clip_to right_thigh + right_shin）。legs/left_leg 贴靠时在右大腿内侧与膝内侧（受影可见约 x 494-506，y 986-1060）造成的柔和接触遮挡。参考取样：接触带 #f3d6cb–#f2d6cb，旁边自身暗带外为 #f5d9d0；投影只做很轻的暖色乘色加深，无硬边。疑问：自身转折和接触遮挡的比例仍是估计，legs_right_leg_right_thigh_tone_inner_shade 的自身暗带保持不变。

path.desc: 投影主体：内缘沿腿内侧轮廓内约 2-3px 起（x≈502-504），向画面右侧越过轮廓延伸到 x 516、上下延伸到 y 978/1068，作双腿相对运动时的余量，超出部分留给后置蒙版裁切。乘色核心 #faf2ee（合成后接触带约 #f4d5cb–#f3d1c8，参考 #f3d6cb–#f3d7cb），3px 高斯软边向画面左侧衰减约 6px；上下端因参考中双腿在 y≈980 以上与 y≈1062 以下分开而自然淡出。

Part legs/right_leg/right_anklet/front_chain fill: four closed overlapping subpaths (nonzero) forming one continuous region. (1) Left arm bead string from the left end bead (446,1375) down-right through 4 oval links (centres ~448,1381 / 451,1386 / 455,1391 / 460,1397) to the V apex ~(464.6,1401.6) under center_bead; (2) right arm mirrored from the right end bead (488,1377) through links ~485,1382 / 482,1387 / 478,1392 / 473,1397 to ~(467.4,1401.6); (3)(4) the two slightly larger blue end beads at the ankle edges (r~2.7 / 2.6), overlapping the arm starts and the back_chain ends. Width ~4.4 px at link centres, pinched ~2.7 px between links (scalloped outline from the reference). Both arms end ~1.5 px under center_bead (internal seam). Visible in full; fill colour is a temporary pearl tone, base colour later. [Brush stage] End-bead subpaths re-wound to the same direction as the arm subpaths so the nonzero overlap no longer cancels (previously a skin-coloured hole showed where each arm entered its end bead). [Base colour 4.1] Base colour pearl white-lavender #eef1f9 (reference link cores #f3fafb-#fdfdfb, pinch/rim #b5c3e0 belongs to the later shade step); the two end beads are a different material (blue glass) and get their own base patch front_chain_base_end_beads on top of this fill.

Part legs/right_leg/right_anklet/front_chain, material zone: the two end beads at the ankle edges (left centre ~446.1,1375.4 r2.75; right ~488.2,1376.6 r2.6), same circles as the last two subpaths of front_chain_fill and closed by front_chain_line_end_bead_left/right. Base colour pale blue glass #b9dcf6 from the reference (left bead #bed9f5-#bee3fa, right bead lit side #9cc4df). Sits above the pearl fill and below the brush strokes; covers the arm starts and the back_chain ends that pass under them. Rotates with the chain; when the ankle turns the full circle keeps the same base colour.

Part front_chain, left arm upper (inside-of-V) edge, from the left end bead ~(447.5,1374) along the scalloped link tops to ~(465.5,1400.5) where it goes under center_bead. Use: visible outline of the bead string; final: thin ~0.6-0.7 px pale blue-grey line, slightly lighter on the lit pinches, breaks allowed at the pinches between links; start hidden under the end bead, end under center_bead. Medium-soft edge. Bounds the left arm fill.

Part front_chain, left arm lower (outside-of-V) edge, from under the left end bead ~(444.8,1376.5) to ~(463.6,1402.6) under center_bead. Use: visible outline, a touch heavier (~0.7 px) than the top edge as the shadow side over the skin; breaks allowed at link pinches. Medium-soft edge. Bounds the left arm fill.

Part front_chain, right arm lower/outer edge (normal side of the image-right arm), from under the right end bead ~(489.5,1377.5) to ~(468.4,1402.6) under center_bead. Use: visible outline, ~0.7 px, breaks allowed at pinches. Medium-soft edge. Bounds the right arm fill.

Part front_chain, right arm upper (inside-of-V) edge, from ~(486.7,1375.7) under the right end bead to ~(466.4,1400.6) under center_bead. Use: visible outline, ~0.6 px, lighter; breaks allowed at pinches. Medium-soft edge. Bounds the right arm fill.

Part front_chain, left end bead (image-left ankle edge) closed ring ~(446.1,1375.4) r 2.75: its outer half sits on the shin outer contour and stays visible against the background; inner half overlaps the left arm start and the back_chain end. Use: visible bead outline; final: ~0.7 px blue-grey, fades/breaks where it meets the arm top edge. Medium edge.

Part front_chain, right end bead ~(488.2,1376.6) r 2.6, on the inner (image-right) ankle edge, partly over the shin inner contour. Same use and weight as the left end bead ring; break where it meets the arm edges. Medium edge.

Part front_chain, left (image-left) arm, link seam 1 at the pinch ~(447.2,1378.4) between two adjacent oval links, crossing the bead string from edge to edge (~2.6 px), slightly bowed toward the V apex so the lower link reads as overlapping the upper one. Use: internal structure separating the oval links (link-to-link joint, matches the pinch of the scalloped outline). Final: kept as a short thin (~0.4 px) blue-grey tick, darkest at the two outline contacts, the middle ~0.8 px left open/faded as the pale pearl highlight; soft edge. [Tone stage] The reference shows radial rim shading rather than a top/bottom split, so this line is downgraded to auxiliary only: it marks where the rim band is ~1 step deeper on the lower/outer side; the actual light zones are the tone_*_link_core ovals.

path.desc: Part legs/right_leg/right_anklet/crystal_drop fill, closed. Narrow neck x 465.35-466.65 from y 1402.4 (bead centre, hidden under center_bead) to the visible tip ~y1406.3, then the rigid diamond: rounded shoulders widening to the widest point y~1417.5 (x 461.6-470.15), straight-ish lower facets converging to the bottom tip (465.8,1427.5). Visible outline aligned with the reference crystal. Expected exposure: when the drop swings about the bead pivot, the neck between y 1402.4 and 1406 can show ~1-2 px beside the bead; keep the same material there. Temporary fill colour; base colour later. [Base colour 4.1] Base colour clear sky-blue glass #a4cff0 (reference mid facets #9ec5e8-#a0d1f1; centre #d8f0f5 is the highlight band, lower #86b9e5-#91bcdc is the pavilion shade, both later steps). Corrects the temporary #8fc6ec which was too saturated/dark.

Part crystal_drop, visible diamond outline, from the right side of the top tip (467,1406.3) down the right shoulder to the widest point (470.15,1417.5), down to the bottom tip (465.8,1427.5), up the left side via (461.6,1417.5) back to (464.7,1406.3). Use: visible outline; final ~0.7 px, deeper blue on the lower facets, lighter on the lit upper-left shoulder; sharp turns at the side and bottom tips; open at the top where it meets the neck under center_bead. Hard edge (rigid gem).

Part crystal_drop, the two short neck sides from y 1402.4 (under center_bead) to the tip at y~1406.3. Use: mostly hidden under center_bead; visible only when the drop swings; final: very thin (~0.4 px) soft lines continuing the outline. Soft edge.

Part crystal_drop, central ridge from the top tip (466.0,1406.3) down through the girdle (465.9,1418.2) to the bottom tip (465.8,1427.5), slightly bowed right in the upper half. Use: main face boundary of the faceted gem; left faces lit (base image shows a pale vertical highlight just left of centre), right faces deeper blue. Final: kept, thin ~0.4 px light cyan-white line, sharp; solid between y1409 and y1424, fading into both tips. Hard edge. Fill: splits the crystal into left (lit) and right (shade) facet regions, both closed by the outline. [Tone stage] Also the axis of crystal_drop_tone_highlight_band; light peaks on and just left of the ridge.

Part crystal_drop, girdle across the widest point from the left corner (461.6,1417.5) through the ridge (465.9,1418.2) to the right corner (470.15,1417.5), bowed slightly down (seen from above). Use: crown/pavilion face boundary of the diamond; upper facets lighter, lower facets darker. Final: kept but lighter than the outline, ~0.35 px, faded in the ~1 px around the ridge crossing; hard edge. Fill: closes the four facet regions (upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right) with the ridge and outline. [Tone stage] Above it = lighter crown facets; below, down to crystal_drop_tone_lower_shade, a transition strip.

Part crystal_drop, upper-left inner facet line from just below the top tip ~(464.7,1407.4) curving down to ~(464.6,1416.9) above the girdle. Use: bright table facet edge on the lit side (matches the highlight streak in the base image). Final: not inked as dark line; becomes the boundary of a white-cyan highlight facet between it and the ridge; fades at both ends. Hard-medium edge.

Part crystal_drop, lower-right pavilion facet line from below the girdle ~(467.6,1419.0) to ~(466.6,1425.6) near the bottom tip. Use: dark reflected facet on the shadow side. Final: soft boundary of the deepest blue facet, not inked; fades at both ends. Medium edge. [Tone stage] Bounds the deepest shade pocket (lower-right) together with crystal_drop_tone_lower_shade and the outline.

Part crystal_drop, central light band: closed spindle from ~(465.7,1408.6) below the top tip, widest ~2.8 px at y~1417 (x 464.4-467.2), closing at ~(465.7,1421.6) just below the girdle; it straddles crystal_drop_struct_ridge and peaks (~243) at y~1418 where it meets crystal_drop_struct_girdle. Source: light transmitted/reflected through the gem centre (self). Inside = lightest cyan-white; outside up to the outline = mid blue facets (left slightly lighter than right). Soft edge ~0.6 px, hardest along the ridge crossing. Final: colour fields take over; auxiliary only. Closed on itself.

Part crystal_drop, upper boundary of the lower (pavilion) shade: from the left outline ~(462.1,1419.7) to the highlight band bottom ~(465.0,1421.0), and from ~(466.4,1421.0) to the right outline ~(469.55,1419.4); ~2 px below the girdle. Source: self-shading of the downward facets (base-subject ~174-190 below y1420 vs ~200-230 above). Region below, closed by the outline down to the bottom tip = darker blue; deepest pocket lower-right between this line and crystal_drop_struct_facet_lr. Soft edge ~0.8 px blend upward. Final: merges into the tone painting; auxiliary only. Open at the highlight band where light runs down the centre.

Part crystal_drop, small shadow at the top tip under center_bead: arc from ~(465.1,1406.9) to ~(466.7,1406.9), 0.6 px below the tip. Source: cast shadow from center_bead (caster) onto crystal_drop (receiver) plus the bail connection; base-subject shows ~185 here. Region above to the neck/bead = dark. Hard-ish edge ~0.3 px. Final: merges into the tone painting; when the drop swings the shadow stays attached to the pivot under the bead. Auxiliary only. 4.5.1: registered as independent layer right_anklet_bead_cast_shadow_on_crystal (owner crystal_drop, follow center_bead, clip_to crystal_drop); no self-volume was painted for it. No other cast shadow found: the chains and drop cast no visible shadow on the shin skin in base-subject.

Part crystal_drop, four-point glint centred on the ridge/girdle crossing ~(465.8,1418.0): vertical stroke y1416.6-1419.4 (~2.8 px), horizontal stroke x464.85-466.75 (~1.9 px). Use: gem sparkle at the brightest spot of crystal_drop_tone_highlight_band (base-subject peak ~243 here). Final: kept as a white/very pale cyan glint, each arm thickest at the centre (~0.4 px) tapering to a sharp point, no dark ink; centre hard, arm tips fade out the last ~0.4 px. Fill: none (overlay mark on the highlight band). Moves rigidly with the drop.

Part crystal_drop, thin vertical light streak from ~(465.95,1409.4) below the top tip down to ~(466.2,1416.3) just above the sparkle, running beside crystal_drop_struct_ridge on its right inside the highlight band. Use: reflected light line along the upper facet (visible in base-subject as a pale streak). Final: kept as a pale white line, ~0.3 px, starting at a faint point, strongest at y~1414-1416, fading into the sparkle; soft edge. Fill: none, sits inside the highlight band.
Part crystal_drop: pavilion (lower facets) shade below crystal_drop_tone_lower_shade (#8ebde3; reference #91bcdc), closed by the outline to the bottom tip; 0.55 px soft upper edge.
Part crystal_drop: left pavilion facet a little lighter than the right (#9bc3e3, reference #98bddf at 464,1424), the transition between the lit left and the deep lower-right pocket.
Part crystal_drop: deepest lower-right pavilion facet (#80b3df; reference #86b9e5), between tone_lower_shade, struct_facet_lr and the outline; soft edge.

Part crystal_drop: upper-right crown facets a little darker than the left (#9ac7ec vs base #a4cff0; reference #9ec5e8 right / #a0d1f1 left), bounded by the ridge, girdle and outline; soft 0.35 px edge.
Part crystal_drop: transition halo around the central light band (band shape widened 1.9x, #b2d6f1, reference #b7d0e7 at 463,1414) between the band and the side facets.

Part crystal_drop: central light band (light through the gem), shape of crystal_drop_tone_highlight_band, #c6e5f8 (reference #beddf5 upper, #d8f0f5 at the girdle); 0.35 px soft edge. The sparkle/specular is a 4.6 job.

ellipse.desc: Part crystal_drop: local cyan-white at the girdle where light passes through the gem (reference #d8f0f5 at 466,1418) - slightly greener and less saturated than the blue band above.

path.desc: Part crystal_drop: faint dark facet edge along the centre ridge (struct_ridge); upper part is mostly hidden under the light band, lower part reads as the pavilion keel. #83b1dc 55%%.
Part crystal_drop: soft dark seam along the girdle (struct_girdle) separating crown and pavilion, #8ab8e0 50%%.
Part crystal_drop: lower-right facet edge darkened slightly where the deepest pocket meets the keel (struct_facet_lr), #78aada 55%%.

ellipse.desc: Part crystal_drop: neck/bail of the drop, a small self-dark where it narrows into the bead (separate from the bead cast shadow, which stays for 4.5).

path.desc: Part crystal_drop: vertical light streak through the crown (detail_light_streak); reference brightens from #d1e9f5 to #ddf0f5 down to the girdle.

ellipse.desc: Part crystal_drop: brightest sparkle at the girdle centre (reference #ebf8f5 at 465,1418). Soft core at the crossing of detail_sparkle.

path.desc: Part crystal_drop: a small four-point glint on the sparkle (detail_sparkle), kept tiny so it reads as a glass glint without starring.

ellipse.desc: Part crystal_drop: light passing through just below the girdle (reference #dff3f6 at 465,1419) before the pavilion darkens.

path.desc: Part crystal_drop: faint rim light along the lower-left facet edge (reference #9cbddc-#a2bfdc slightly lifted against #92bde0 inside).

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothstep easing); source curves kept hidden in this part (display=none), see data-source-curve; line colour set in 4.7 to same-hue darks of the adjacent colour fields (pearl lavender-blue for the chain and bead, glass blue for the crystal, pale cyan-white for the crystal ridge, sparkle and light streak); tone_* and turn/highlight/facet guide lines stay hidden for colour fields

path.data-brush-role: 晶坠外轮廓 0.75px 硬边：下刻面加重、左上受光肩减轻，侧角与底尖锐利转折，顶部在中心珠下开口收尖
晶坠颈侧 0.4px 软边，大部分在中心珠下，摆动时才露出
晶坠颈侧 0.4px 软边，大部分在中心珠下，摆动时才露出
中脊 0.4px 硬边：y1409–1424 实线，向两尖端渐隐（成稿为浅青白线，线色此处暂用中性色）
腰线 0.35px 硬边，比外轮廓淡；与中脊交叉处约 1px 留白
腰线 0.35px 硬边，比外轮廓淡；与中脊交叉处约 1px 留白
四芒闪光：每臂中心 0.4px、两端锐尖，中心硬、末端 0.4px 渐隐（成稿为白色，暂用中性色）
四芒闪光：每臂中心 0.4px、两端锐尖，中心硬、末端 0.4px 渐隐（成稿为白色，暂用中性色）
光线条 0.3px 软边：起笔淡、y1414–1416 最强、收入闪光（成稿浅白，暂用中性色）

g.desc: 独立投影层（4.5.1 登记，4.5.2 绘制）：center_bead 挡光投在 crystal_drop 顶尖与挂环下方；follow center_bead，clip_to crystal_drop。放在 crystal_drop 之后、center_bead 之前。

path.desc: Shadow of center_bead on the crystal tip and loop. Multiply #c4cde6, which turns the crystal blue #a4cff0 to about #a1bee2 (reference 1405-1406). The lower edge follows crystal_drop_tone_top_shadow at about y1407.5-1408.5, softened by a 0.35 px blur. The shape reaches up under the bead and about 1.5 px wider than the neck on each side, leaving room for the drop to swing; the later mask clips it to crystal_drop.
A soft penumbra below the core, multiply #dde3f0, fading out by about y1410 (reference 1409 #a9cdec is only slightly darker than the light band below).

Part legs/right_leg/right_anklet/center_bead fill, closed circle centre (466.0,1402.8) r 2.9 (x 463.1-468.9, y 1399.9-1405.7), aligned to the reference bead. Covers the V apex ends of both front_chain arms and the crystal_drop neck (pivot). Fully visible. Temporary fill colour; base colour later. [Base colour 4.1] Base colour pearl white #f4f6fb (reference core #fbfcf7, rim #c3c7d6 / lower #aec9e7 are shade/reflection for later steps); same material family as the chain links, slightly whiter.

Part center_bead, closed outer ring of the round bead. Use: visible outline, final ~0.7 px blue-grey, a little heavier at the lower edge (shadow side above the crystal), slightly broken at the upper-left highlight; closed. Medium edge. Matches the center_bead fill.

Part center_bead, light/shade turn of the round bead: arc from the left rim ~(463.3,1403.8) bowing down-right through ~(465.8,1404.9) to the right rim ~(468.6,1402.0). Use: sphere turn; upper-left lit white pearl, lower-right cool shadow above the crystal. Final: not inked; soft shade boundary fading into the ring at both ends. Very soft edge. Fill: shade region between this arc and the lower-right ring. [Tone stage] Confirmed as the upper boundary of the darkest lower rim of the bead (~181-196 at y1405); region below it, closed by the ring, is the deepest shade; the core is center_bead_tone_core.

Part center_bead, small highlight boundary near the upper-left of the bead from ~(464.2,1402.2) to ~(465.7,1400.6). Use: specular spot on the pearl (base image shows a bright core). Final: not inked; edge of a ~1.2 px white highlight cell, closed visually by the ring; very soft. [Tone stage] Lies inside center_bead_tone_core; marks the brightest specular corner of the core (upper-left). Auxiliary only.

Part center_bead, bottom bail arc where the crystal_drop neck enters the bead, ~(465.0,1405.3) to (467.0,1405.3), 0.5 px above the ring bottom. Use: connection/pivot of the pendant (the drop hangs and swings from here). Final: kept, short ~0.4-0.5 px darker accent, heaviest at the centre where the neck meets, fading at the ends; medium edge. Fill: no region; marks the overlap with crystal_drop.

Part center_bead, highlight core: closed near-circle centre ~(465.6,1402.4) r ~1.5 (x 464.0-467.2, y 1401.0-1403.9), matching the bright core (~250) in base-subject. Source: self-shading of the round bead. Inside = white highlight; ring band between core and center_bead_line_ring = cool blue rim, closed by the ring; lower part of that band below center_bead_struct_turn is the darkest (~185). Soft edge ~0.5 px. Final: colour fields take over; auxiliary only.

Part center_bead, string/drill hole: tiny closed oval centred ~(465.9,1402.5), ~0.7 x 0.65 px, inside center_bead_tone_core just below-right of struct_highlight. Use: decorative detail showing the bead is threaded (base-subject shows a small grey dot at the bead centre; line-reference a faint mark). Final: kept as a tiny soft grey-blue dot (fill-like, ~0.3 px stroke, no taper), not darker than the rim; soft edge. Fill: closed tiny region, filled slightly darker than the white core. Rotates with the bead; no other exposure.
Part center_bead: whole bead laid in the cool rim tone #c9d1e4 (reference rim #c3c7d6).
Part center_bead: lavender transition (#bcc0da, reference #bbbed6 at 468,1404) above the darkest lower rim, softening the step from rim tone to the blue-reflected bottom.

Part center_bead: lower-right darkest part below center_bead_struct_turn (#aec6e4, reference #aec9e7 — the slight blue comes from the crystal and the shade side). Boundary = struct_turn arc, closed by the ring; 0.55 px soft edge.
Part center_bead: lit core, shape of center_bead_tone_core, #f8f9fb (reference #fbfcf7), 0.35 px soft edge.
Part center_bead: small groove of the bail notch at the bottom of the bead where the drop hangs (struct_bail), #a7b4d3 soft 0.8 px.

ellipse.desc: Part center_bead: faint drill-hole dimple at the bead centre (detail_drill_hole), #a9b2cc soft. Kept faint because in the reference the dot could equally be a reflection.

path.desc: Part center_bead: white crescent highlight on the upper left along center_bead_struct_highlight (reference #fcfdf9 at 465,1401). Soft edge, toward the light.

ellipse.desc: Part center_bead: faint bounce light just above the dark lower rim (reference #f5f9f8 / #f7fbf9 at y1404), so the pearl reads round and not flat at the bottom.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothstep easing); source curves kept hidden in this part (display=none), see data-source-curve; line colour set in 4.7 to same-hue darks of the adjacent colour fields (pearl lavender-blue for the chain and bead, glass blue for the crystal, pale cyan-white for the crystal ridge, sparkle and light streak); tone_* and turn/highlight/facet guide lines stay hidden for colour fields

path.data-brush-role: 圆珠外环 0.7px 中硬边：下缘（晶坠上方暗侧）加重到 0.85px，左上高光处断开约 45°，断口两端收尖
吊环弧 0.45px：与晶坠颈相接的中点最重，两端渐细，中边
穿孔小点：0.3px 软边闭合小环，色面略深于白芯；暂以淡中性色显示

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_thigh fill, closed (nonzero union of two pieces cut from the completed left_leg outline: visible thigh and hip joint cap). Top: semicircular hip-joint cap (x 509-626, top y~704) hidden under pelvis/hips, which paints over it down to the bodysuit leg-opening line (crotch ~509,890 to outer hip ~625,814); expected to be exposed only as a thin crescent when the thigh rotates at the hip, so the hidden cap is kept simple. Outer (image-right) edge visible from under the hips lobe (~y 814) down to the knee, aligned to the reference silhouette (hair lies behind the leg). Inner (image-left) edge visible from the crotch (~508,880) along the dark thigh gap to y~970, then the contact seam x~506.2 with the right thigh (y 970-1061); the left thigh lies on top here and the right leg carries the hidden overlap lens. Bottom: shallow rounded joint end y~1080 (sides) to ~1096 (centre) across the knee, overlapping the shin top (y~1010-1034) for the knee bend; internal skin seam under the shin, never stroked, soft blend. Base colour (part_base_colors): bare skin #f9e7de, one material and one inherent-colour zone over the whole fill incl. the hidden hip cap and knee overlap; reference left-thigh mid-tone medians #f9e9e1 (upper) / #f9e8df (mid), knee #f9e4dc (blush is a later layer); shared with left_shin and the right leg so the knee seam and the leg contact seam stay invisible, a hair under pelvis #f9e8df. Material: warm, soft, matte skin with low gloss; the knee blush (warm pink), rim warmth, highlight and shade bands are later shading/colour layers, not base-colour zones.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_thigh big light/dark (4.2): self-shading of the thigh form only, light from the front/upper image-right, as on the right leg. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; all layers soft-edged (Gaussian blur) and clipped to the thigh fill, painted over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: shade bands, then the lit front plane. No cast shadows (left for 4.5), no warm crease stripes (4.4) and no specular dot (4.6). 4.5 check: the reference shows no foreign cast shadow on the thigh (skin under the bodysuit leg opening at y 800-900 stays flat, about #f9e6dc to #fbefe8), so no separate layer is registered. Open question: the darkening on the inner side towards the gap between the legs is still kept as self-shade in inner_shade; it is not certain whether it is really contact occlusion from the right leg.

path.desc: Outer (image-right) turning shade: region between thigh_tone_outer_shade (continued by thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead) and the outer outline, extended past the outline and clipped. ~6px under the hips, widening to ~8-12px at the outer knee; #f8e2d9 at the top deepening to #f5dbd0 at the knee (reference f7e2da-f4ddd5 at y 850 x 604-612, f6dad0 at y 950 x 584, f5ddd2-f4dccf at y 1000 x 568-572). Blur 2.5 for the ~3px soft inner edge. Continues up under the pelvis so motion exposes the same band.

Inner (image-left) turning shade: region from thigh_tone_inner_shade (x~513-516) to the inner outline, ~6-8px wide; #f7ded5 at the crotch to #f5d9cf at the knee contact seam y 970-1061 (reference f3d8cd-f5dfd2 at x 512, f8e0d7 at x 516). Deepened by occlusion in the gap to legs/right_leg but kept as self shade; the left leg lies on top here, so no cast shadow from the right leg. Blur 2.0.

Lit front plane: the closed thigh_tone_highlight_band loop filled #fbede5 (reference f9eae2-f9ebe2 at y 850 x 556-572, fbeee6 at y 950 x 548), blur 3.0 for the ~4-6px soft transition; its left edge follows thigh_struct_front_ridge over y 905-1000. The tip fades out over y 960-976 through the gradient. Upper part runs on under the pelvis for motion.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_thigh transition and local colour (4.3), over the volume layer and under the brush strokes, clipped to the thigh fill; same scheme as the right leg so both legs read as one skin. From the left-leg reference: the outer (image-right) turning shade warms toward peach (f8e5d7-f7e3d6 at y 980) before the edge; a 1-2px pinkish light lies just inside the outer silhouette (fbe6dc-fae0db) ahead of the warm rim line; the inner thigh is pinker near the crotch (crotch area average e4cac2, edge f5d5c7-f4d8cc at y 920); the knee carries a soft pink blush (f6dcd4 average). Big light/shade zones are unchanged.

path.desc: Warm peach transition (#f8e5d5, opacity 0.55, ~5px wide, blur 3) straddling the inner edge of the outer shade band (thigh_tone_outer_shade, image-right): shifts the soft turn from pink-grey toward the warmer yellow-peach of the reference (f8e5d7-f6e0d5 at y 980) without moving the band.

Pinkish edge light just inside the outer silhouette: the hidden outline stroked 5px (about 2.5px falls inside after clipping), #fbe2dc at 0.8, blur 1.0; matches the reference fbe6dc-fae0db between the warm rim line and the shade. Fades in under the pelvis.

Warm pink along the inner silhouette: the hidden inner outline stroked 7px, blur 2.0; strongest near the crotch (#f2cbc5), lighter mid-thigh, pinker again in the knee contact zone. Reference f5d5c7-f4d8cc at y 920, f1cec2 in the contact zone at y 1060.

ellipse.desc: Local pink warmth at the top of the inner thigh under the crotch (centre ~514,878, image-left of the thigh), radial fade, blur 3; continues under the pelvis for motion.

Upper part of the knee blush: the same radial field as shin_lc_knee_blush (centre ~537,1058, 38x50, shared gradient r2s8_legs_left_leg_lc_knee_blush), so colour matches exactly across the thigh/shin overlap. On the thigh only its faint upper fringe shows (opacity under ~0.15 around the specular at y~1015), keeping the knee top light. Blur 3.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_thigh local darks (4.4): only the upper starts of the two kneecap creases (both sides have a thigh lead-in on this leg). Warm pink from the reference, soft, over volume and local colour and under the brush strokes, clipped to the thigh fill. No cast shadows (4.5).

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_shin fill, closed. Top: rounded joint end over the kneecap, y~1034 (sides) to ~1010 (centre), overlapping the thigh bottom for the knee bend (internal seam, never stroked). Outer and inner edges visible from the knee through calf and shin to the ankle, aligned with the reference silhouette; inner edge follows the contact seam x~506.2 down to y~1061 where the knees part. Bottom: rounded joint end y~1399 (sides) to ~1408 (centre), hidden under the left_foot top (foot starts y~1358-1374), ~30-45 px overlap for ankle rotation; internal seam, not stroked. Base colour (part_base_colors): bare skin #f9e7de, one material and one inherent-colour zone over the whole fill incl. the hidden knee and ankle overlaps; reference left-shin mid-tone medians #fae7de (shin) / #f9e6db (ankle); shared with left_thigh and the right leg so the knee seam stays invisible. Material: warm, soft, matte skin with low gloss; the knee blush (warm pink), rim warmth, highlight and shade bands are later shading/colour layers, not base-colour zones.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_shin big light/dark (4.2): self-shading of knee, calf and shin, light from the front/upper image-right. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; soft-edged, clipped to the shin fill, over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: side shade bands, concave mid shade under the kneecap, shallow ankle hollows, then the lit shin front. The warm crease stripes along the kneecap sides are left to 4.4, the knee specular to 4.6, cast shadows (anklet etc.) to 4.5. 4.5 check: in the reference the shin directly above the anklet (y 1364-1382) stays flat at about #fae8dd, with no shadow cast by the anklet, so no separate layer is registered. If an anklet contact shadow is added later, use owner legs/left_leg/left_shin, follow legs/left_leg/left_anklet, clip_to legs/left_leg/left_shin (the anklet group has no drawn part yet).

path.desc: Outer (image-right) calf turning shade: from the outer knee (bounded at the knee top by the upper part of shin_struct_knee_outer, x~560-566) down shin_tone_outer_shade (with shin_struct_calf_turn as its softer inner fade, covered by the blur) to the ankle, extended past the outer outline and clipped. ~6px at the knee, 7-9px at the calf, ~4px above the ankle; #f5dcd1 at the knee top y 1000-1040 (continuing the thigh outer knee shade over the overlap seam), lightening to #f8e2d8 by y~1040 (reference f8e3d9-f7e3d6 at x 564-568), #f8e2d9 on the calf (f8e2d9 at y 1150 x 580), #f6ddd3 near the ankle (f6dbd5 at y 1260 x 560). Blur 2.5.

Inner (image-left) shin turning shade: from the inner slope of the shin top cap (y~1004, continuing the thigh inner shade across the knee seam) and the knee contact line along shin_tone_inner_shade to the inner outline, ~5-7px; #f5dad0 at the knee, #f6ddd3-#f7dfd6 lower (reference f7ded3 at y 1100 x 516, f9e4d8 at y 1200; the darker f1ccc5-f3c8c1 right at the edge is the rim/outline, not this band). Slight occlusion by the gap to legs/right_leg is folded in (uncertain). Blur 2.0.

Concave mid shade under the patella: the closed shin_tone_knee_lower_shade region filled #f5d9d0 (reference f5d8d0-f6dbd3 at y 1070 x 528-548), one step below base. Top edge along shin_struct_knee_top softened by the gradient (opacity 0 at y 1032, 0.6 at ~1051, full by ~1060, a long fade) plus blur 2.0; the bottom tip fades toward ~1094.

Shallow hollows beside both ankle bones: outer pocket (x 546-556, y 1357-1371, marked by shin_struct_ankle_bones) and the closed shin_tone_ankle_pockets inner pocket (x 512-518, y 1351-1371); shade #f6ddd3 (reference f6ddd1-f5d9d2 at y 1360 x 544-548, f4dad1 at x 516), blur 1.5.
