path.desc: Outer kneecap crease stripe straddling shin_struct_knee_outer: #eec8c1, ~6px wide (x 549-560 over y 1030-1062), strongest y 1035-1062 (0.8), fading out toward the patella bottom point by ~1092; shares the gradient with thigh_ls_knee_outer_crease so it joins without a step. Blur 2.0, no hard edge.

Inner kneecap crease stripe straddling shin_struct_knee_inner: #ebc0bb (slightly deeper than the outer side, as in the reference), ~6px wide (x 513-528 over y 1030-1068), darkest y 1040-1070, about 8px clear of the inner outline, fading out toward the patella bottom. Blur 2.0.

Small soft crease under the outer (image-right) ankle bone along shin_struct_ankle_bones (555,1358)-(547,1370): #efcdc6, ~3px, max 0.55 mid, thin faded ends, blur 1.0; sits inside the outer ankle pocket shade without stacking to a dark spot (reference f4d9cd-f4d8d1).

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_shin highlights (4.6): only the kneecap specular, on the rounded top cap of the shin (the shin covers the thigh here). Skin is matte, so there is a single small soft spot on the top of the patella, consistent with the light from upper front / image-right and with the front light band already in the volume layer (shin_volume_front_light, unchanged; the long thigh band and shin streak in the reference are no brighter than that layer, so no extra highlight there). Reference: core #fcf2ed at ~(534-538, 1013-1022), a lighter #faeae4-#fbebe5 area above it up to y~1004, then base skin #fae6dd. It moves and deforms with the shin, so it stays in this part, painted above volume/local colour/local shading and under the brush strokes.

path.desc: Soft teardrop halo around the knee specular, ~9x24px, narrow upper tail above the core (reference #faeae4 up to y~1004), fading over ~5px into the base tone.

Specular core following legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_knee_specular, centre ~(536,1018), already on the reference peak. Near white #fcf3ee; 0.6px blur keeps the slightly firmer upper edge the reference shows.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin, outer (image-right) contour. Starts at the knee ~(583,1018), where the shin top joint end meets the outer edge, overlapping the end of the thigh outer line, follows the outer knee and calf bulge (~587,1130) and shin down to the outer ankle bone (~555,1375), ending at y~1400 under the left_foot top where the foot contour continues. Use: main silhouette line, final visible. Weight ~1.2 px, fullest along the calf, thin at the knee start (fades in over ~15 px) and at the ankle; hard edge. Matches the outer edge of the shin fill.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin, inner (image-left) contour. Starts at ~(506,1027.5), the top-left corner of the shin fill on the knee contact seam (the shin fill covers the thigh line there), continues to the split at ~(506,1061) where the knees part, then runs down the inner calf and shin along the dark leg gap to the inner ankle (~510,1380), ending at y~1400 under the left_foot top. Use: inner silhouette line, final visible. Weight ~1.0 px, clear along the leg gap, thin start and end; hard edge. Matches the inner edge of the shin fill.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Outer (image-right) side of the kneecap: from ~(565.5,1013.5) at the shin top edge, overlapping the end of thigh_struct_knee_outer_lead (which the shin fill covers below y~1014), down along the pink shading to the patella bottom point ~(541,1095), where it meets shin_struct_knee_inner. Use: patella/outer tendon plane turn; the shade on its right is the outer knee shadow. Final: kept as a soft shade edge; slightly darker y 1035-1065, tapering out toward the bottom point. Weight 0.8 mid, thin ends; soft edge. Closes with shin_struct_knee_inner as the bottom of the kneecap shade region. Tone (3.3): also a shade boundary. A darker crease stripe ~5px wide straddles it over y 1032-1058 (x 552-558); to its left below y 1040 is the mid shade region legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_knee_lower_shade. Detail (3.4): the crease stripe here is a warm pink blush in the reference (same family as the rim lines), not grey. Keep the stripe colour warm.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Inner (image-left) side of the kneecap: from ~(514.5,1017.5) at the shin top edge, overlapping the end of thigh_struct_knee_inner_lead (covered by the shin fill below y~1018), keeping ~10 px from the inner seam contour, curving down-right along the inner knee shade to the patella bottom ~(541,1095). Use: inner tendon / patella plane turn. Final: soft shade edge, darkest y 1040-1070, fades at both ends. Weight 0.8 mid, thin ends; soft edge. Tone (3.3): also a shade boundary. A dark crease stripe straddles it over y 1037-1068 (x 515-525); to its right below y 1040 is legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_knee_lower_shade. Detail (3.4): the crease stripe here is a warm pink blush in the reference (same family as the rim lines), not grey. Keep the stripe colour warm.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Small specular dot on the top of the kneecap ~(536,1012-1022), on the rounded top cap of the shin (it covers the thigh here), above shin_struct_knee_top. Use: marks the most forward point of the patella; later the highlight colour step paints a soft white dot here. Final: no line; placement guide only, fade both ends. Weight 0.4; very soft. Tone (3.3): closed range given by legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_knee_specular.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Upper rim of the lower kneecap face: faint arc from ~(518,1036) on shin_struct_knee_inner to ~(556,1038) on shin_struct_knee_outer, sagging to y~1045 at x~538. Use: with the two side lines and the bottom point it encloses the lighter lower kneecap face (closed region y 1036-1095); the specular dot (shin_struct_knee_highlight) sits above it. Final: barely visible, fade-only, no hard stroke. Weight 0.5; very soft. Tone (3.3) correction: in the reference the area enclosed below this arc is a mid shade (legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_knee_lower_shade), not a lighter face; the lighter area is above the arc around the specular dot. This arc is the soft top edge of that shade.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Shin bone (tibia) front ridge: starts under the patella bottom ~(542,1100), runs down the faint highlight stripe at x~549-553 to ~(537,1350) above the ankle bones. Use: divides the lit front of the shin from the inner calf plane; drives the vertical shin highlight. Final: not a drawn line, only the edge of the highlight; strongest y 1120-1220, fading out from 1260 down. Weight 0.5; very soft edge. Tone (3.3): forms the right edge of legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_highlight_streak over y 1100-1250.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Outer calf plane turn: from ~(579,1062) just inside the outer contour below the knee, down to ~(567,1210) where the calf narrows, about 7 px inside legs_left_leg_left_shin_line_outer. Use: separates the outer calf bulge (shade) from the front of the shin. Final: shade edge only, faded at both ends, no solid stretch. Weight 0.5; soft. Tone (3.3): soft inner fade of the outer calf shade bounded by legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_outer_shade.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Outer (image-right) ankle bone (malleolus) underside: short curve from the outer contour ~(555,1358) inward to ~(547,1370), just above the anklet chain end bead; continues under left_anklet / left_foot. The inner ankle bump ~(511,1360) is read from the contour and needs no line. Use: ankle bone volume. Final: short soft crease, thin start and end. Weight 0.6; soft edge. Tone (3.3): marks the outer ankle shade pocket (x 547-555, y 1358-1370); its inner counterpart is legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_ankle_pockets.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Small closed spot for the specular highlight on top of the kneecap, centre ~(536,1018), ~4x9px, on the rounded top cap of the shin (it covers the thigh here); matches legs_left_leg_left_shin_struct_knee_highlight. Source: the patella catching the light (self). Inside = specular (near white); outside = a slightly lighter knee-top area fading into the base over ~8px. Hard-ish upper edge, softer below. Final: rendered as a highlight shape; helper line not kept.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Closed region for the mid shadow below the patella (lower kneecap face / tendon dip): top edge along legs_left_leg_left_shin_struct_knee_top (y~1035-1043), sides just inside legs_left_leg_left_shin_struct_knee_inner and legs_left_leg_left_shin_struct_knee_outer, bottom tip ~(540,1094). Source: concave form under the kneecap (self). Inside = mid shade (one step below base); darker crease stripes run along the two side lines (inner x 515-525 y 1037-1068, outer x 552-558 y 1032-1058). Top edge soft (~4px vertical fade); sides firmer; bottom fades over ~5px. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Closed loop around the vertical shin highlight: from x 544-553 at y 1097 under the patella tip, down to a tip ~(538,1285). Its right edge follows legs_left_leg_left_shin_struct_tibia_ridge (shin bone front ridge). Source: the lit front of the shin (self, deforms with the shin). Inside = highlight; outside = base skin. Soft edges ~3px; the lower part y 1240-1285 fades out. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Inner edge of the shade band along the outer (image-right) calf: (578,1065)->(576,1150)->(565,1250)->(552,1340). The region from here to legs_left_leg_left_shin_line_outer is shade (~7-9px at the calf, ~4px above the ankle), closed by that outline at both ends. Over y 1062-1210 it sits next to legs_left_leg_left_shin_struct_calf_turn, the softer inner fade of the same shade. Source: the calf turning away from the light (self). Soft, ~3px gradient. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Edge of the shade band along the inner (image-left) shin: x~513-516 from (515,1062) where the knees part down to (516,1340). The region from here to legs_left_leg_left_shin_line_inner is shade (~5-7px), closed by that outline. Source: the inner shin turning from the light (self), slightly deepened by the gap to legs/right_leg (occlusion, uncertain). Soft, ~2-3px gradient. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Small closed shade pocket beside the inner (image-left) ankle bone, ~(512-517, 1352-1370); the outer pocket is marked by legs_left_leg_left_shin_struct_ankle_bones (x 547-555, y 1358-1370). Source: hollow beside the ankle bone (self). Inside = shade; soft edges ~2px. The lower part continues under left_anklet / left_foot. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Warm skin rim ~1px inside legs_left_leg_left_shin_line_outer (image-right), from ~y 1016 at the outer knee to ~y 1395 at the ankle, ending under left_anklet / left_foot. Purpose: warm silhouette edge from the reference. Final: kept as a soft colour line, not a dark line. Weight 0.6; brightest along the calf (y 1080-1250), slightly faded at the outer ankle bone (y 1355-1370); soft inner edge into shin_tone_outer_shade.

Part legs/left_leg/left_shin. Warm skin rim ~1px inside legs_left_leg_left_shin_line_inner (image-left), y 1018.5-1395 (starting at the shin fill top edge so it overlaps the end of thigh_detail_rim_inner without a gap), continuing from thigh_detail_rim_inner across the knee split (~y 1061) down the inner shin to the ankle, ending under left_anklet / left_foot. Final: kept as a soft warm colour line. Weight 0.6; thin ends, fades over the last 10px at the ankle; soft edge into shin_tone_inner_shade.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothstep easing); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_shin brush strokes: closed filled outlines generated from the source curves by their desc (weight, taper, fades, soft edges). Silhouette lines unclipped; structure and rim strokes clipped to the shin fill where they touch its edge. Source curves kept as display=none. Hidden helper or tone curves without a brush: shin_struct_knee_top, shin_struct_tibia_ridge, shin_struct_calf_turn (absorbed into shading), shin_struct_knee_highlight (placement guide only); all shin_tone_* boundaries (colour fill takes over). Colours set in 4.7: silhouette lines #5c3533 (mauve #866478 against the light backdrop on the upper outer thigh, lighter #b07a77 on the contact seam with legs/right_leg), soft structure creases #e0aaa2-#f0d0c8, rims #e2a29c.

path.desc: Brush for shin_line_outer: size 1.35; fullest (pressure 1.0, ~1.3px) along the calf y 1080-1250, 0.8 at the knee and ankle; starts at full opacity and width at the shin top edge (no start taper) so it joins the thigh outline that the shin fill partly covers, taper end 10px under left_foot. Hard edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): warm deep red-brown #5c3533 (reference silhouette against the dark backdrop: dark warm line with a pink fringe ~#c4958d-#d0a296).

Brush for shin_line_inner: size 1.15 (~1.0px). Along the contact seam y 1027-1061 slightly lighter (pressure 0.75) continuing the thigh seam line from the shin top edge at full opacity (no start taper, so no notch at the join), then full along the leg gap to the inner ankle; taper start 0, end 10px under left_foot. Hard edge, unclipped. Colour (4.7): #b07a77 on the contact seam down to y~1052 (reference #b47979-#c48a8a), stepping through #8a5652 to warm deep red-brown #5c3533 along the dark leg gap to the ankle.

Brush for shin_struct_knee_outer, outer kneecap side: heaviest y 1035-1065. Mid stroke size 1.1, pressure starts at 0.75 at the shin top edge (matching the end of the thigh lead-in, no start taper, so no break at the join), heaviest mid, thin end; opacity 0.5-0.55, the bottom end fading to 0.25. Gaussian blur 0.6 (soft shade edge kept in the final as the edge of the warm crease). Unclipped; lies well inside the shin fill and continues the thigh lead-in from the shin top edge. Colour (4.7): skin-family soft pink, segmented along the stroke (#e6b3ab start, #e0aaa2 at the heaviest middle, #e9bdb5-#f0d0c8 toward the lower end where the reference crease fades into the skin); at the existing opacity it lands ~#e8c0b8-#eac0b9, like the reference creases (#eec8c0 outer, #e6bbb6-#eac1bc inner). Opacity eased in 4.7 to 0.20 at the shin top, 0.45-0.48 mid, 0.22 at the end, since the reference crease only becomes a readable line below y~1026.

Brush for shin_struct_knee_inner, inner kneecap side: heaviest y 1040-1070, stays ~10px clear of the inner outline. Mid stroke size 1.1, pressure starts at 0.75 at the shin top edge (matching the end of the thigh lead-in, no start taper, so no break at the join), heaviest mid, thin end; opacity 0.5-0.55, the bottom end fading to 0.25. Gaussian blur 0.6 (soft shade edge kept in the final as the edge of the warm crease). Unclipped; lies well inside the shin fill and continues the thigh lead-in from the shin top edge. Colour (4.7): skin-family soft pink, segmented along the stroke (#e6b3ab start, #e0aaa2 at the heaviest middle, #e9bdb5-#f0d0c8 toward the lower end where the reference crease fades into the skin); at the existing opacity it lands ~#e8c0b8-#eac0b9, like the reference creases (#eec8c0 outer, #e6bbb6-#eac1bc inner). Opacity eased in 4.7 to 0.20 at the shin top, 0.45-0.48 mid, 0.22 at the end, since the reference crease only becomes a readable line below y~1026.

Brush for shin_struct_ankle_bones: short soft crease at the outer ankle bone, size 0.8, thin start and end, opacity max 0.45 mid; blur 0.4; clipped to the shin fill. Colour (4.7): light skin pink #ebc0b8/#e8bab2 (reference under the ankle bone ~#f4d8d1, so kept lighter than the knee creases).

Brush for shin_detail_rim_outer: warm rim, size 0.75, thinner over the outer ankle bone y 1355-1370 (pressure 0.45), fades at both ends; blur 0.3; clipped to the shin fill. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e2a29c at the existing opacity, giving the reference pink skin edge (~#f0c6c6/#d5a8a6).

Brush for shin_detail_rim_inner: warm rim, size 0.75, starts at the shin top overlapping the thigh rim end, fades out over the last ~10px at the ankle; blur 0.3; clipped to the shin fill. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e2a29c at the existing opacity, giving the reference pink skin edge (~#f0c6c6/#d5a8a6).

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes outer contours and junctions (3.1) for the five direct parts, mirroring legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes. Stack: the whole group lies under legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body (toe roots tuck ~9 px under its toe_root_seam, as the foot_body desc states); inside the group the paint order is little_toe (bottom), fourth_toe, middle_toe, second_toe, big_toe (top), so each visible toe-gap line is the image-right side edge of the toe toward the big toe, and the toe toward the little toe continues as a hidden root lap under it. Gap lines follow the dark minima of the gaps on base-subject.png (the same centrelines used for the guide blocks); the toe tips and the notches where neighbouring tips meet are traced from base-subject.png (skin-to-background edge, set 0.6 px outward so the ink centre matches the foot_body contour handovers at (505.4,1461.6) and (573.8,1459.1)); the guide block had smoothed over the notches, so the traced tips sit up to ~2 px inside it there. Between big_toe and second_toe the reference opens a hair-thin dark slit (y~1474-1490, about 1 px of background); it is carried by the shared gap-1 line and its junction notch at ~(529.4,1489.7), not as a separate opening. The root seams and hidden laps keep the guide block top. line-reference.png agrees with the colour reference here within ~1 px and is used for stroke character (gap strokes start ~y 1462-1468 under the foot_body seam, line weight). Lines are thin position guides only (red = visible contour to be inked, blue dashed = internal seam / hidden edge, never inked); final ink, colour and widths come in later stages. No holes or openings in any toe; nails and toe pads are interior detail for later stages.

legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe: little (5th) toe, image-right edge toe. One closed fill plus its boundary curves (tip contour, side edges, root seam), which together trace the fill outline exactly. Guide: block-layers/groups.svg legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe (block0 visible strip, block1 root motion margin).

path.desc: Fill region of little_toe, base skin #f9e7de (same as foot_body), one continuous closed area without holes: from the gap-4 junction (564.5,1480.0) round the small rounded tip and up the outer (image-right) side to (573.8,1459.1), where the foot_body outer contour hands over, then on under foot_body up the parent edge and along the root seam to (559.3,1453.4), then down the hidden left side (gap 4 plus the root lap under fourth_toe, up to ~3.5 px image-left of the visible gap at y~1450, 1 px at y 1468, 0 by y 1474) back to the start. Expected reveal: the root lap (under foot_body and under the neighbouring toe) shows only when the toes spread, curl or the foot flexes; it is the same toe skin and later shading should simply continue the visible root tone into it. Base colour (4.1, checked against base-subject.png): bare toe skin #f9e7de over the whole closed fill, the same skin material and inherent colour as legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body (reference foot top #f9e7da-#fae6dc, this toe #fbe6da), one continuous colour zone including the hidden root lap under foot_body and the hidden lap under the neighbouring toe, so toe flexion and spread reveal the same skin. Pinker gap sides, pale tip and edge lights are tone steps, not base colour. The nail plate is a separate nail material: legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_nail_base.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe large light/shade (4.2), checked against base-subject.png: light from the upper right/front. The toe top plane stays the lit base skin #f9e7de with no fill over it. The left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps (both sides of each gap read light, recorded in 3.3 as edge lights), so the only self shade carried by the toe form is the narrow tip rim where the top plane rolls under toward the sole, between legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_tip_turn and the tip contour. Not here: the gap-1 cleft (slit and its root above y 1474, contact occlusion from big_toe, rendering 4.5), the hidden-lap occlusion (4.5), edge lights / nail centre / pale tip (4.6), nail plate shading (later nail steps). Drawn over the skin fill and under the nail plate and brush lines. Local darks (4.4, checked against base-subject.png): no extra dark painted on this toe. At the junctions: at J4 (564.5,1480.1) the reference notch (x 564, y 1476-1479: G 176-75) is already matched or exceeded by the swelling gap and tip brushes (current 148-53), so a crevice dark would double the junction and make it too black. The reference shows no dark at the knuckle hinge, the nail fold or the toe root on this toe (rows above the nail stay G 228-232, current 231); the tip rim shade above stays the only turning dark, and the nail ring brush and nail local colour carry the nail edge. (Current values measured before the 4.7 gap-line recolour; after it the gap lines read pinkish brown and the junction notches stay at or below the reference, still no extra crevice dark needed.)

path.desc: 4.2 tip rim self shade of little_toe: closed band from legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_tip_turn (inner edge) to the tip contour, pushed ~1.2 px past the contour so the outer edge is cut hard by the toe fill clip. Reference x 565-569, y 1478-1479: G 198-222, narrow rim under the nail: a slightly pinker, darker skin where the round tip turns away, #efc6c0 at 0.8 over the base (reads ~#f2d0ca). Edge: hard against the tip contour (fill clip, under the 2 px brush), blur 0.5 softens the ~1 px inner edge toward the pale tip / top plane. Moves with the toe.

Nail plate base colour of little_toe (4.1): #f4d2cd, pink-mauve nail material distinct from the toe skin #f9e7de (reference small nail reads #f5d2c9-#f8d3cd; same nail material as legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes; small nails one step lighter than the big nail, as in the reference). Closed area = legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_nail (ellipse ~6.5 x 6.7 px centred (568.2,1475.0)), clipped to the little_toe fill. Sits over the skin fill and under the brush lines; the pale skin below the free edge stays skin (tip pale highlight tone, later). Nail local colour, shading and highlight are later steps.

Local colour across the little_toe nail plate (4.3), over legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_nail_base: reference x 567-569: y 1472 #f2cec4 at the cuticle, lower arc y 1476-1478 deeper #f2c6c2. Vertical gradient over the nail area (y 1471.7-1478.3): paler #fbe1dc at 0.70 opacity at the cuticle, fading out over the top ~25 % so the skin-to-nail change is soft along the cuticle; deeper #eec4c2 at 0.60 over the lowest ~26 %, so the plate deepens toward the free edge as in the reference. The plate body keeps the base colour. Hard edge stays only where the nail ring brush runs; the paler nail centre, the free-edge light and the pale tip below are 4.6. Moves with the toe.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe highlights (4.6), checked against base-subject.png: matte skin and nail, light from the upper right/front, so only soft pale planes (#fdf1ed for skin, #fbe5e1 for nail), no glossy specular dots. Placed above the nail colours and below the brush lines. No reflected light under the tip (the tip rim stays pink-dark, 4.2). Nail centre stays its 4.3 local colour (reference G 195-215 at (568,1475), current 210), no tip pale crescent in the reference. All highlights move with the toe, so no separate rendering layer.

path.desc: little_toe edge light along the image-left gap side (4.6), filled from the 3.3 range legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_left_gap_edge_light; weak: reference G 230-232 at (564-566,1468), about the top plane. Matte skin light, no specular dot; 0.5 blur: firm on the ink / nail side, soft ~1 px into the base. Moves with the toe.

little_toe visible contour (red). Visible outer contour of the little toe: starts at the gap-4 junction (564.5,1480.0) (bottom of fourth_toe_right_gap_contour, end of fourth_toe_tip_contour), dips round the small toe tip (lowest ~y 1480.7) and rises up the slightly convex outer side (x~573.3-574.0, y 1474-1463) to (573.8,1459.1), where foot_body_outer_contour continues it upward as one stroke. Weight: ~1.5 px at the junction, 2-2.2 px round the tip and outer side, ~2 px into the handover; hard edge, continuous, no fade-out. Traced on base-subject.png (edge set 0.6 px outward). Bounds the lower edge of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_fill.

little_toe image-left side, hidden (blue dashed): from (559.3,1453.4) at the toes-group top down to (564.5,1480.0) at the gap-4 junction. Lies under fourth_toe (gap 4 line plus a root lap ~3.5 px wide at y~1450, 1 px at y 1468, closing to 0 by y~1474), so it is never inked and stays a soft, colour-matched fill edge; the visible gap line here is fourth_toe_right_gap_contour. Bounds the left edge of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_fill. Expected reveal: a 1-3 px strip of this toe's side shows beside the gap line only when the toes spread apart.

little_toe root edge, hidden (blue dashed): from (573.8,1459.1) up the parent edge under the foot outer contour to (572.0,1450.3) and along the toes-group top to (559.3,1453.4), about 6-10 px above foot_body_toe_root_seam, all under foot_body. Internal joint lap for toe flexion, never inked, soft colour-matched edge. Closes legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_fill along the top. Expected reveal: none in the rest pose; toe curl or spread keeps it under the foot.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe internal structure lines (3.2), thin position guides. The nail is the only interior line inked in line-reference.png (a light grey-pink thin ring, much lighter than the skin contour); the knuckle hinge, side-plane turns and tip turn are structure / shade boundaries for later shading and are not inked. Positions measured on base-subject.png (pink nail ring / nail plate, pinker side bands along the gaps and sides, pinker rim along the tip). Mirrors the right-foot toes structure.

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe. Little toe nail: small closed oval centred (568.2,1475.0), ~6.5 x 6.7 px, long axis tilted 8 deg to follow the toe axis (the left-foot toes lean toward image-right at the tip). Reference: pink ring (G~193-210) with paler centre (G~225-230) on base-subject.png, light grey ring in line-reference.png. Island inside the toe top plane, its lower edge ~1.5-2.5 px above the tip contour; connects to nothing. Use: nail border; final shows as a thin light ring (~0.5-0.7 px, warm grey-pink, clearly lighter than the gap lines), slightly firmer on the upper arc and the two sides, thinning and nearly breaking for ~1.5 px at the lower arc where the paler tip crescent begins. Hard but light edge. Fill: closes the nail region for later local colour (pinkish ring, paler centre). Expected reveal: none. Tone (3.3): the paler centre / free edge is closed as tone_nail_center_light inside this loop; on toes with room below, tone_tip_pale_highlight shares its lower edge.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe. Interphalangeal joint hinge: very shallow upward-bowed arc across the toe at y~1466.5 from (563.8,1466.8) to (571.7,1466.8), ending ~1 px short of both side edges, about halfway between the foot_body toe-root seam and the nail top. Use: bend axis for toe curl / flex (the segment below it rotates); the reference shows no crease or knuckle mark here in the rest pose, so final: no ink, no visible tone, at most a hair of shading if the toe curls. Soft, both ends fade. Not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: when the toes curl a soft crease forms along this line and the knuckle top above it catches light.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe. Left side-plane turn: runs 1.8 px inside (image-right of) the gap-4 line from (564.3,1463.0), just below where the gap line starts showing under foot_body, down to (566.0,1479.0) beside the nail, where it fades into the tip turn. The band between it and the gap line is this toe's side rolling under fourth_toe (reference: pinker shade band ~1.5-2 px along the gap). Continues as the same side plane over the hidden root lap (left_hidden_edge, under fourth_toe) if the toes spread. Use: top-plane / side-plane boundary for shading; final: no ink, soft tone break only (~1.5 px gradient toward the side), fades in at its upper end over ~2 px and fades out into the tip turn. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): no visible occlusion at rest; the band between it and the gap line holds the thin left_gap_edge_light (outer limit = this line); the cast shadow from the overlapping toe lies on the hidden lap (tone_hidden_lap_occlusion) and appears here only when the toes spread.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe. Outer side-plane turn of the little toe: ~1.9 px inside the outer (image-right) contour from (571.8,1463.5), just under the foot_body outer contour handover, to (570.2,1477.5) where it curves into the tip turn. Continues the foot_body outer side plane (foot_body_struct_outer_side_turn ends at (564.2,1458.5) above the 4th/5th toe roots; on the little toe the side band narrows to ~2 px). Band to the right of it is the outer side shade (reference pinker band x 571-573, y 1464-1476). Use: top-plane / side-plane boundary for shading; final: no ink, soft tone break only (~1.5 px gradient toward the side), fades in at its upper end over ~2 px and fades out into the tip turn. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): no outer side shade or rim light measured on the little toe (outer edge G 229-232 like the top plane); auxiliary line only, no fill relation in this pose.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe. Tip turn: where the top plane rolls over the rounded toe tip toward the underside, ~1.2 px inside the tip contour, from (566.0,1479.0) to (570.2,1477.5) (lowest ~y 1479.0), passing just under the nail. Joins the lower ends of the two side-plane turns. The strip between it and the tip contour is the pinker rim of the tip in the reference (1-2 px), and above it, under the nail, the pale tip crescent. Use: shade boundary for the tip rim / pale crescent; final: no ink, soft tone break; fades out at both ends into the side turns near the gap-junction notches. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: none beyond the visible tip. Tone (3.3): no darker tip rim measured in this pose (the band below it is the contour antialias, G ~230 inside); where present the pale crescent (tone_tip_pale_highlight) lies above it; auxiliary only.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe light/shade ranges (3.3), thin dashed position loops only (display none, like the right-foot toes); colour and value are the next stage. Read from base-subject.png in the current rest pose: light from the upper right/front, the toe top plane is one even light value (#f9e6db-#fae7db, G 228-231), with no cast shadow from foot_body over the toe roots (y 1456-1462 is as light as the toe tops, so no root shadow loop) and no tone on the knuckle hinge. Unlike the mirrored right-foot draft, the left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps or the tip rim: the drawing puts a thin lighter edge on both sides of each gap ink line, so those bands are recorded as edge lights. Ranges here: left gap edge light (weak), hidden-lap cast shadow from fourth_toe, nail centre light (weak); no pale crescent (nail at the tip) and no outer rim light or side shade: the outer edge x 571-573 reads G 229-232 like the top plane, so foot_body_tone_outer_side_shade / outer_rim_light end at the toe-root seam.

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe. Closed loop from (563.6,1464.0) to (564.5,1471.0): hard side 1.1 px right of the gap centreline (ink edge), soft side up to 2.1 px, tapering to 0 at both ends. Source: form light on the rounded toe side next to the gap (no cast shadow from fourth_toe is visible at rest: the overlap is on the hidden root lap, see legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_tone_hidden_lap_occlusion). Reference: mean G 230 in the band vs 228-231 top plane, y 1464-1471 (weak, close to the top-plane value). Definite y 1466-1469, fades in/out over ~2 px at both ends, blank elsewhere. Edge: hard on the gap side, soft ~0.8 px inward. Lies between the gap line and legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_left_side_turn (1.8 px). Final: absorbed into colour/shading as a lighter hairline, no line. Region: inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_fill, closed against the gap line. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe. Caster: fourth_toe (the toe above in the stack, nearer the big toe) whose right side overlaps this toe; receiver: little_toe. Not visible in the rest pose (covered by fourth_toe, the reference shows only the gap ink), so the whole loop is blank at rest; it becomes the shade of the exposed strip when the toes spread or fourth_toe moves away, darkest next to the gap line, fading toward the hidden edge. Edge: soft ~1 px, follows the caster edge. Final: handed to the cast-shadow layer in 4.5 (moves with fourth_toe, not baked into this toe fill); no line. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe. Light range on the nail: closed oval centred (568.2,1475.3), 3.6 x 3.7 px, ~55% of the nail, long axis tilted 8 deg like the nail, entirely inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_nail. Source: the domed nail plate facing the light. The nail reads as a pink ring (G ~193-213) with a paler centre; reference G 207 in the oval (weak, only a few values above the ring). Edge: soft ~0.8 px all round, no hard edge; no blank intervals (the whole loop is a soft limit). Final: absorbed into colour (nail colour step, paler centre / free edge) in 4.x, no line. Region: inside the nail region, closed on itself. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe details (3.4): foot_body convention (silhouette rim as a thin warm colour line). The reference skin of the toes is smooth at this density (no wrinkles, knuckle creases, nail ridges or cuticle lines in base-subject.png); line-reference.png has only the outer contour, the gap lines and faint nail outlines (offset ~+2/+3 px like the rest of this area), all already drawn in 3.1/3.2. path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe. Warm-pink skin rim ~0.9 px inside the little toe outer (image-right) contour, from (572.8,1461.0) at the foot_body / toes handover (continues legs__left_leg__left_foot__foot_body_detail_rim_outer, which ends at (573.2,1461) on the toe-root seam) down to (573.0,1470.8), where the outer side turns into the nail and tip. Purpose: the single warm edge pixel the reference shows just inside the dark contour (RGB ~233-235,190-195,183-185 at x 572, y 1458-1464; 244,207,196 at y 1466; nearly base 249-250,219-220,209-212 by y 1468-1470, base 250,230,217); it softens the contour into the skin, same family as the foot_body outer rim. Final: kept as a faint warm colour line merged with the contour edge, not a dark line. Weight 0.5, opacity 0.45 like the foot_body rim; full strength y 1461-1465 so the rim reads continuous across the seam, thinning to ~0.3 px over y 1465-1468 and fading out by y 1470.7; blank below (nail and tip take over). Soft inner edge. Not a fill boundary.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (size 1, thinning 1, smoothing 0.5, simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, linear radius easing; width = 2 x pressure set per point from the source desc, ramps by smoothstep t*t*(3-2t); built-in taper options off, tapers realised as pressure ramps); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe visible brush strokes (3.5), from the 3.1 contours, the 3.2 nail line and the 3.4 detail lines of this part; source curves kept hidden (data-brush-role brush-source). Hidden edges, root seams, the knuckle hinge, side and tip turns stay hidden guides (data-brush-role guide); the 3.3 tone loops stay hidden tone boundaries for the colour stages. Colours: #5c3533 skin ink matching legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body brushes, nail lines #e0aea9 like the right-foot toes. Line colour (4.7): tip contour stays the silhouette ink #5c3533 (matching the foot_body outer contour it hands over to; the reference silhouette sits on the dark background, so the ink value there is a style match with the right foot), outer-side rim #f0c4b8 and nail ring #e0aea9 unchanged (reference nail ring G 193-213).

path.desc: Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_tip_contour: one continuous hard #5c3533 stroke, no fade-out. 1.5 px at the gap-4 junction (564.5,1480.0), 2.1 px round the small tip and up the outer side, ~2.0 px into the handover; continues ~4 px past (573.8,1459.1) up to (573.0,1455.0) under the foot_body outer contour stroke (which tapers to a point there) with that overlap eased up to ~0.45 px outward over the last 5.5 px as the foot_body stroke tapers (back to centred 2.5 px below), so the visible band beside the foot_body fill stays ~1.5-2 px without a step and the outer edge keeps one line across the handover. Round caps, hard edge.

Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_struct_nail: thin light warm grey-pink ring (#e0aea9) drawn from the lowest point round and back so its thin faint ends meet there, ~0.6 px on the upper arc and sides, thinning to ~0.35 px on the lower arc; opacity 0.85 easing to ~0.08 over the lowest ~1.5 px so the ring nearly breaks where the pale tip crescent begins. Hard but light edge, clearly lighter than the gap lines.

Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_detail_rim_outer: faint warm colour line (#f0c4b8, opacity 0.45 like foot_body_detail_rim_outer_brush), 0.5 px y 1461-1465 at full strength so the rim reads continuous across the seam, thinning to ~0.3 px over y 1465-1468 and fading out (opacity to 0) by y 1470.7; soft edge via 0.3 px blur; clipped to legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_fill.

g.desc: 独立投影层（4.5.1 登记，4.5.2 绘制）：fourth_toe 叠压在 little_toe 的 image-left 缘并挡光，投在 little_toe 沿 gap 的根部叠压带与缝隙。follow legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe，clip_to legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/little_toe。放在 little_toe 之后、fourth_toe 之前，故被 fourth_toe 自身遮住的部分静止不可见、张趾时随 fourth_toe 移动露出。关系依据见 structure/rendering.json 同名条目 note。_range 为 3.3 范围曲线的隐藏位置参考（display none）；_band 为完整投影色面。

path.desc: Full cast shadow / contact occlusion of fourth_toe on little_toe along gap 4. Geometry: from the toes-group top (y 1451.9) the hidden root lap between legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__little_toe_left_hidden_edge and the gap-4 line (2.6-3 px wide at the top, closing by y~1472), then a 1 px margin under fourth_toe down to the junction (564.5,1480.0); on the visible little_toe side only 0.5 px, inside the gap ink, tapering to 0 into the junction. Reference: gap 4 shows only its line (skin back to G 213-235 one pixel right of it), so at rest this layer is almost fully covered by fourth_toe and the ink; it shows when the toes spread or fourth_toe moves away. Colour: multiply #c09694 (the mid gap shade of the feet), opacity 0 above y 1462.5, 0.8 over the lap, 0.5 at the junction. Blur 0.45, soft ~1 px toward the hidden edge.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe: fourth toe. One closed fill plus its boundary curves (tip contour, side edges, root seam), which together trace the fill outline exactly. Guide: block-layers/groups.svg legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe (block0 visible strip, block1 root motion margin).

path.desc: Fill region of fourth_toe, base skin #f9e7de (same as foot_body), one continuous closed area without holes: rounded tip from the gap-3 junction (553.6,1485.7) to the gap-4 junction (564.5,1480.0), visible right side up gap 4 to (562.2,1451.9) at the toes-group top, root seam under foot_body to (548.4,1455.6), then down the hidden left side (gap 3 plus the root lap under middle_toe, up to ~3.5 px image-left of the visible gap at y~1450, 1 px at y 1468, 0 by y 1474) back to the start. Expected reveal: the root lap (under foot_body and under the neighbouring toe) shows only when the toes spread, curl or the foot flexes; it is the same toe skin and later shading should simply continue the visible root tone into it. Base colour (4.1, checked against base-subject.png): bare toe skin #f9e7de over the whole closed fill, the same skin material and inherent colour as legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body (reference foot top #f9e7da-#fae6dc, this toe #fae4de), one continuous colour zone including the hidden root lap under foot_body and the hidden lap under the neighbouring toe, so toe flexion and spread reveal the same skin. Pinker gap sides, pale tip and edge lights are tone steps, not base colour. The nail plate is a separate nail material: legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe_nail_base.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe large light/shade (4.2), checked against base-subject.png: light from the upper right/front. The toe top plane stays the lit base skin #f9e7de with no fill over it. The left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps (both sides of each gap read light, recorded in 3.3 as edge lights), so the only self shade carried by the toe form is the narrow tip rim where the top plane rolls under toward the sole, between legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe_struct_tip_turn and the tip contour. Not here: the gap-1 cleft (slit and its root above y 1474, contact occlusion from big_toe, rendering 4.5), the hidden-lap occlusion (4.5), edge lights / nail centre / pale tip (4.6), nail plate shading (later nail steps). Drawn over the skin fill and under the nail plate and brush lines. Local darks (4.4, checked against base-subject.png): no extra dark painted on this toe. At the junctions: at J3 (553.6,1485.7) and J4 (564.5,1480.1) the reference notches are already matched or exceeded by the swelling gap and tip brushes (J4 x 564-565, y 1478-1479: reference x 564, y 1476-1479: reference G 176-75, current 148-53), so a crevice dark would double the junction and make it too black. The reference shows no dark at the knuckle hinge, the nail fold or the toe root on this toe (rows above the nail stay G 228-232, current 231); the tip rim shade above stays the only turning dark, and the nail ring brush and nail local colour carry the nail edge. (Current values measured before the 4.7 gap-line recolour; after it the gap lines read pinkish brown and the junction notches stay at or below the reference, still no extra crevice dark needed.)

path.desc: 4.2 tip rim self shade of fourth_toe: closed band from legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe_struct_tip_turn (inner edge) to the tip contour, pushed ~1.2 px past the contour so the outer edge is cut hard by the toe fill clip. Reference x 556-561, y 1484-1486: G 185-220 against 219 above, narrowest rim: a slightly pinker, darker skin where the round tip turns away, #efc6c0 at 0.8 over the base (reads ~#f2d0ca). Edge: hard against the tip contour (fill clip, under the 2 px brush), blur 0.5 softens the ~1 px inner edge toward the pale tip / top plane. Moves with the toe.

Nail plate base colour of fourth_toe (4.1): #f4d2cd, pink-mauve nail material distinct from the toe skin #f9e7de (reference small nail reads #f4cfd0-#f9dcdc; same nail material as legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes; small nails one step lighter than the big nail, as in the reference). Closed area = legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe_struct_nail (ellipse ~7 x 7 px centred (558.5,1481.8)), clipped to the fourth_toe fill. Sits over the skin fill and under the brush lines; the pale skin below the free edge stays skin (tip pale highlight tone, later). Nail local colour, shading and highlight are later steps.

Local colour across the fourth_toe nail plate (4.3), over legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe_nail_base: reference column x 559: cuticle y 1478 #f9d8d6 soft, lower arc y 1482 deeper #ecc4c3. Vertical gradient over the nail area (y 1478.3-1485.3): paler #fbe1dc at 0.70 opacity at the cuticle, fading out over the top ~25 % so the skin-to-nail change is soft along the cuticle; deeper #eec4c2 at 0.60 over the lowest ~26 %, so the plate deepens toward the free edge as in the reference. The plate body keeps the base colour. Hard edge stays only where the nail ring brush runs; the paler nail centre, the free-edge light and the pale tip below are 4.6. Moves with the toe.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe highlights (4.6), checked against base-subject.png: matte skin and nail, light from the upper right/front, so only soft pale planes (#fdf1ed for skin, #fbe5e1 for nail), no glossy specular dots. Placed above the nail colours and below the brush lines. No reflected light under the tip (the tip rim stays pink-dark, 4.2). Nail centre stays its 4.3 local colour (reference G 196-207 at (558,1482), current 210), no tip pale crescent in the reference. All highlights move with the toe, so no separate rendering layer.

Matte skin light, no specular dot; 0.5 blur: firm on the ink / nail side, soft ~1 px into the base. Moves with the toe.

fourth_toe edge light along the image-right gap side (4.6), filled from the 3.3 range legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe_tone_right_gap_edge_light; reference G 236 at (561,1470) beside the gap-4 ink, current 231. Matte skin light, no specular dot; 0.5 blur: firm on the ink / nail side, soft ~1 px into the base. Moves with the toe.

fourth_toe visible contour (red). Visible tip contour of the fourth toe: from the gap-3 junction (553.6,1485.7) (bottom of the neighbouring toe's right gap line, also end of the neighbouring tip contour) round the rounded tip (lowest ~y 1487.5) to the gap-4 junction (564.5,1480.0). Runs from (562.2,1451.9) at the toes-group top (hidden under foot_body) down to the junction (564.5,1480.0) with the tip contours. Hidden and never inked above y~1461 (under foot_body toe_root_seam); the inked stroke starts at y~1461 with a soft fade-in over ~3 px (hair-thin, then ~1-1.2 px), holds ~1.2 px, and thickens slightly to ~1.5 px into the junction where it merges with the tip contours. Edge firm on the fourth_toe side; the dark gap shading beside it toward little_toe belongs to later shading. Expected reveal when toes spread: the line stays this toe's edge; the neighbour's root lap appears beside it.

Lies under middle_toe (gap 3 line plus a root lap ~3.5 px wide at y~1450, 1 px at y 1468, closing to 0 by y~1474), so it is never inked and stays a soft, colour-matched fill edge; the visible gap line here is middle_toe_right_gap_contour. Use: top-plane / side-plane boundary for shading; final: no ink, soft tone break only (~1.5 px gradient toward the side), fades in at its upper end over ~2 px and fades out into the tip turn. Tone (3.3): no visible occlusion at rest; the band between it and the gap line holds the thin left_gap_edge_light (outer limit = this line); the cast shadow from the overlapping toe lies on the hidden lap (tone_hidden_lap_occlusion) and appears here only when the toes spread.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe. Right side-plane turn: runs 1.8 px inside (image-left of) the gap-4 line (this toe's visible right_gap_contour) from (560.7,1463.0), just below where the gap line starts showing under foot_body, down to (562.7,1485.0) beside the nail, where it fades into the tip turn. The narrow band between it and the gap line is the toe side turning away into the gap (reference: pinker/darker band 1.5-2 px wide along the gap against the top plane G~229-233). Use: top-plane / side-plane boundary for shading; final: no ink, soft tone break only (~1.5 px gradient toward the side), fades in at its upper end over ~2 px and fades out into the tip turn. Tone (3.3): no side shade in this pose; the band between it and the gap contour holds the thin right_gap_edge_light (outer limit = this line); auxiliary only, the shade relation applies when the toe turns or curls.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe. Joins the lower ends of the two side-plane turns. The strip between it and the tip contour is the pinker rim of the tip in the reference (1-2 px), and above it, under the nail, the pale tip crescent. Use: shade boundary for the tip rim / pale crescent; final: no ink, soft tone break; fades out at both ends into the side turns near the gap-junction notches. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: none beyond the visible tip. Tone (3.3): no darker tip rim measured in this pose (the band below it is the contour antialias, G ~230 inside); where present the pale crescent (tone_tip_pale_highlight) lies above it; auxiliary only.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe light/shade ranges (3.3), thin dashed position loops only (display none, like the right-foot toes); colour and value are the next stage. Read from base-subject.png in the current rest pose: light from the upper right/front, the toe top plane is one even light value (#f9e6db-#fae7db, G 228-231), with no cast shadow from foot_body over the toe roots (y 1456-1462 is as light as the toe tops, so no root shadow loop) and no tone on the knuckle hinge. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe details (3.4): none needed. g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (size 1, thinning 1, smoothing 0.5, simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, linear radius easing; width = 2 x pressure set per point from the source desc, ramps by smoothstep t*t*(3-2t); built-in taper options off, tapers realised as pressure ramps); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe visible brush strokes (3.5), from the 3.1 contours, the 3.2 nail line and the 3.4 detail lines of this part; source curves kept hidden (data-brush-role brush-source). Hidden edges, root seams, the knuckle hinge, side and tip turns stay hidden guides (data-brush-role guide); the 3.3 tone loops stay hidden tone boundaries for the colour stages. Line colour (4.7): tip contour stays the silhouette ink #5c3533 (matches the foot_body contours and the neighbouring tip strokes; the reference silhouette sits on the dark background), the visible right gap line recoloured from #5c3533 to the reference pinkish-brown gradient (see its desc), nail ring #e0aea9 unchanged (reference nail ring G 193-213).

path.desc: Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe_tip_contour: one continuous hard #5c3533 stroke from junction to junction, ~1.5 px at both junctions (meets the neighbouring tip strokes and the gap stroke end there, round caps overlapping so the junction has no gap), swelling to ~2.0 px over the lowest ~3 px of the tip (lowest y 1487.6). Hard edge.

Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe_right_gap_contour (gap 4): blank above y ~1460.5 (under foot_body, never inked); soft fade-in over y 1461-1464 (pressure ramp from hair-thin to ~1.15 px plus opacity ramp 0-1), holds ~1.15 px, thickens to ~1.5 px over the last ~4 px into the junction (564.5,1480.0), where it merges with the tip strokes; round end cap. Firm edge on this toe side. Colour (4.7): same opacity fade-in, then a vertical gradient over the visible length following the reference line value, the pinkish brown of the neighbouring skin in the same family (reference gap-4 line: #d59fa0-#bd7d82 at y 1463-1465, #cd9796-#d09d9c at 1471-1473, #d6a9a9-#dba8a6 at 1475-1477, #894b51 at 1479, dark notch at J4); the line stays lighter than the silhouette ink along the toe sides and darkens only into the tip junction, where the toe tips meet. Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__fourth_toe_struct_nail: thin light warm grey-pink ring (#e0aea9) drawn from the lowest point round and back so its thin faint ends meet there, ~0.6 px on the upper arc and sides, thinning to ~0.35 px on the lower arc; opacity 0.85 easing to ~0.08 over the lowest ~1.5 px so the ring nearly breaks where the pale tip crescent begins. Hard but light edge, clearly lighter than the gap lines.

g.desc: 独立投影层（4.5.1 登记，4.5.2 绘制）：middle_toe 叠压在 fourth_toe 的 image-left 缘并挡光，投在 fourth_toe 沿 gap 的根部叠压带与缝隙。follow legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/middle_toe，clip_to legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/fourth_toe。放在 fourth_toe 之后、middle_toe 之前，故被 middle_toe 自身遮住的部分静止不可见、张趾时随 middle_toe 移动露出。关系依据见 structure/rendering.json 同名条目 note。_range 为 3.3 范围曲线的隐藏位置参考（display none）；_band 为完整投影色面。

path.desc: Full cast shadow / contact occlusion of middle_toe on fourth_toe along gap 3. path.desc: Fill region of middle_toe, base skin #f9e7de (same as foot_body), one continuous closed area without holes: rounded tip from the gap-2 junction (542.4,1490.2) to the gap-3 junction (553.6,1485.7), visible right side up gap 3 to (551.1,1454.5) at the toes-group top, root seam under foot_body to (536.5,1456.4), then down the hidden left side (gap 2 plus the root lap under second_toe, up to ~3.5 px image-left of the visible gap at y~1450, 1 px at y 1468, 0 by y 1474) back to the start. Pinker gap sides, pale tip and edge lights are tone steps, not base colour. The nail plate is a separate nail material: legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__middle_toe_nail_base.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/middle_toe large light/shade (4.2), checked against base-subject.png: light from the upper right/front. The toe top plane stays the lit base skin #f9e7de with no fill over it. The left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps (both sides of each gap read light, recorded in 3.3 as edge lights), so the only self shade carried by the toe form is the narrow tip rim where the top plane rolls under toward the sole, between legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__middle_toe_struct_tip_turn and the tip contour. Not here: the gap-1 cleft (slit and its root above y 1474, contact occlusion from big_toe, rendering 4.5), the hidden-lap occlusion (4.5), edge lights / nail centre / pale tip (4.6), nail plate shading (later nail steps). Drawn over the skin fill and under the nail plate and brush lines. Local darks (4.4, checked against base-subject.png): no extra dark painted on this toe. At the junctions: at J2 (542.4,1490.2) and J3 (553.6,1485.7) the reference notches (J3 x 553, y 1482-1486: G 130-9, current 53 throughout) are already matched or exceeded by the swelling gap and tip brushes (J2 x 542, y 1486-1490: reference G 178-15, current 180-53), so a crevice dark would double the junction and make it too black. The reference shows no dark at the knuckle hinge, the nail fold or the toe root on this toe (rows above the nail stay G 228-232, current 231); the tip rim shade above stays the only turning dark, and the nail ring brush and nail local colour carry the nail edge. (Current values measured before the 4.7 gap-line recolour; after it the gap lines read pinkish brown and the junction notches stay at or below the reference, still no extra crevice dark needed.)

path.desc: 4.2 tip rim self shade of middle_toe: closed band from legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__middle_toe_struct_tip_turn (inner edge) to the tip contour, pushed ~1.2 px past the contour so the outer edge is cut hard by the toe fill clip. Reference x 545-550, y 1489-1491: #f0c8bb-ish, G 200-207 against 230-239 above: a slightly pinker, darker skin where the round tip turns away, #efc6c0 at 0.8 over the base (reads ~#f2d0ca). Sits over the skin fill and under the brush lines; the pale skin below the free edge stays skin (tip pale highlight tone, later). Nail local colour, shading and highlight are later steps.

Vertical gradient over the nail area (y 1481.7-1487.7): paler #fbe1dc at 0.70 opacity at the cuticle, fading out over the top ~25 % so the skin-to-nail change is soft along the cuticle; deeper #eec4c2 at 0.60 over the lowest ~26 %, so the plate deepens toward the free edge as in the reference. The plate body keeps the base colour. Hard edge stays only where the nail ring brush runs; the paler nail centre, the free-edge light and the pale tip below are 4.6. Moves with the toe.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/middle_toe highlights (4.6), checked against base-subject.png: matte skin and nail, light from the upper right/front, so only soft pale planes (#fdf1ed for skin, #fbe5e1 for nail), no glossy specular dots. middle_toe visible contour (red). Bounds the lower edge of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__middle_toe_fill.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/middle_toe. Use: shade boundary for the tip rim / pale crescent; final: no ink, soft tone break; fades out at both ends into the side turns near the gap-junction notches. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/middle_toe. g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (size 1, thinning 1, smoothing 0.5, simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, linear radius easing; width = 2 x pressure set per point from the source desc, ramps by smoothstep t*t*(3-2t); built-in taper options off, tapers realised as pressure ramps); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/middle_toe visible brush strokes (3.5), from the 3.1 contours, the 3.2 nail line and the 3.4 detail lines of this part; source curves kept hidden (data-brush-role brush-source). Firm edge on this toe side. Colour (4.7): same opacity fade-in, then a vertical gradient over the visible length following the reference line value, the pinkish brown of the neighbouring skin in the same family (reference gap-3 line: #d0a199-#c4928b at y 1467-1469, #ce9e95-#d19c9a at 1471-1477, #bf8989 at 1481, #a87070 at 1483, #592530 at J3); the line stays lighter than the silhouette ink along the toe sides and darkens only into the tip junction, where the toe tips meet. Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__middle_toe_struct_nail: thin light warm grey-pink ring (#e0aea9) drawn from the lowest point round and back so its thin faint ends meet there, ~0.6 px on the upper arc and sides, thinning to ~0.35 px on the lower arc; opacity 0.85 easing to ~0.08 over the lowest ~1.5 px so the ring nearly breaks where the pale tip crescent begins. Hard but light edge, clearly lighter than the gap lines.

g.desc: 独立投影层（4.5.1 登记，4.5.2 绘制）：second_toe 叠压在 middle_toe 的 image-left 缘并挡光，投在 middle_toe 沿 gap 的根部叠压带与缝隙。follow legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe，clip_to legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/middle_toe。放在 middle_toe 之后、second_toe 之前，故被 second_toe 自身遮住的部分静止不可见、张趾时随 second_toe 移动露出。关系依据见 structure/rendering.json 同名条目 note。_range 为 3.3 范围曲线的隐藏位置参考（display none）；_band 为完整投影色面。

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe large light/shade (4.2), checked against base-subject.png: light from the upper right/front. The toe top plane stays the lit base skin #f9e7de with no fill over it. The left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps (both sides of each gap read light, recorded in 3.3 as edge lights), so the only self shade carried by the toe form is the narrow tip rim where the top plane rolls under toward the sole, between legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_struct_tip_turn and the tip contour. Not here: the gap-1 cleft (slit and its root above y 1474, contact occlusion from big_toe, rendering 4.5), the hidden-lap occlusion (4.5), edge lights / nail centre / pale tip (4.6), nail plate shading (later nail steps). Drawn over the skin fill and under the nail plate and brush lines. Local darks (4.4, checked against base-subject.png): no extra dark painted on this toe. At the junctions: J1 belongs to the 4.5 slit; at J2 (542.4,1490.2) the reference notch (x 542, y 1486-1490: G 178-15) is already matched or exceeded by the swelling gap and tip brushes (current 180-53, darker from y 1487), so a crevice dark would double the junction and make it too black. The reference shows no dark at the knuckle hinge, the nail fold or the toe root on this toe (rows above the nail stay G 228-232, current 231); the tip rim shade above stays the only turning dark, and the nail ring brush and nail local colour carry the nail edge. (Current values measured before the 4.7 gap-line recolour; after it the gap lines read pinkish brown and the junction notches stay at or below the reference, still no extra crevice dark needed.)

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe. Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe. The narrow band between it and the gap line is the toe side turning away into the gap (reference: pinker/darker band 1.5-2 px wide along the gap against the top plane G~229-233). Use: top-plane / side-plane boundary for shading; final: no ink, soft tone break only (~1.5 px gradient toward the side), fades in at its upper end over ~2 px and fades out into the tip turn.
