Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe. Tip turn: where the top plane rolls over the rounded toe tip toward the underside, ~2.0 px inside the tip contour, from (531.0,1488.0) to (540.2,1488.0) (lowest ~y 1491.4), passing just under the nail. Joins the lower ends of the two side-plane turns. The strip between it and the tip contour is the pinker rim of the tip in the reference (1-2 px), and above it, under the nail, the pale tip crescent. Use: shade boundary for the tip rim / pale crescent; final: no ink, soft tone break; fades out at both ends into the side turns near the gap-junction notches. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: none beyond the visible tip. Tone (3.3): no darker tip rim measured in this pose (the band below it is the contour antialias, G ~230 inside); where present the pale crescent (tone_tip_pale_highlight) lies above it; auxiliary only.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe light/shade ranges (3.3), thin dashed position loops only (display none, like the right-foot toes); colour and value are the next stage. Read from base-subject.png in the current rest pose: light from the upper right/front, the toe top plane is one even light value (#f9e6db-#fae7db, G 228-231), with no cast shadow from foot_body over the toe roots (y 1456-1462 is as light as the toe tops, so no root shadow loop) and no tone on the knuckle hinge. Unlike the mirrored right-foot draft, the left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps or the tip rim: the drawing puts a thin lighter edge on both sides of each gap ink line, so those bands are recorded as edge lights. Ranges here: left and right gap edge lights, the near-black slit occlusion against big_toe, the hidden-lap cast shadow from big_toe, nail centre light, pale tip crescent (the brightest skin of the group).

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe. Light range: thin edge light on the image-left side of the toe, just right of the gap-1 line (legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_right_gap_contour, the visible edge of big_toe that overlaps this toe). Closed loop from (527.8,1474.0) to (530.4,1488.5): hard side 1.1 px right of the gap centreline (ink edge), soft side up to 2.1 px, tapering to 0 at both ends. Source: form light on the rounded toe side next to the gap (no cast shadow from big_toe is visible at rest: the overlap is on the hidden root lap, see legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_tone_hidden_lap_occlusion). Reference: mean G 232 in the band vs 228-231 top plane, y 1474-1488. Definite y 1476-1486, fades in/out over ~2 px at both ends, blank elsewhere. Edge: hard on the gap side, soft ~0.8 px inward. Lies between the gap line and legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_struct_left_side_turn (1.8 px). Final: absorbed into colour/shading as a lighter hairline, no line. Region: inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_fill, closed against the gap line. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe. Light range: thin edge light on the image-right side of the toe, along its visible right gap contour legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_right_gap_contour (gap 2). Closed loop from (538.7,1468.0) to (540.9,1488.0): hard inner side 1.1 px left of the gap centreline (the ink edge), soft side up to 2.2 px from it, width 0 at both ends and ~1.1 px in the middle. Source: form light, the rounded toe side rolling toward the light (upper right/front) right where it meets the gap; the edge of second_toe stays light, the gap itself is the only dark. Reference base-subject.png: mean G 229 in the band against 228-231 on the top plane (peaks 239-248), y 1468-1488. Definite y 1470-1486; fades in from the foot_body toe-root seam side (blank above y 1468, where the gap ink is still faint) and fades out ~1.5 px before the tip junction (542.4,1490.2); blank below. Edge: hard against the gap ink, soft ~0.8 px toward the top plane. Lies between the gap contour and legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_struct_right_side_turn (1.8 px), which is its outer limit; this light reads where 3.2 expected a side shade, so the side turn carries no shade in this pose. Final: absorbed into colour/shading as a lighter skin hairline (4.x), no line; the gap contour keeps the ink. Region: inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_fill, closed against the gap contour. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe. Cast shadow / contact occlusion range on the hidden root lap: closed loop between legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_left_hidden_edge from (521.5,1453.3) down to (525.4,1471.1) and the gap-1 line (legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_right_gap_contour) back up to (524.5,1453.3); width ~3.0 px at the top, closing to 0 at y~1472. Caster: big_toe (the toe above in the stack, nearer the big toe) whose right side overlaps this toe; receiver: second_toe. Not visible in the rest pose (covered by big_toe, the reference shows only the gap ink), so the whole loop is blank at rest; it becomes the shade of the exposed strip when the toes spread or big_toe moves away, darkest next to the gap line, fading toward the hidden edge. Edge: soft ~1 px, follows the caster edge. Final: handed to the cast-shadow layer in 4.5 (moves with big_toe, not baked into this toe fill); no line. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe. Darkest range of the group: the deep slit between big toe and second toe, closed lens straddling the gap-1 line from (526.5,1473.5) to (529.4,1489.7) at the tip junction J1, up to ~1.1 px wide (0.5 left / 0.6 right of the centreline), pointed at both ends. Source: contact occlusion / cast shadow from big_toe (caster, lying over this toe) into the narrow cleft where big_toe meets second_toe; receiver second_toe (its rolled-under left side). Reference: G mean 67 on the line (min 3-45 at y 1474-1480), near black #51393c at (527,1478), clearly darker than the other gap lines (G 110-200). Definite y 1475-1487; fades in over ~1.5 px at the top (gap ink above y 1473 is ordinary weight) and closes at J1. Edge: hard, both sides (the edge lights of both toes sit right against it). Final: kept as line - taken over by the ink of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_right_gap_contour, which is drawn heavier (~1.1-1.2 px, darkest) over this interval in 3.5; no separate fill. Region: straddles the gap; closes on the gap line at both ends. Shown only as this 0.4 px dashed position loop (display none).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe. Light range on the nail: closed oval centred (535.6,1486.1), 4.1 x 3.7 px, ~55% of the nail, long axis tilted 8 deg like the nail, entirely inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_struct_nail. Source: the domed nail plate facing the light. The nail reads as a pink ring (G ~193-213) with a paler centre; reference G 226 in the oval. Edge: soft ~0.8 px all round, no hard edge; no blank intervals (the whole loop is a soft limit). Final: absorbed into colour (nail colour step, paler centre / free edge) in 4.x, no line. Region: inside the nail region, closed on itself. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe. Light range: pale crescent of the toe tip under the nail, closed lens from (532.6,1487.9) along the lower edge of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_struct_nail (shared edge) to (538.6,1487.8), bowing down to y 1490.8, stopping ~1.5 px above the tip contour. Source: light on the forward-facing toe pad / the nail free edge. Reference: mean G 236 just under the nail (peak G 244, #fdf4f1 at (534,1490): the brightest skin in the group). Edge: firm along the nail (colour change), soft ~1 px downward into the base skin; definite in the middle third, fading out at both ends where the nail meets the tip. Final: absorbed into colour as a lighter skin / free-edge step, no line. Region: inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_fill, closed against the nail outline. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe details (3.4): none needed. The reference skin of the toes is smooth at this density (no wrinkles, knuckle creases, nail ridges or cuticle lines in base-subject.png); line-reference.png has only the outer contour, the gap lines and faint nail outlines (offset ~+2/+3 px like the rest of this area), all already drawn in 3.1/3.2. The nail ring (second_toe_struct_nail) with its centre light and pale crescent tones carries the nail; this toe has no silhouette edge outside the gap lines and tip contour.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (size 1, thinning 1, smoothing 0.5, simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, linear radius easing; width = 2 x pressure set per point from the source desc, ramps by smoothstep t*t*(3-2t); built-in taper options off, tapers realised as pressure ramps); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe visible brush strokes (3.5), from the 3.1 contours, the 3.2 nail line and the 3.4 detail lines of this part; source curves kept hidden (data-brush-role brush-source). Hidden edges, root seams, the knuckle hinge, side and tip turns stay hidden guides (data-brush-role guide); the 3.3 tone loops stay hidden tone boundaries for the colour stages. Colours: #5c3533 skin ink matching legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body brushes, nail lines #e0aea9 like the right-foot toes. Line colour (4.7): tip contour stays the silhouette ink #5c3533 (matches the foot_body contours and the neighbouring tip strokes; the reference silhouette sits on the dark background), the visible right gap line recoloured from #5c3533 to the reference pinkish-brown gradient (see its desc), nail ring #e0aea9 unchanged (reference nail ring G 193-213).

path.desc: Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_tip_contour: one continuous hard #5c3533 stroke from junction to junction, ~1.5 px at both junctions (meets the neighbouring tip strokes and the gap stroke end there, round caps overlapping so the junction has no gap), swelling to ~2.0 px over the lowest ~3 px of the tip (lowest y 1494.2). Hard edge.

Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_right_gap_contour (gap 2): blank above y ~1463.5 (under foot_body, never inked); soft fade-in over y 1464-1467 (pressure ramp from hair-thin to ~1.15 px plus opacity ramp 0-1), holds ~1.15 px, thickens to ~1.5 px over the last ~4 px into the junction (542.4,1490.2), where it merges with the tip strokes; round end cap. Firm edge on this toe side. Colour (4.7): same opacity fade-in, then a vertical gradient over the visible length following the reference line value, the pinkish brown of the neighbouring skin in the same family (reference gap-2 line: #d49b9a at y 1469, #bb7a7a-#ba787a at 1471-1473, #c38888-#bf8483 at 1477-1479, #cc9a99-#d5a8a6 at 1483-1487, #905d5a at 1489, darker notch into J2); the line stays lighter than the silhouette ink along the toe sides and darkens only into the tip junction, where the toe tips meet. Width, start, fade and hardness unchanged from 3.5.

Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_struct_nail: thin light warm grey-pink ring (#e0aea9) drawn from the lowest point round and back so its thin faint ends meet there, ~0.6 px on the upper arc and sides, thinning to ~0.35 px on the lower arc; opacity 0.85 easing to ~0.08 over the lowest ~1.5 px so the ring nearly breaks where the pale tip crescent begins. Hard but light edge, clearly lighter than the gap lines.

g.desc: 独立投影层（4.5.1 登记，4.5.2 绘制）：big_toe 叠压在 second_toe 的 image-left 缘并挡光，投在 second_toe 沿 gap 的根部叠压带与缝隙。follow legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe，clip_to legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/second_toe。放在 second_toe 之后、big_toe 之前，故被 big_toe 自身遮住的部分静止不可见、张趾时随 big_toe 移动露出。关系依据见 structure/rendering.json 同名条目 note。_range 为 3.3 范围曲线的隐藏位置参考（display none）；_band 为完整投影色面。

path.desc: Full cast shadow / contact occlusion of big_toe on second_toe along gap 1. Geometry: from the toes-group top (y 1453.8) the hidden root lap between legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_left_hidden_edge and the gap-1 line (~3 px wide at the top, kept as motion margin under big_toe and foot_body), then a 1 px margin under big_toe down to the gap-1 junction J1 (529.4,1489.7); on the visible second_toe side 0.5 px under the gap ink, widening to 2.0 px over y 1469-1476 (the deep slit), narrowing back to 0.5 px by y 1483 (the reference skin is back to G 215-243 two pixels right of the line there) and tapering to 0 over the last 3.5 px into J1. Colour from base-subject.png: the right side of the gap-1 line reads G 208/164/133/79 at y 1467-1479 and the slit reaches G 3 at (527,1476), clearly darker than gaps 2-4, so multiply #ad8180 (opacity 1) over y 1470-1478, lighter #b58a88 at the ends; opacity 0 above y 1462.5 (no root shadow under foot_body in the reference) fading in by y 1466.5. Blur 0.45: firm against big_toe, ~1 px soft onto the second_toe top. The near-black core of the slit stays in the 3.5 gap-1 brush stroke (#3a2022); this layer adds the soft dark spill beside it.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe: big toe (hallux), image-left edge toe. One closed fill plus its boundary curves (tip contour, side edges, root seam), which together trace the fill outline exactly. Guide: block-layers/groups.svg legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe (block0 visible strip, block1 root motion margin).

path.desc: Fill region of big_toe, base skin #f9e7de (same as foot_body), one continuous closed area without holes: from (505.4,1461.6), where the foot_body inner contour hands over, down the inner (image-left) side and round the broad rounded tip to the gap-1 junction (529.4,1489.7), up the visible right side along gap 1 to (524.5,1453.8) at the toes-group top, then along the root seam under foot_body and down the parent edge back to the start. No hidden lap on the right: this toe is the top of the stack. Expected reveal: the root lap (under foot_body and under the neighbouring toe) shows only when the toes spread, curl or the foot flexes; it is the same toe skin and later shading should simply continue the visible root tone into it. Base colour (4.1, checked against base-subject.png): bare toe skin #f9e7de over the whole closed fill, the same skin material and inherent colour as legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body (reference foot top #f9e7da-#fae6dc, this toe #fae5dd (top plane), tip #fbe5e0), one continuous colour zone including the hidden root lap under foot_body and the hidden lap under the neighbouring toe, so toe flexion and spread reveal the same skin. Pinker gap sides, pale tip and edge lights are tone steps, not base colour. The nail plate is a separate nail material: legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_nail_base.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe large light/shade (4.2), checked against base-subject.png: light from the upper right/front. The toe top plane stays the lit base skin #f9e7de with no fill over it. The left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps (both sides of each gap read light, recorded in 3.3 as edge lights), so the only self shade carried by the toe form is the narrow tip rim where the top plane rolls under toward the sole, between legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_tip_turn and the tip contour. Not here: the gap-1 cleft (slit and its root above y 1474, contact occlusion from big_toe, rendering 4.5), the hidden-lap occlusion (4.5), edge lights / nail centre / pale tip (4.6), nail plate shading (later nail steps). Drawn over the skin fill and under the nail plate and brush lines. Local darks (4.4, checked against base-subject.png): no extra dark painted on this toe. At the junctions: J1 (529.4,1489.7) is the deep big/second slit, contact occlusion from big_toe, rendering 4.5, so a crevice dark would double the junction and make it too black. The reference shows no dark at the knuckle hinge, the nail fold or the toe root on this toe (rows above the nail stay G 228-232, current 231); the tip rim shade above stays the only turning dark, and the nail ring brush and nail local colour carry the nail edge. (Current values measured before the 4.7 gap-line recolour; after it the gap lines read pinkish brown and the junction notches stay at or below the reference, still no extra crevice dark needed.)

path.desc: 4.2 tip rim self shade of big_toe: closed band from legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_tip_turn (inner edge) to the tip contour, pushed ~1.2 px past the contour so the outer edge is cut hard by the toe fill clip. Reference x 515-524, y 1491-1493: G 216-177 against 229-233 on the pale tip above: a slightly pinker, darker skin where the round tip turns away, #efc6c0 at 0.8 over the base (reads ~#f2d0ca). Edge: hard against the tip contour (fill clip, under the 2 px brush), blur 0.5 softens the ~1 px inner edge toward the pale tip / top plane. Moves with the toe.

Nail plate base colour of big_toe (4.1): #f0cac4, pink-mauve nail material distinct from the toe skin #f9e7de (reference nail interior x 515-525, y 1480-1486 median #efcac3 (upper quintile #f1c8c7); same nail material as legs/right_leg/right_foot/toes; small nails one step lighter than the big nail, as in the reference). Closed area = legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_nail (rounded rectangle x 513.8-526.2, top y~1478.4, free edge y~1486.4), clipped to the big_toe fill. Sits over the skin fill and under the brush lines; the pale skin below the free edge stays skin (tip pale highlight tone, later). Nail local colour, shading and highlight are later steps.

Local colour across the big_toe nail plate (4.3), over legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_nail_base: reference column x 517-523: y 1477 skin #fce6e0, y 1478 paler pink #f5d6d1 (soft ~1.5 px cuticle transition), plate body y 1479-1484 #f0c8c6-#efc9c5 (matches the base), lowest row y 1485 deeper #eac2c1-#eac5c2 just above the free edge. Vertical gradient over the nail area (y 1478.4-1486.5): paler #f7dad5 at 0.85 opacity at the cuticle, fading out over the top ~22 % so the skin-to-nail change is soft along the cuticle; deeper #e9bfbe at 0.75 over the lowest ~20 %, so the plate deepens toward the free edge as in the reference. The plate body keeps the base colour. Hard edge stays only where the nail ring brush runs; the paler nail centre, the free-edge light and the pale tip below are 4.6. Moves with the toe.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe highlights (4.6), checked against base-subject.png: matte skin and nail, light from the upper right/front, so only soft pale planes (#fdf1ed for skin, #fbe5e1 for nail), no glossy specular dots. Placed above the nail colours and below the brush lines. No reflected light under the tip (the tip rim stays pink-dark, 4.2). The big toe nail centre stays its 4.3 local colour (reference G 194-197, current 194). All highlights move with the toe, so no separate rendering layer.

path.desc: big_toe edge light along the image-right gap side (4.6), filled from the 3.3 range legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_tone_right_gap_edge_light; reference G 240 at (526,1480) beside the gap-1 ink, current base 231. Matte skin light, no specular dot; 0.5 blur: firm on the ink / nail side, soft ~1 px into the base. Moves with the toe.

big_toe rim light along the lower inner contour (4.6), filled from the 3.3 range legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_tone_inner_edge_light; reference G 233-238 along the lower inner contour, e.g. G 238 at (509,1482), current base 231. Matte skin light, no specular dot; 0.5 blur: firm on the ink / nail side, soft ~1 px into the base. Moves with the toe.

big_toe pale crescent of the toe tip under the nail (4.6), filled from the 3.3 range legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_tone_tip_pale_highlight; weak: reference G 229 just under the nail (#fbe6e0), reads light only against the pink nail plate. Matte skin light, no specular dot; 0.5 blur: firm on the ink / nail side, soft ~1 px into the base. Moves with the toe.

big_toe visible contour (red). Visible outer contour of the big toe: starts at (505.4,1461.6), where foot_body_inner_contour ends, so the foot inner edge and this line read as one stroke; runs down the inner (image-left) side (x~505.2-507.7), turns round the broad rounded tip (lowest ~y 1495.2) and rises into the gap-1 junction (529.4,1489.7), where it meets the end of this toe's own right gap line and the start of second_toe_tip_contour. Weight: ~2 px skin line from the start, 2-2.2 px round the inner side and tip, easing to ~1.5 px into the junction; hard edge, continuous, no gaps (line-reference outline is continuous here). Traced on base-subject.png (edge set 0.6 px outward). Bounds the lower edge of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_fill.

big_toe image-right side = toe gap 1 (between big_toe and second_toe), the visible gap line (red). Runs from (524.5,1453.8) at the toes-group top (hidden under foot_body) down to the junction (529.4,1489.7) with the tip contours. Hidden and never inked above y~1463 (under foot_body toe_root_seam); the inked stroke starts at y~1463 with a soft fade-in over ~3 px (hair-thin, then ~1-1.2 px), holds ~1.2 px, and thickens slightly to ~1.5 px into the junction where it merges with the tip contours. Edge firm on the big_toe side; the dark gap shading beside it toward second_toe belongs to later shading. Bounds the right edge of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_fill; this toe sits above second_toe, so this line is the actual silhouette edge over the neighbour. Expected reveal when toes spread: the line stays this toe's edge; the neighbour's root lap appears beside it. The reference shows a hair-thin dark slit beside this line at y~1474-1490 (background between the two toes); the line carries it, the slit darkness is for later shading.

big_toe root edge, hidden (blue dashed): top of the toe from (524.5,1453.8) along the toes-group top to the parent corner (506.4,1452.5) and down the parent edge under the foot inner contour to (505.4,1461.6), about 6-10 px above foot_body_toe_root_seam, all under foot_body. Internal joint lap for toe flexion, never inked, soft colour-matched edge. Closes legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_fill along the top. Expected reveal: none in the rest pose; toe curl or spread keeps it under the foot.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe internal structure lines (3.2), thin position guides. The nail is the only interior line inked in line-reference.png (a light grey-pink thin ring, much lighter than the skin contour); the knuckle hinge, side-plane turns and tip turn are structure / shade boundaries for later shading and are not inked. Positions measured on base-subject.png (pink nail ring / nail plate, pinker side bands along the gaps and sides, pinker rim along the tip). Mirrors the right-foot toes structure.

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe. Big toe nail plate: rounded rectangle x 513.8-526.2, y 1478.4-1486.4 (reference pink plate G~197-202 against skin G~229, x 514-526, y 1479-1486), top edge gently arched (highest 1478.4 at x~520), sides nearly straight, bottom edge (free-edge line) almost straight at y~1486.4 with rounded corners r~2. Connects to nothing: an island inside the toe top plane, ~8 px from the inner contour, ~1.3-2 px from the gap-1 line on its image-right side (the reference nail sits close to the gap here) and ~6 px above the tip contour. Use: nail border; final shows as a thin light line (~0.6-0.8 px, warm grey-pink, line-reference light grey), slightly firmer along the top and the two upper corners, thinning to ~0.4 px and nearly fading along the bottom free-edge line where the pink plate meets the pale tip zone (the colour change carries it). Hard but light edge. Fill: closes the nail region (pink nail plate) for later local colour; the pale zone between it and the tip contour (y 1486.5-1492) is the pale tip, not part of this region. Expected reveal: none (always on the visible top plane). Tone (3.3): its lower third is closed as big_toe_tone_nail_center_light (pale free edge); tone_tip_pale_highlight shares its bottom edge.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe. Interphalangeal joint hinge: very shallow upward-bowed arc across the toe at y~1471.5 from (508.0,1471.8) to (525.0,1471.8), ending ~1 px short of both side edges, about halfway between the foot_body toe-root seam and the nail top. Use: bend axis for toe curl / flex (the segment below it rotates); the reference shows no crease or knuckle mark here in the rest pose, so final: no ink, no visible tone, at most a hair of shading if the toe curls. Soft, both ends fade. Not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: when the toes curl a soft crease forms along this line and the knuckle top above it catches light.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe. Inner side-plane turn of the big toe: ~2.5 px inside the inner (image-left) contour from (507.8,1463.5), continuing foot_body_struct_inner_side_turn (ends at (510.4,1460.0) above the big-toe root; on the toe the side band narrows to ~2.5 px, reference pinker band x 505.5-508) down to (510.2,1484.0) where it bends into the tip turn. Band to the left of it is the narrow inner side shade. Use: top-plane / side-plane boundary for shading; final: no ink, soft tone break only (~1.5 px gradient toward the side), fades in at its upper end over ~2 px and fades out into the tip turn. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): no inner side shade on the toe (G 228-230 at the edge); below y 1476 the band between it and the inner contour holds big_toe_tone_inner_edge_light; auxiliary only above.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe. Right side-plane turn: runs 1.8 px inside (image-left of) the gap-1 line (this toe's visible right_gap_contour) from (523.3,1465.0), just below where the gap line starts showing under foot_body, down to (527.4,1487.5) beside the nail, where it fades into the tip turn. The narrow band between it and the gap line is the toe side turning away into the gap (reference: pinker/darker band 1.5-2 px wide along the gap against the top plane G~229-233). Use: top-plane / side-plane boundary for shading; final: no ink, soft tone break only (~1.5 px gradient toward the side), fades in at its upper end over ~2 px and fades out into the tip turn. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): no side shade in this pose; the band between it and the gap contour holds the thin right_gap_edge_light (outer limit = this line); auxiliary only, the shade relation applies when the toe turns or curls.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe. Tip turn: where the top plane rolls over the rounded toe tip toward the underside, ~2.0 px inside the tip contour, from (510.2,1484.0) to (527.4,1487.5) (lowest ~y 1492.5), passing just under the nail. Joins the lower ends of the two side-plane turns. The strip between it and the tip contour is the pinker rim of the tip in the reference (1-2 px), and above it, under the nail, the pale tip crescent. Use: shade boundary for the tip rim / pale crescent; final: no ink, soft tone break; fades out at both ends into the side turns near the gap-junction notches. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Expected reveal: none beyond the visible tip. Tone (3.3): no darker tip rim measured in this pose (the band below it is the contour antialias, G ~230 inside); where present the pale crescent (tone_tip_pale_highlight) lies above it; auxiliary only.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe light/shade ranges (3.3), thin dashed position loops only (display none, like the right-foot toes); colour and value are the next stage. Read from base-subject.png in the current rest pose: light from the upper right/front, the toe top plane is one even light value (#f9e6db-#fae7db, G 228-231), with no cast shadow from foot_body over the toe roots (y 1456-1462 is as light as the toe tops, so no root shadow loop) and no tone on the knuckle hinge. Unlike the mirrored right-foot draft, the left toes show no darker side bands along the gaps or the tip rim: the drawing puts a thin lighter edge on both sides of each gap ink line, so those bands are recorded as edge lights. Ranges here: right gap edge light, inner edge light at the lower inner corner, nail free-edge light, weak pale tip.

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe. Light range: thin edge light on the image-right side of the toe, along its visible right gap contour legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_right_gap_contour (gap 1). Closed loop from (525.0,1472.0) to (528.2,1488.5): hard inner side 1.1 px left of the gap centreline (the ink edge), soft side up to 2.2 px from it, width 0 at both ends and ~1.1 px in the middle. Source: form light, the rounded toe side rolling toward the light (upper right/front) right where it meets the gap; the edge of big_toe stays light, the gap itself is the only dark. Reference base-subject.png: mean G 231 in the band against 228-231 on the top plane (peaks 239-248), y 1472-1488. Definite y 1474-1486; fades in from the foot_body toe-root seam side (blank above y 1472, where the gap ink is still faint) and fades out ~1.5 px before the tip junction (529.4,1489.7); blank below. Edge: hard against the gap ink, soft ~0.8 px toward the top plane. Lies between the gap contour and legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_right_side_turn (1.8 px), which is its outer limit; this light reads where 3.2 expected a side shade, so the side turn carries no shade in this pose. Final: absorbed into colour/shading as a lighter skin hairline (4.x), no line; the gap contour keeps the ink. Region: inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_fill, closed against the gap contour. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe. Light range: rim light along the lower inner (image-left) contour of the big toe, closed loop from (507.8,1476.0) down to (510.6,1488.5) just above where the contour turns into the tip, hard side 0.9 px inside the contour (ink edge), soft side up to 2.3 px, tapering at both ends. Source: edge/form light on the rounded inner corner of the toe tip facing the viewer. Reference: mean G 233 (peaks 236-238) at y 1478-1487 against 230 on the top plane; above y 1476 the inner edge is flat (G 228-230), so the narrow inner side shade of foot_body (foot_body_tone_inner_side_shade, closing at the toe-root seam) does not continue onto the toe and there is no inner side shade here. Definite y 1478-1487, fades in/out over ~2 px, blank above 1476. Edge: hard against the contour, soft ~1 px inward. Lies between the inner contour and legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_inner_side_turn. Final: absorbed into colour/shading as a lighter rim, no line; the contour keeps the ink. Region: inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_fill, closed against the inner contour. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe. Light range on the nail: closed oval centred (520.4,1485.0), 6.8 x 2.6 px (lower third of the nail, the free edge), entirely inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_nail. Source: the domed nail plate facing the light. The big toe nail reads as a pink plate (G 197-210) whose lower third, the free edge, is paler; reference G 196 in the oval (weak, only a few values above the ring). Edge: soft ~0.8 px all round, no hard edge; no blank intervals (the whole loop is a soft limit). Final: absorbed into colour (nail colour step, paler centre / free edge) in 4.x, no line. Region: inside the nail region, closed on itself. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe. Light range: pale crescent of the toe tip under the nail, closed lens from (515.0,1486.4) along the lower edge of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_nail (shared edge) to (525.0,1486.4), bowing down to y 1490.0, stopping ~1.5 px above the tip contour. Source: light on the forward-facing toe pad / the nail free edge. Reference: mean G 229 just under the nail (y 1489-1491 at #fbe6e0, about the top-plane value; it reads light only against the pink nail plate above and the pinker band at y 1487-1488, so it is a weak range). Edge: firm along the nail (colour change), soft ~1 px downward into the base skin; definite in the middle third, fading out at both ends where the nail meets the tip. Final: absorbed into colour as a lighter skin / free-edge step, no line. Region: inside legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_fill, closed against the nail outline. Not drawn as a line: display none, 0.4 px dashed position loop only (no stroke start/end, no weight in the final art).

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe details (3.4): none needed. The reference skin of the toes is smooth at this density (no wrinkles, knuckle creases, nail ridges or cuticle lines in base-subject.png); line-reference.png has only the outer contour, the gap lines and faint nail outlines (offset ~+2/+3 px like the rest of this area), all already drawn in 3.1/3.2. The nail plate and its pale free edge are carried by legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_nail and the 3.3 tones; unlike the right foot, there is no separate free-edge line (rows 1484-1485 pink, 1486 transition, 1487-1490 pale, no second light line in line-reference). No inner rim line: foot_body_detail_rim_inner is already blank at the toe-root seam, and the light lower inner edge is the tone big_toe_tone_inner_edge_light.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (size 1, thinning 1, smoothing 0.5, simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, linear radius easing; width = 2 x pressure set per point from the source desc, ramps by smoothstep t*t*(3-2t); built-in taper options off, tapers realised as pressure ramps); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/toes/big_toe visible brush strokes (3.5), from the 3.1 contours, the 3.2 nail line and the 3.4 detail lines of this part; source curves kept hidden (data-brush-role brush-source). Hidden edges, root seams, the knuckle hinge, side and tip turns stay hidden guides (data-brush-role guide); the 3.3 tone loops stay hidden tone boundaries for the colour stages. Colours: #5c3533 skin ink matching legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body brushes, nail lines #e0aea9 like the right-foot toes. Line colour (4.7): tip contour stays the silhouette ink #5c3533 (matches the foot_body contours and the neighbouring tip strokes; the reference silhouette sits on the dark background), the visible right gap line recoloured from #5c3533 to the reference pinkish-brown gradient (see its desc), nail ring #e0aea9 unchanged (reference nail ring G 193-213).

path.desc: Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_tip_contour: one continuous hard #5c3533 stroke, no gaps. Starts ~6 px up the foot inner edge at (506.0,1455.0), lying under the foot_body inner contour stroke (which tapers to a point at (505.4,1461.6)) with that overlap eased up to ~0.45 px outward over the last 5.5 px as the foot_body stroke tapers (and back to centred within 2.5 px below the handover), so the visible band beside the foot_body fill stays ~1.5-2 px without a step and the silhouette keeps one line across the handover; 1.3 px at that hidden start rising to 2.0 px within 2.5 px, 2.0-2.1 px down the inner side and round the broad tip (lowest ~y 1495), easing to ~1.4 px over the last 5 px into the gap-1 junction (529.4,1489.7), round cap. Hard edge.

Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_right_gap_contour (gap 1): blank (not drawn) above y ~1462.5 under foot_body; fades in over y 1463-1466 (pressure ramp 0 to 1.15 px plus opacity 0 to 1 in the gradient), holds ~1.15 px, then over the deep big/second slit y 1474-1488 thickens to ~1.4 px and darkens to #3a2022 (carries legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__second_toe_tone_slit_occlusion_shade, the near-black cleft), ~1.45 px into the junction (529.4,1489.7) where it merges with the two tip strokes. Firm edge, round end cap. Colour (4.7): same opacity fade-in, then a vertical gradient over the visible length following the reference line value, the pinkish brown of the neighbouring skin in the same family (reference gap-1 line: #e0b6ad-#cfa29b at y 1467-1469, #b78582 at 1473, near black #0e0302-#3f1c1b over the slit y 1475-1479, #5e3530 at 1481, #9a716a-#a97a6b at 1483-1485, #855750-#331816 into J1); the line stays lighter than the silhouette ink along the toe sides and darkens only into the tip junction, where the toe tips meet. Width, start, fade and hardness unchanged from 3.5.

Brush of legs__left_leg__left_foot__toes__big_toe_struct_nail: thin light warm grey-pink line (#e0aea9, not ink), ring drawn from the bottom centre round and back so its thinnest, faintest ends meet on the bottom line. ~0.75 px along the arched top and the upper corners and sides, thinning to ~0.4 px along the bottom free-edge line; opacity 0.9 at the top easing to ~0.2 at the bottom (nearly fading where the pink plate meets the pale tip, the colour change carries it). Hard but light edge.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body outer contour and junctions (3.1). Mirror of right_foot/foot_body. Stack: above legs/left_leg/left_shin (the shin's lower end y~1400-1405 lies under this part), below left_anklet and above the toes group (toe roots tuck under this part ~9 px). Guide: block-layers/groups.svg same id. Lines here are thin position guides only (red = visible contour to be inked, blue dashed = internal seam / hidden edge, never inked); final ink, colour and widths come in later stages.

path.desc: Fill region of foot_body, one continuous closed area without holes or openings: ankle dome top (533,1358.7) - inner side (511,1366.4) - inner (big-toe side, image-left) edge down to (505.4,1461.6) - toe-root seam through the toe-gap tops to (573.8,1459.1) - outer (little-toe side, image-right) edge up to (554,1365.7) - back over the dome. Taken unchanged from the guide block (visible edges calibrated to base-subject.png and line-reference.png; dome is the hidden ankle cap). Base colour (part_base_colors): bare skin #f9e7de over the whole closed fill, one material and one inherent-colour zone, including the hidden ankle dome under the shin end and the strip under the toe roots, so ankle rotation and toe flexion reveal the same skin. Checked against the reference: the mid-tone median of the visible foot is ~#f9e6dc (measured median y 1405-1455, x 520-550; ankle front and instep, anklet excluded), the same as the shin (~#fae6dd); so the foot uses the shin/thigh base #f9e7de and the ankle seam with legs/left_leg/left_shin stays invisible. Material: warm, soft, matte skin with low gloss, the same as the legs. The side shades, ankle hollows, instep highlight, rims and the anklet glow are later shading/colour layers, not base-colour zones; the anklet chain and crystal belong to left_anklet. Volume step (4.2): the top of the hidden ankle dome is feathered with mask r3s7_legs__left_leg__left_foot_dome_feather (the fill blurred by 3 px, solid from y 1376 down), so the internal seam over the shin ankle shading stays invisible as foot_body_ankle_joint_seam requires; the visible outer/inner edges below y 1376 stay hard. The earlier blue position stroke is removed; the visible edge is drawn by the contour brushes. Whole region is one bare-skin surface like the shin, matte.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body big light/dark (4.2): self shading of the foot, frontal light treated as the mirror of the right foot (outer image-right side and both ankle hollows in shade), consistent with the left shin. Colours sampled from the reference against base skin #f9e7de; soft-edged, clipped to the foot_body fill, over the fill and under the brush strokes. Order: side-plane shades, ankle hollows (continuing the shin ankle pockets over the hidden ankle seam), then the lit instep. The foot in the reference is almost flat-lit, so all steps are small. The outer rim light and inner warm rim are left to 4.3/4.4 (detail rims), the left_anklet glow and any anklet occlusion to 4.5 / rendering stack.

path.desc: Outer (little-toe) side plane turning from the light (mirrors the right foot; outer = image-right here): the closed foot_body_tone_outer_side_shade loop (inner edge = struct_outer_side_turn, outer edge past the outer contour, clipped by the fill), filled #f8e1d6, one soft step below base #f9e7de (reference #fae3dc on the left foot side band x 554-562 y 1420-1450, against #f9e6dc on the top plane; deepened a hair so the side reads). Opacity fades in under the anklet beads (y 1388-1397), held to ~1452, eases to 0.5 at the toe-root seam where the toes take over. Blur 2.0: ~3-4 px soft gradient toward the top plane, matching the reference.

Inner (big-toe/arch) side plane shade: the closed foot_body_tone_inner_side_shade loop, #f7e3d6, a slightly warm step below base (left reference #f9e5d9 on the 3-5 px inner band x 511-515, less yellow than the right foot; edge pixel #eebab0 at y 1400). Fades in under the anklet, eases out toward the toe-root seam. Blur 1.5 (~2 px soft edge toward image-left).

Outer ankle hollow beside the lateral malleolus: closed foot_body_tone_outer_ankle_pocket (left edge = struct_outer_malleolus), #f4d6cf (left reference #f4d4d0 at x 548-555 y 1364-1382; the foot carries the same hollow down from the shin over the hidden ankle seam). Top fades in over the hidden dome overlap (y 1356-1363) so it meets the shin pocket under the cap; firm y 1363-1383; fades into the outer side shade below the anklet beads. Grown by a 5 px stroke in the same gradient (about 2.5 px past the malleolus line, outward part clipped) and blurred 2.0, because the reference hollow reaches ~3 px in front of the bone line (x~546 outer, x~519 inner) and meets the shin side shade there.

Inner ankle hollow beside the medial malleolus: closed foot_body_tone_inner_ankle_pocket (right edge = struct_inner_malleolus), #f5d9d0 (left reference #f6d8d1 at x 513-518 y 1364-1382, slightly lighter than the right inner hollow), continuing the shin inner pocket; top fades in over the hidden overlap, fades out under the anklet inner beads. Grown by a 5 px stroke in the same gradient (about 2.5 px past the malleolus line, outward part clipped) and blurred 2.0, because the reference hollow reaches ~3 px in front of the bone line (x~546 outer, x~519 inner) and meets the shin side shade there.

Lit instep top plane: closed foot_body_tone_instep_highlight around struct_instep_ridge, #fbebe3 at max 0.6 opacity, only a whisper above base (the left reference top plane is nearly flat, #f9e6dc-#f9e7db; the lift mainly separates the top plane from the side shades). Fades in under the anklet pendant, held over y 1418-1450, fades out before the toe-root seam. Blur 3.0 (~4-5 px soft on all sides).

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body transition and local colour (4.3), over the volume layer and under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill and sharing the dome feather mask. From the reference: slight warm peach on the forefoot top plane, pinkish edge light at the outer ankle continuing the shin, warm pink-peach along the inner edge, a warm peach transition at the outer side-plane turn. Big light/shade zones unchanged; the rims stay as detail lines (4.4), the left_anklet glow for 4.5/rendering stack.

ellipse.desc: Slight warm peach on the lower top plane / forefoot (centre 532,1440, rx 20, ry 13, #f8e3d6 0.45 at the centre, radial fade, blur 3): the left reference forefoot reads #f9e6dc (x 520-545, y 1432-1450), a touch warmer and less pale than the instep highlight above it (#f8e7de in the reference, lifted after 4.2); this tempers the cool pale run-out of the instep highlight into the toe roots without moving the highlight itself. The ankle warmth of the shin (shin_lc_ankle_warm) was tested here and left out: on the foot top plane it darkened the visible ankle front (reference #f9e7dc-#fae8dc), so that warmth stays under left_anklet.

path.desc: Pinkish edge light inside the outer silhouette at the ankle, continuing legs_left_leg_left_shin_lc_outer_edge_light (which ends #f8d8d2 at the ankle): hidden outer contour stroked 5 px (outer half clipped), #f8d8d2 0.7 at y~1370, lightening to #fbe2dc 0.6 by ~1392 and fading out by ~1420, where the pale detail rim (foot_body_detail_rim_outer) takes over toward the toes (left reference outer edge #f5d3cc at y 1372, #fae1de at y 1400, #fae1da at y 1415). Blur 1.0.

Warm pink-peach along the inner (big-toe side) edge, continuing legs_left_leg_left_shin_lc_inner_edge_warm (#f3d1cb at the ankle): hidden inner contour stroked 7 px (outer half clipped), #f1ccc6 0.6 at the ankle, #f3d3c8 0.5 by y~1400, easing to #f4d9cc 0.25 by ~1420, 0.1 by ~1446 and 0 at the toe-root seam (left reference inner edge #f1ccc6 at y 1372, #f4d6cc at 1400, already #f9e5d8 at 1420: the warm band is shorter and higher than on the right foot, which kept 0.45-0.55 down to y 1428). Over the inner side shade, under the warm detail rim. Blur 2.0.

Warm peach transition (#f8e5d5, 0.5, ~5 px, blur 3) along struct_outer_side_turn, the inner edge of the outer side shade: keeps the side-plane turn warm and soft like the shin calf turn (left reference side band #fae3dc, slightly warmer/pinker than the top plane #f9e6dc). Fades in below the anklet (y~1398) and out before the toe-root seam.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body local darks (4.4): the narrow warm creases where both ankle bones turn into the foot sides and a very faint ankle-front fold. Over volume and local colour, under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill and sharing the dome feather mask. Ankle hollows stay as the volume pockets (no double darkening); the metatarsal arc gets no shade because the reference shows no tone step there (G 229-231); the anklet / crystal drop shadows and the toe overlaps are left for 4.5.

path.desc: Warm crease just inside the inner contour where the inner ankle bone turns into the arch side (y ~1362-1404): the left reference keeps a narrow deeper band 1-3 px inside the inner edge (#f1cec7-#f2d0c8 at x 513-515 y 1370, #f3cccd at y 1388, edge #ebb7ad at y 1398), a little lighter than on the right foot (#deb0a6), while the foot body around it is #f6d8d1/#fadfd8. Hidden inner contour stroked 5 px (outer half clipped, so ~2.5 px inside), #eec7bd 0.5 over y 1366-1393, fading in at the top and out by ~1406. Narrow and soft (blur 1.0); lies over the inner ankle pocket and inner edge warm without forming a dark spot.

Small soft crease along the outer contour behind the outer ankle bone (y ~1362-1392), continuing legs_left_leg_left_shin_ls_ankle_bone_crease (#efcdc6) onto the foot so the bone hollow reads across the ankle seam: left reference #f5d0cc-#f2c7c4 at x 550-551 y 1370 and #edc9cc-#f2ccce at x 553-554 y 1388 (it runs a few px lower than on the right foot, gone by ~1398 where the edge reads #fae0dd). Hidden outer contour stroked 4 px (outer half clipped), #efc9c4 0.45-0.5, fading out at both ends by ~1396. Blur 1.0.

Very faint flexion fold across the front of the ankle along struct_ankle_front_crease, as its desc asks: #f4dcd3, max 0.25 over the centre third, fading out toward both malleoli, ~3 px, blur 1.5, no ink. Mostly under the anklet chain; the reference shows almost nothing between the beads, so it is kept just perceptible as a hinge for dorsiflexion.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body highlights (4.6), over local colour and local shading, under the brush strokes, clipped to the foot fill. Skin, matte: two faint warm rim lights just inside the contours (measured on the left-foot reference, not mirrored blindly). The top-plane highlight is already carried by volume_instep_highlight (4.2) and gets no extra sheen: no specular spot in the reference. tone_anklet_glow is not made an independent glow layer: next to the bead/crystal the skin brightening is only 1-2 px of anti-aliased fringe belonging to left_anklet's own rendering, and under the crystal the skin equals the base (f9e6dc); nothing follows the crystal on the skin.

path.desc: Warm rim light just inside the outer (image-right, little-toe) contour from ~y 1440 to the toe-root seam (~1462), following tone_outer_rim_light: reference shows fae6da-fbe6da 1-2 px inside the outline (x 566-570, y 1448-1460) against the side plane f9e3dc; weaker than on the right foot (no pale rim above y 1440, where the edge is only +2 levels). Hidden outer contour stroked 7 px (outer half clipped, ~3.5 px inside, just past the contour brush), #fce8dc 0.7, fading in over ~9 px and out at the seam. Slightly soft (blur 0.6); contour brush on top.

Faint reflected light just inside the inner (image-left, big-toe) contour, y ~1430-1458: reference edge pixel faebda / fbeadb (x 508-510, y 1436-1454), slightly yellower and +4-5 levels over the inner side plane f7e7d6-f9e5d8. Below the darker rim_inner detail (y 1392-1412), it does not overlap it. Hidden inner contour stroked 6 px (~3 px inside), #fcecdc 0.6, fading at both ends; soft (blur 0.6); contour brush on top.

foot_body visible inner (image-left, big-toe side) silhouette. Starts at (511,1366.4) where it continues the left_shin inner outline (shin ink runs above; this line picks it up at the ankle so ankle-to-foot reads as one stroke), passes the inner ankle bulge under the anklet left bead (x~510.2, y 1373-1381), then runs almost straight, very slightly outward, down to (505.4,1461.6) at the big-toe root, where the big toe outline (toes group) continues it down to ~y 1490. Final ink: line-reference shows a firm dark line ~2.0 px, thinner (~1.4 px) at the start where it overlaps the shin stroke end; short taper over the last ~4 px at the toe-root handover. Clear from y 1383 to 1458; y 1371-1383 is crossed by the anklet beads (ink may stop at bead edges). Hard edge, identical to the fill boundary.

foot_body visible outer (image-right, little-toe side) silhouette. Starts at (554,1365.7) continuing the left_shin outer outline, passes the outer ankle-bone bulge (x~556, y 1375-1384, under the anklet right bead at ~555,1377), then runs as a long gently convex line down-right along the side of the foot to (573.8,1459.1) at the little-toe root, where the little toe outer edge (toes group) continues it. Final ink: firm dark line ~1.8-2.0 px as in line-reference, thinner start overlapping the shin stroke, taper at the bottom handover so it overlaps the toe outline without a blob. Clear from y 1385 to 1456; anklet covers y 1371-1385. Hard edge, identical to the fill boundary.

Hidden ankle cap: near-semicircular top (peak 533,1358.7; ends at the inner and outer contour starts y~1366) lying under/over the shin's lower end as a joint overlap for ankle rotation. Same skin as the shin, so this seam is never inked and stays invisible (soft, colour-matched). Expected reveal: on ankle rotation only a few px near the sides may peek out from the shin silhouette; there it must continue the shin skin colour and the side contours, nothing more. The rest of the dome is simplified hidden margin.

Junction with the toes group: lower edge of foot_body along the ball of the foot / toe roots, from (505.4,1461.6) through the tops of the toe gaps (~526,1463; 540,1465; 551,1463.5; 562,1461) to (573.8,1459.1). The toes group continues ~9 px up beneath this edge, so the seam is internal skin and never inked; the short dark toe-gap strokes that start here (line-reference y~1465-1475) belong to the toes group. Expected reveal: when toes curl or spread the edge stays over continuous toe-root skin; nothing behind it opens.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body internal structure lines (3.2), thin position guides (#3a2a2a, 0.5-0.6 px), mirrored from right_foot/foot_body (contours of the two feet mirror within ~0.5 px about x=500, and the reference shading is mirrored too) and checked on base-subject.png. The line-reference has no inked interior lines on the foot body (only toe-gap strokes, which belong to the toes group), so every line here is a structure/shade boundary for later shading and none is inked in the final; anklet and crystal drop lie over the upper instep.

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Outer ankle bone (lateral malleolus) on the image-right side: shallow convex arc from (552.8,1360.5) under the shin overlap, bulging inward to x~548.4 at y~1374.5 and closing back toward the outer contour at (551.4,1385.4). Continues legs_left_leg_left_shin_struct_ankle_bones (outer pocket x 547-555, y 1358-1370) across the ankle seam so the bone reads as one form when the foot rotates. Use: separates the bone bump from the hollow in front of it; final display only as a soft shade edge (no ink), fading in at the top and out at the bottom; middle y 1366-1380 slightly firmer. Upper part y 1360-1370 lies under the shin cap and is expected to show only during ankle rotation (keep same finish there); lower part partly under the anklet right beads (x 548-556, y 1374-1386). Soft edge. Not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): also a shade boundary. Between this line and foot_body_outer_contour (x 549-556, y 1359-1386) is the outer ankle hollow shade, closed as foot_body_tone_outer_ankle_pocket; to its left is the lit ankle front (base/light skin). Self shading from the bone turning away from the light.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Inner ankle bone (medial malleolus) on the image-left side: mirror of outer_malleolus, slightly higher and narrower, from (513.6,1359.8) bulging inward to x~517.6 at y~1374 and back toward the inner contour at (514.0,1384.2). Continues the shin inner ankle pocket (legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_ankle_pockets, inner bump ~511,1360). Soft shade edge only, no ink; fades at both ends, firmest y 1366-1378. Top part hidden under the shin cap (reveals on rotation), lower end under the anklet left beads. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): also a shade boundary. Between this line and foot_body_inner_contour (x 511-518, y 1359-1384) is the inner ankle hollow shade, closed as foot_body_tone_inner_ankle_pocket; to its right is the lit ankle front.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Ankle flexion fold across the front of the ankle where the shin front turns into the instep, from just inside the outer malleolus (545.5,1389.5) sagging to y~1394 at the centre (~530) and rising to (518.0,1389.6) by the inner malleolus. Connects the lower ends of both malleolus lines. Mostly lies under the anklet chain (beads y 1384-1405), visible between beads. Use: top boundary of the instep plane and the hinge of ankle dorsiflexion. Final: very faint soft tone break only, no ink; centre third slightly stronger, both ends fade out. Soft edge. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Crest of the instep (dorsum), highest line of the foot top: from the ankle centre under the anklet pendant bead (532,1397) running down and slightly toward the big-toe (image-left) side to (521.4,1456.5) just above the second/big-toe root. Separates the lit top plane (inner half, reference lighter x 510-535) from the plane rolling toward the outer side. Passes under the crystal drop (x 530-540, y 1425-1458). Final: no ink; it is the axis of the top-plane highlight in later shading, soft and fading at both ends, strongest y 1420-1445. Tone (3.3): runs inside foot_body_tone_instep_highlight, toward its image-left half; the highlight is brightest just right of this ridge (x 525-538, y 1425-1452) and fades toward both side turns. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Turn from the top plane to the outer (little-toe, image-right) side plane: from below the outer malleolus (547.4,1395) running down-right roughly parallel to the outer contour, 9-12 px inside it, to (564.2,1458.5) above the 4th/5th toe roots. The band between this line and the outer contour is the darker side plane in the reference (x ~556-572, y 1420-1460). Final: soft shade boundary only, no ink; fades in at the top under the anklet and fades out 3-4 px before the toe-root seam. Soft edge. Tone (3.3): also the inner edge of foot_body_tone_outer_side_shade; right of it (to the outer contour) is the outer side shade, left of it base/lit top plane. Soft, ~3 px gradient toward image-left. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Turn from the top plane to the inner (arch) side plane on the big-toe (image-left) side: from below the inner malleolus (515.4,1394.5) down, 4-6 px inside the inner contour, to (510.4,1460) above the big-toe root. Narrow darker inner side band (reference x ~506-513). Final: soft shade boundary, no ink, fades at both ends. Soft edge. Tone (3.3): also the inner edge of foot_body_tone_inner_side_shade; left of it (to the inner contour) is the narrow inner side shade, right of it the lit top plane. Soft, ~2 px gradient toward image-right. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Ball-of-foot line (metatarsal heads): gentle arc across the foot 4-8 px above the toe-root seam, from the outer side (571,1455.5) to the inner side (507.4,1458.4). Marks where the top plane rolls forward into the toe roots; the toes group bends from here. Final: very faint soft tone step (slightly shaded below), no ink; ends fade into the side planes. Soft edge, not a fill boundary. Tone (3.3): the reference shows almost no tone step here (G 229-231 on both sides); kept as an auxiliary line only, no fill relation; at most a very faint shade under it handed to shading. Brush (3.5): no visible stroke; kept as a hidden shading guide, the boundary is taken over by the 4.x shading layers.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body main light/dark ranges (3.3), simple hidden dashed guide loops in the shin convention. Light from upper image-left/front (mirrored from the right foot). Self shading: outer and inner ankle hollows, outer and inner side planes; lit instep top plane; outer rim light near the toes. External: a light halo from the left_anklet gem (rendering stack). The reference foot is very evenly lit (G 225-233), so all ranges are weak, soft-edged steps.

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Outer ankle hollow shade, closed region: left edge = foot_body_struct_outer_malleolus (553.2,1359.2)-(551.4,1385.4); right edge runs just outside foot_body_outer_contour (x 554-557), closed by it (the overflow is clipped by the fill). Top starts under the ankle dome/shin overlap (hidden, revealed on ankle rotation); bottom ends under the left_anklet outer beads. Source: self shading, the lateral malleolus and ankle side turning from the upper-left light; reference stretch shows it as the darker band beside the lit ankle front (G ~211-219 vs 231). Continues legs_left_leg_left_shin_tone_ankle_pockets on the shin so the hollow reads continuous across the hidden seam. Soft edge, ~2 px gradient toward image-left; firmest y 1364-1380, fades into the outer side shade below the anklet. Final: absorbed into shading (colour fill), no line.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Inner ankle hollow shade, closed region: right edge = foot_body_struct_inner_malleolus (513.4,1359)-(514.0,1384.2); left edge just outside foot_body_inner_contour (x 510-511.4), closed by it. Top hidden under the dome/shin overlap, bottom under the left_anklet inner beads. Source: self shading of the medial malleolus side (reference G ~184-219 near the inner edge at y 1378-1390). Continues the shin inner ankle pocket. Soft edge, ~2 px gradient toward image-right; fades at top and bottom. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Outer (little-toe) side plane shade, closed region: inner edge = foot_body_struct_outer_side_turn (547.4,1395)-(564.2,1458.5); outer edge runs along/just outside foot_body_outer_contour from ~(443.0,1388) to (573.6,1462.4), closed by the contour; top joins the outer ankle pocket under the anklet beads; bottom closes at the toe-root seam (foot_body_toe_root_seam), where the toes group takes over. Source: self shading, the side plane turned away from the upper-left light (reference mottled G ~227-228 vs 230-232 on the top plane, a weak step). 8-12 px wide, widest y 1420-1450. Very soft edge, ~3-4 px gradient toward image-left; inside it the outer rim light strip (foot_body_tone_outer_rim_light) sits along the contour near the toes. Final: absorbed into shading. Left foot is the x'=1000-x mirror of the right foot (measured: reference brightness mirrors within ~5 G levels: outer pocket G~202, inner pocket ~210, outer side ~225, instep ~230); light here reads as upper image-left/front, i.e. the frontal light treated symmetrically on both feet.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Lighter rim strip along the outer contour near the toes, closed thin region ~1.5-2 px wide, 0.5 px inside foot_body_outer_contour, from (565.7,1428) to the toe-root seam at (572.8,1461). Source: rim/edge light on the outer side (reference stretch shows a bright strip there, G ~231 against the 227-228 side shade); same family as the warm rim on the shin. Fades in at the top over ~6 px, ends at the toe-root seam (continued on the toes group if they show it). Soft edge. Final: colour accent (light warm skin) inside the side shade, no line.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Inner (big-toe/arch) side shade, narrow closed region: inner edge = foot_body_struct_inner_side_turn (515.4,1394.5)-(510.4,1460); outer edge along/just outside foot_body_inner_contour, closed by it; top joins the inner ankle pocket under the anklet beads, bottom closes at the toe-root seam. Source: self shading, inner side turning from the light; reference G ~228-229 near the edge with a slightly darker 1-2 px edge at y 1380-1440. 3-5 px wide. Soft edge, ~2 px gradient toward image-right. Final: absorbed into shading.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Lit instep (top plane) highlight, closed soft region x 518-541, y 1400-1457, centred around foot_body_struct_instep_ridge (ridge on its image-left half). Upper part y 1400-1430 is overlapped by the left_anklet pendant and crystal drop. Source: self lighting of the top plane facing the upper-left light (reference G ~231-233 vs 229-230). Very soft edge, ~4 px gradient on all sides; brightest x 525-538, y 1425-1452; fades out toward the toe-root seam and the side turns. Final: absorbed into shading (slightly lighter skin), no line.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body (receiver). Bright halo on the skin around the anklet pendant bead and crystal drop, closed region x 520-545, y 1392-1433. Source: light from another part, the gem/crystal of left_anklet (caster) lighting or reflecting onto foot_body (receiver); reference G up to ~240-248 next to the bead vs 230 base. Doubt: this may be part of the anklet's own glow rendering rather than skin tone; to be decided in rendering stack. No clear cast shadow under the chain or crystal is visible in the reference (doubt kept: any anklet occlusion is left to rendering stack). Very soft edge, ~3-5 px radial fade. Final: handed to the rendering stack as an independent light layer; on foot_body only a slight lightening. Highlights (4.6): decided not to register an independent glow layer; the halo is the anklet beads/crystal anti-aliased fringe (1-2 px) and the skin under the crystal equals the base.

g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body details (3.4), shin convention (hidden detail colour lines). The line-reference has no interior lines on the foot body and the reference skin is smooth: only the two silhouette rims are needed (mirroring the right foot; the outer rim here is a faint warm edge rather than a pale rim). Faint instep mottling in a contrast-stretched crop is compression/soft shading, not tendons or texture, so no tendon or texture lines are drawn; the hidden ankle area under the shin continues the same smooth skin. Toe gaps belong to the toes group; anklet chain and crystal belong to left_anklet.

path.desc: Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Faint warm skin rim ~1 px inside foot_body_outer_contour (image-right, little-toe side), from (555.4,1372) under the left_anklet outer beads (hidden ankle continuation up to the dome) down to (573.2,1461) at the toe-root seam, where the toes group continues it. Geometry mirrors legs__right_leg__right_foot__foot_body_detail_rim_outer (x'=1000-x). Purpose: the reference shows no pale rim here (unlike the right foot) but a single warm-pink edge pixel just inside the dark contour (RGB ~225,175,172 at y 1400, 247,213,205 at y 1420, 248,219,206 at y 1440, base 249,226,219); it softens the contour into the skin and continues the shin outer rim in tone. Final: kept as a faint warm colour line merged with the contour edge, not a dark line. Weight 0.5, opacity 0.45; solid y 1395-1458, faded start under the anklet beads (y 1372-1392, blank where beads cover), fades over the last ~2 px at the seam. Soft inner edge into foot_body_tone_outer_side_shade; foot_body_tone_outer_rim_light stays the lighter band just inside it near the toes. Not a fill boundary.

Part legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body. Warm pink skin rim ~1-1.5 px inside foot_body_inner_contour (image-left, big-toe side), from (511.4,1372) under the left_anklet inner beads down to (506.8,1462) at the toe-root seam. Geometry mirrors legs__right_leg__right_foot__foot_body_detail_rim_inner. Purpose: warm subsurface-like inner edge in the reference (RGB ~238,186,176 / 244,214,204 at y 1400, nearly gone at y 1420 at 251,229,215, faint again 242,212,196 at y 1440); continues the shin inner rim across the ankle. Final: soft warm colour line, not dark. Weight 0.7 at y 1392-1412 (strongest), thinning to 0.4 by y 1420, faint trace y 1435-1450, blank to the seam; faded start under the anklet beads (blank where beads cover). Soft inner edge into foot_body_tone_inner_side_shade. Not a fill boundary.

g.data-brush-source: perfect_freehand 1.2.0 get_stroke (simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0, smoothstep easing; start/end tapers realised as smoothstep pressure ramps over the stated lengths, built-in taper options off); source curve in data-source-curve
g.desc: legs/left_leg/left_foot/foot_body brush strokes (3.5), neutral check colours at 3.5 (#3a3a3a ink, #8a8a8a soft lines), recoloured in 4.7. Inked: outer and inner silhouette. Soft: both malleolus shade edges and the two rims, clipped to the foot_body fill. Not stroked (hidden guides, kept with descs): fill boundary, ankle and toe-root seams, ankle crease, instep ridge, side turns, metatarsal arc, all tone loops. Final colours (4.7): outline #5c3533 continuous with the shin; malleolus edges warm pink #e0aaa2; outer rim warm pink at the ankle easing paler and fading toward the toes (hl_outer_rim continues); inner rim warm #e2a69c.

path.desc: Brush for foot_body_outer_contour (outer silhouette ink): perfect_freehand size 1.18, thinning 0.7; pressure 0.7 (~1.5 px) at the start over the shin stroke end, rising to 1.0 (~2.0 px) by y~1386 and held to the toe root; taper start 3 px, taper end 4 px into the toe outline. Fades in over the first ~2 px (opacity 0 to 1) so it joins the shin outline without a blob; solid through the anklet crossing (the anklet beads paint over it). Hard edge, unclipped. Neutral check colour; final colour later. Line colour (4.7): #5c3533, the same dark warm brown as legs_left_leg_left_shin_line_outer_brush so the silhouette runs on unbroken across the ankle; reference outline here reads dark red-brown (3a1d1c-6b4c48 core with a warm 876059 / e1afac fringe at x 558-571, y 1400-1455). Width, tapers and opacity ramps unchanged.

Brush for foot_body_inner_contour (inner silhouette ink): size 1.12, thinning 0.7; pressure 0.7 (~1.4 px) at the start over the shin stroke end, 1.0 (~1.9 px) from y~1388 to the big-toe root; taper start 3 px, end 4 px into the big-toe outline. Fades in over the first ~2 px; solid under the anklet beads. Hard edge, unclipped. Neutral check colour. Line colour (4.7): #5c3533, matching legs_left_leg_left_shin_line_outer_brush (shin inner line also starts #5c3533 at the ankle); reference inner outline 372322 core with d5ada9 / f4d6c2 fringe. Geometry and ramps unchanged.

Brush for foot_body_struct_outer_malleolus: soft shade-edge stroke (no ink), size 1.0, thinning 0.6, pressure 0.3 at the ends rising to 0.8 over y 1366-1380; opacity fades in from 0 and out to 0 along the curve (max ~0.35 in the middle); taper 4 px both ends. Upper part lies in the hidden overlap under the shin cap, lower end under the anklet beads. Gaussian blur 0.5 (soft edge), clipped to the foot_body fill. Final: merged into the ankle hollow shading (foot_body_tone_*_ankle_pocket); neutral check colour. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e0aaa2 (ends #e6b3ab), max 0.32, the shin ankle-bone family (#e8bab2); over the pocket it gives ~f0cec6 against the reference bone edge f2d6ce-f4d3cd (x 547-549, y 1368-1374), staying soft.

Brush for foot_body_struct_inner_malleolus: soft shade-edge stroke (no ink), size 1.0, thinning 0.6, pressure 0.3 at the ends rising to 0.8 over y 1366-1378; opacity fades in from 0 and out to 0 along the curve (max ~0.35 in the middle); taper 4 px both ends. Upper part lies in the hidden overlap under the shin cap, lower end under the anklet beads. Gaussian blur 0.5 (soft edge), clipped to the foot_body fill. Final: merged into the ankle hollow shading (foot_body_tone_*_ankle_pocket); neutral check colour. Colour (4.7): warm pink #e0aaa2 (ends #e6b3ab), max 0.34 (inner pocket edge slightly deeper on this foot: reference f0c7c1-f4d0c7 at x 514-515, y 1368-1374).

Brush for foot_body_detail_rim_outer (faint warm edge inside the outer, image-right silhouette): size 0.5, thinning 0.6, pressure 0.4 under the left_anklet beads rising to 1.0 (~0.5 px) by y~1396, easing off over the last 2 px at the toe-root seam. Opacity blank y 1372-1388 (under beads), fades in to 0.4 by y~1395 (weaker than the right foot pale rim, per the reference single warm edge pixel), solid to y~1458, fades out at the seam. Blur 0.3, clipped to the foot_body fill. Final: faint warm colour line merged with the contour edge (#f0c4b8-ish); neutral check colour for now. Colour (4.7), split along the stroke: warm pink #eab7af 0.45 near the ankle (y ~1395-1420, reference e1afac / f7d5cd just inside the outline, continuing the shin rim #e2a29c softly), easing to #f2cbc0 0.35 by y ~1440 (reference f8dbce) and fading out by ~1452, where foot_body_hl_outer_rim takes over as the slightly paler strip (reference fae6da). No pale rim above y 1440 on this foot.

Brush for foot_body_detail_rim_inner (warm rim inside the inner, image-left silhouette): size 0.65, thinning 0.6, pressure 1.0 (~0.7 px) over y 1392-1412, thinning to ~0.55 (~0.4 px) from y 1420. Opacity blank under the left_anklet beads (y 1372-1384), fades in to 0.6 by y~1392, solid to ~1412, drops to a faint 0.15-0.2 trace through y 1420-1445, out to 0 by ~1450, blank to the seam. Blur 0.3, clipped to the foot_body fill. Final: warm colour line (#e9a898-ish); neutral check colour for now. Colour (4.7): warm #e2a69c 0.6 over y 1392-1412 easing to #e4ab9f / #e8b5a8 and fading by ~1450, the shin inner rim family (#e2a29c); reference inner edge d5ada9 / f4d6cc at x 511-514, y 1362-1400.

Part legs/left_leg/left_anklet/front_chain fill: four closed overlapping subpaths (nonzero) forming one continuous region. (1) Left (image-left) arm bead string from the end bead (512.4,1376.4) down-right through 4 oval links (centres ~515,1383 / 518,1387 / 522,1392 / 527,1397) to ~(531.4,1401.3) under center_bead; (2) right arm from the end bead (553.4,1376) down-left through links ~550,1383 / 546,1388 / 542,1393 / 539,1397 to ~(535.4,1401.3); (3)(4) the two slightly larger pale-blue end beads on the ankle edges (r 2.8 / 2.7), overlapping the arm starts and the back_chain ends. Width ~4.4 px at link centres, ~2.7 px at the pinches (scalloped outline from the reference). Both arms end ~2 px under center_bead (internal seam). Visible in full; temporary pearl fill, base colour later. [Base colour 4.1] Base colour pearl white-lavender #eef1f9 (reference link cores #fafafa-#fdfcfe, pinch/rim #d3dbed belongs to the later shade step); the two end beads are a different material (blue glass) and get their own base patch front_chain_base_end_beads on top of this fill.

Part front_chain, image-right arm lower/outer edge, from under the right end bead ~(555,1377.5) to ~(536.4,1402.5) under center_bead. Use: visible outline, ~0.7 px, breaks allowed at pinches. Medium-soft edge. Bounds the right arm fill.

Final: kept as a short thin (~0.4 px) blue-grey tick, darkest at the two outline contacts, the middle ~0.8 px left open/faded as the pale pearl highlight; soft edge. Fill: divides the front_chain fill into per-link shading cells; not a closed region by itself.

Part front_chain, left (image-left) arm, rounded turn line of the bead string running just below its centreline (~0.6 px toward the lower/outer edge), from where the arm leaves the end bead to where it slides under center_bead. Use: the light-to-shadow turn of the round links (upper half lit pearl, lower half cool shade). Final: not inked; becomes the soft boundary of the shade band, broken at every link seam (each link gets its own short arc), faded to nothing at both ends. Very soft edge. Fill: shade region = between this line and the lower/outer outline, closed by the link seams. [Tone stage] The reference shows radial rim shading rather than a top/bottom split, so this line is downgraded to auxiliary only: it marks where the rim band is ~1 step deeper on the lower/outer side; the actual light zones are the tone_*_link_core ovals.

Region inside = highlight core (near white); region between this oval, the link seams on either side and the front_chain outline = blue rim shade band. Soft boundary, ~0.6 px blend width toward the rim, slightly harder on the upper side. Final: taken over by colour fields (no ink); auxiliary line only. Closed on itself.
